4.195.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
bhagavañchrotumicchāmi dānamāhātmyamuttamam ..
yadakṣayaṃ pare loke devarṣigaṇapūjitam .. 1 ..
4.195.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥
भगवञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि दानमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् ॥
यदक्षयं परे लोके देवर्षिगणपूजितम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.195.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O Lord, I wish to hear about the supreme majesty of donating, / which is imperishable in the next world and revered by the hosts of divine sages.

4.195.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
rudreṇa yatpurā proktaṃ nāradāya mahātmane ..
matsyena manave tadvattacchuṇuṣva kurūdvaha .. 2 ..
4.195.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
रुद्रेण यत्पुरा प्रोक्तं नारदाय महात्मने ॥
मत्स्येन मनवे तद्वत्तच्छुणुष्व कुरूद्वह ॥ 2 ॥
4.195.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / What was declared in ancient times by Rudra to the great-souled Nārada, / and likewise by the Fish [Avatāra] to Manu, hear that, O bull of the Kurus!

4.195.s:
meroḥ pradānaṃ vakṣyāmi daśadhā punareva te ..
yatpradātottarām̐llokānprāpnoti surapūjitān.. 3 ..
4.195.d:
मेरोः प्रदानं वक्ष्यामि दशधा पुनरेव ते ॥
यत्प्रदातोत्तराम्̐ल्लोकान्प्राप्नोति सुरपूजितान्॥ 3 ॥
4.195.m: I shall tell you once again of the ten gifts of Mount Meru, / by giving which one attains the higher worlds revered by the gods.

4.195.s:
purāṇeṣu ca vedeṣu yajñeṣvadhyayaneṣu ca ..
na tatphalamadhīteṣu kṛteṣviha yadaśnute .. 4 ..
4.195.d:
पुराणेषु च वेदेषु यज्ञेष्वध्ययनेषु च ॥
न तत्फलमधीतेषु कृतेष्विह यदश्नुते ॥ 4 ॥
4.195.m: Not in the Purāṇas, nor in the Vedas, nor in sacrifices, nor in studies / is that reward obtained, which one enjoys here when these are performed.

4.195.s:
tasmādvidhānaṃ vakṣyāmi parvatānāmanukramāt ..
prathamo dhānyaśailaḥ syaddvitīyo lavaṇācalaḥ .. 5 ..
4.195.d:
तस्माद्विधानं वक्ष्यामि पर्वतानामनुक्रमात् ॥
प्रथमो धान्यशैलः स्यद्द्वितीयो लवणाचलः ॥ 5 ॥
4.195.m: Therefore I will explain the procedure for the mountains in order: / the first is the grain mountain; the second, the salt mountain;

4.195.s:
guḍācalastṛtīyastu caturtho hemaparvataḥ ..
pañcamastilaśailaḥ syātṣaṣṭhaḥ kārpāsaparvataḥ .. 6 ..
4.195.d:
गुडाचलस्तृतीयस्तु चतुर्थो हेमपर्वतः ॥
पञ्चमस्तिलशैलः स्यात्षष्ठः कार्पासपर्वतः ॥ 6 ॥
4.195.m: the third is the mountain of molasses; and the fourth is the gold mountain; / the fifth is the sesame mountain; the sixth, the cotton mountain;

4.195.s:
saptamo ghṛtaśailaśca rasaśailastathāṣṭamaḥ ..
rājato navamastadvaddaśamaḥ śarkarācalaḥ .. .. 7 ..
4.195.d:
सप्तमो घृतशैलश्च रसशैलस्तथाष्टमः ॥
राजतो नवमस्तद्वद्दशमः शर्कराचलः ॥ ॥ 7 ॥
4.195.m: the seventh is the clarified butter mountain; and likewise the eighth is the mountain of liquids; / the ninth is the silver [mountain]; and similarly the tenth is the sugar mountain.

4.195.s:
vakṣye vidhānameteṣāṃ yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ ..
ayane viṣuve puṇye vyatīpāte dinakṣaye .. 8 ..
4.195.d:
वक्ष्ये विधानमेतेषां यथावदनुपूर्वशः ॥
अयने विषुवे पुण्ये व्यतीपाते दिनक्षये ॥ 8 ॥
4.195.m: I shall explain their procedure properly in due succession: / at an equinox, a holy solstice, a vyatīpāta, on a day of moon loss,

4.195.s:
śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāmuparāge śaśikṣaye ..
vivāhotsavayajñe vā dvādaśyāmatha vā punaḥ .. 9 ..
4.195.d:
शुक्लपक्षे तृतीयायामुपरागे शशिक्षये ॥
विवाहोत्सवयज्ञे वा द्वादश्यामथ वा पुनः ॥ 9 ॥
4.195.m: on the third [tithi] of the bright fortnight, during an eclipse, on a new moon, / at a marriage, a festival, a sacrifice, or on the twelfth [tithi],

4.195.s:
śuklāyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ vā puṇyarkṣe vā pradhānataḥ ..
dhānyaśailādayo deyā yathāśāstraṃ vijānatā .. 4.195.10 ..
4.195.d:
शुक्लायां पञ्चदश्यां वा पुण्यर्क्षे वा प्रधानतः ॥
धान्यशैलादयो देया यथाशास्त्रं विजानता ॥ 4.195.10 ॥
4.195.m: or on the fifteenth [tithi] of the bright fortnight, or especially under an auspicious lunar mansion, / the grain mountain and the others should be given according to the treatise by one who understands.

4.195.s:
tīrthe vāyatane vāpi goṣṭhe vā saṃgame'pi vā ..
maṃḍapaṃ kārayedbhaktyā caturasramudaṅmukham .. 11 ..
4.195.d:
तीर्थे वायतने वापि गोष्ठे वा संगमेऽपि वा ॥
मंडपं कारयेद्भक्त्या चतुरस्रमुदङ्मुखम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.195.m: In a holy site, or in a temple, or in a cowshed, or at a confluence, / one should build with devotion a four-sided pavilion facing north,

4.195.s:
prāgudakpravaṇaṃ tatra prāṅmukhaṃ vā vidhānataḥ ..
gomayenānuliptāyāṃ bhūmāvāstīrya vā kuśān .. 12 ..
4.195.d:
प्रागुदक्प्रवणं तत्र प्राङ्मुखं वा विधानतः ॥
गोमयेनानुलिप्तायां भूमावास्तीर्य वा कुशान् ॥ 12 ॥
4.195.m: sloping towards the north-east, or facing east, according to the rule. / Having smeared the ground with cow-dung or having spread kuśa grass,

4.195.s:
tanmadhye parvataṃ kuryādviṣkambhaparvatānvitam ..
dhānyadroṇasahasreṇa bhavedgiririhottamaḥ .. 13 ..
4.195.d:
तन्मध्ये पर्वतं कुर्याद्विष्कम्भपर्वतान्वितम् ॥
धान्यद्रोणसहस्रेण भवेद्गिरिरिहोत्तमः ॥ 13 ॥
4.195.m: in its middle one should make the mountain, accompanied by the supporting mountains. / With a thousand droṇas of grain, the mountain here is the best;

4.195.s: madhyamaḥ paṃcaśatikaḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ syāttribhiḥ śataiḥ .. 14 ..
4.195.d: मध्यमः पंचशतिकः कनिष्ठः स्यात्त्रिभिः शतैः ॥ 14 ॥
4.195.m: the middling is of five hundred, and the lowest consists of three hundred.

4.195.s:
merurmahāvrīhimayastu madhyasuvarṇavṛkṣatrayasaṃyutaḥ syāt ..
saṃpūrṇamuktāphalavajrayukto yāmye nu gomedakapuṣparāgaiḥ ..15..
4.195.d:
मेरुर्महाव्रीहिमयस्तु मध्यसुवर्णवृक्षत्रयसंयुतः स्यात् ॥
संपूर्णमुक्ताफलवज्रयुक्तो याम्ये नु गोमेदकपुष्परागैः ॥15॥
4.195.m: Meru made of great rice should be equipped in its centre with three golden trees, / fully set with pearls and diamonds, and on the south side with hessonite and topaz;

4.195.s:
yaḥ syācca gārutmatanīlaratnaiḥ saumyena vaiḍūryasarojarāgaiḥ ..
śrīkhaṃḍakhaṇḍairabhitaḥ pravāla latānvitaḥ śuddhaśilātalaḥ syāt ..16..
4.195.d:
यः स्याच्च गारुत्मतनीलरत्नैः सौम्येन वैडूर्यसरोजरागैः ॥
श्रीखंडखण्डैरभितः प्रवाल लतान्वितः शुद्धशिलातलः स्यात् ॥16॥
4.195.m: to the west with emerald and sapphire gems, to the north with cat’s eye and rubies; / it should have pieces of sandalwood, be surrounded by coral creepers, and have pure stone ledges.

4.195.s:
brahmātha viṣṇurbhagavānpurārirdivākaro'pyatra hiraṇmayaḥ syāt ..
tathaikadeśoddhatakandharastu ghṛtodakaprasravaṇāśca dikṣu .. 17 ..
4.195.d:
ब्रह्माथ विष्णुर्भगवान्पुरारिर्दिवाकरोऽप्यत्र हिरण्मयः स्यात् ॥
तथैकदेशोद्धतकन्धरस्तु घृतोदकप्रस्रवणाश्च दिक्षु ॥ 17 ॥
4.195.m: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Lord Śiva, and the Sun here should also be made of gold; / likewise, its summits should rise in one part, with waterfalls of clarified butter in the directions.

4.195.s:
śuklāṃbaro'nyaśca surācalaḥ syātpūrveṇa kṛṣṇāni ca dakṣiṇena ..
vāsāṃsi paścādatha kesarāṇi raktāni caivottarato dalāni .. 18 ..
4.195.d:
शुक्लांबरोऽन्यश्च सुराचलः स्यात्पूर्वेण कृष्णानि च दक्षिणेन ॥
वासांसि पश्चादथ केसराणि रक्तानि चैवोत्तरतो दलानि ॥ 18 ॥
4.195.m: And the mountain of the gods should have white garments [to the south], black garments to the east, / garments of saffron to the west, and red leaves to the north.

4.195.s:
raupyā maheṃdrapramukhāstathāṣṭau saṃsthāpayellokapatīnkrameṇa ..
nānāphalālī ca samaṃtataḥ syānmanoramāmālyavilepanādyā .. 19 ..
4.195.d:
रौप्या महेंद्रप्रमुखास्तथाष्टौ संस्थापयेल्लोकपतीन्क्रमेण ॥
नानाफलाली च समंततः स्यान्मनोरमामाल्यविलेपनाद्या ॥ 19 ॥
4.195.m: One should install in order the eight silver world protectors beginning with Mahendra; / and all around there should be a variety of fruits, delightful garlands, unguents, and the like;

4.195.s:
vitānakañcopari pañcavarṇamamlānapuṣpābharaṇaṃ sitaṃ vā ..
itthaṃ niveśyāmaraśailamapyunmanāstu viṣkambhagaṇānkrameṇa .. 4.195.20 ..
4.195.d:
वितानकञ्चोपरि पञ्चवर्णमम्लानपुष्पाभरणं सितं वा ॥
इत्थं निवेश्यामरशैलमप्युन्मनास्तु विष्कम्भगणान्क्रमेण ॥ 4.195.20 ॥
4.195.m: and above it, a five-coloured canopy, or a white one, adorned with unfading flowers. / Having thus installed the mountain of the immortals, with intent mind [one should install] the supporting ranges in order.

4.195.s:
turīyabhāgena caturdiśaṃ ca saṃsthāpayetpuṣpavilepanādyān ..
pūrveṇa mandaramanekaphalopayuktaṃ yatrollasatkanakabhadrakadaṃbacihnam .. 21 ..
4.195.d:
तुरीयभागेन चतुर्दिशं च संस्थापयेत्पुष्पविलेपनाद्यान् ॥
पूर्वेण मन्दरमनेकफलोपयुक्तं यत्रोल्लसत्कनकभद्रकदंबचिह्नम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.195.m: With a fourth part [of the grain] in the four directions, one should set them up with flowers, ointments, and so forth: / to the east Mandara, supplied with various fruits, where shines the mark of a golden bhadrakadamba tree,

4.195.s:
kāmena kāṃcanamayena virājamānamākārayetkusumavastravilepanāḍhyam ..
kṣīrāruṇodasarasātha tathā vanena raupyeṇa śaktighaṭitena virājamānam ..22..
4.195.d:
कामेन कांचनमयेन विराजमानमाकारयेत्कुसुमवस्त्रविलेपनाढ्यम् ॥
क्षीरारुणोदसरसाथ तथा वनेन रौप्येण शक्तिघटितेन विराजमानम् ॥22॥
4.195.m: shining with a golden Kāmadeva, one should fashion it rich with flowers, garments, and unguents, / and shining with a lake of milk and red water, and with a silver forest fashioned with strength.

4.195.s:
yāmyena gaṃdhamadanotra niveśanīyo godhūmasaṃcayamayaḥ kaladhautajo vā ..
haimena pakṣipatinā dhṛtamānasena tenādyameva sakalaṃ kilasaṃyutaḥ syāt .. 23 ..
4.195.d:
याम्येन गंधमदनोत्र निवेशनीयो गोधूमसंचयमयः कलधौतजो वा ॥
हैमेन पक्षिपतिना धृतमानसेन तेनाद्यमेव सकलं किलसंयुतः स्यात् ॥ 23 ॥
4.195.m: To the south should be placed Gandhamādana, made of a heap of wheat or fashioned of silver, / with a golden lord of birds who holds [Mount] Mānasa; with that, indeed, the entire [mountain] becomes complete. 23

4.195.s:
paścāttilācalamanekasugandha puṣpasauvarṇapippalahiraṇyayahaṃsayuktam ..
ākārayedrajatapuṣpavanena tadvadvastrānvitaṃ dadhiśatodasarastathāgre .. 24 ..
4.195.d:
पश्चात्तिलाचलमनेकसुगन्ध पुष्पसौवर्णपिप्पलहिरण्ययहंसयुक्तम् ॥
आकारयेद्रजतपुष्पवनेन तद्वद्वस्त्रान्वितं दधिशतोदसरस्तथाग्रे ॥ 24 ॥
4.195.m: To the west [one should place] the mountain of sesame seeds, endowed with various fragrant flowers, a golden pippala tree, and a golden goose; / one should fashion it likewise with a silver flower-grove, clothed in garments, with the lake of Dadhiśatoda before it. 24

4.195.s:
saṃsthāpya taṃ vipulaśailamathottareṇa śailaṃ supārśvamapi māṣamayaṃ suvapram ..
puṣpaiśca hemavaṭapādapaśeṣaratnamākārayetkanakadhenuvirājamānam .. 25 ..
4.195.d:
संस्थाप्य तं विपुलशैलमथोत्तरेण शैलं सुपार्श्वमपि माषमयं सुवप्रम् ॥
पुष्पैश्च हेमवटपादपशेषरत्नमाकारयेत्कनकधेनुविराजमानम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.195.m: Having set up that great mountain, then to the north Mount Supārśva, made of māṣa beans, with fair ramparts, / with flowers, a golden banyan tree, the remainder of jewels, and adorned with a golden cow; 25

4.195.s:
mākṣīkabhadrakarasāvacayena tadvadrau pyeṇa bhāsvararasaiśca yutaṃ vidhāya ..
homaścaturbhiratha vedapurāṇavidbhirhyetairaniṃdya varitākṛtibhirdvijendraiḥ .. 26 ..
4.195.d:
माक्षीकभद्रकरसावचयेन तद्वद्रौ प्येण भास्वररसैश्च युतं विधाय ॥
होमश्चतुर्भिरथ वेदपुराणविद्भिर्ह्येतैरनिंद्य वरिताकृतिभिर्द्विजेन्द्रैः ॥ 26 ॥
4.195.m: furnished likewise with a collection of honey and good fluids, and with silver and gleaming essences, / a homa should then be performed by four eminent Brahmins who know the Vedas and Purāṇas, irreproachable and chosen for their form. 26

4.195.s:
pūrveṇa hastamukhamatra vidhāya kuṃḍaṃ kāryastilairatha ghṛtena samitkuśaiśca ..
rātrau ca jāgaramanuddhatagītatūryairāvāhanaṃ ca kathayāmi śiloccayānām .. 27 ..
4.195.d:
पूर्वेण हस्तमुखमत्र विधाय कुंडं कार्यस्तिलैरथ घृतेन समित्कुशैश्च ॥
रात्रौ च जागरमनुद्धतगीततूर्यैरावाहनं च कथयामि शिलोच्चयानाम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.195.m: Having made here a sacrificial pit of one cubit's extent in the east, [the offering] should be made with sesame seeds, ghee, kindling sticks, and kuśa grass; / and at night [one should keep] vigil with restrained singing and musical instruments. Now I shall tell the invocation of the mountains: 27

4.195.s:
tvaṃ sarvadevagaṇadhāmanidhe ca vighnamasmadgṛheṣvamaraparvata nāśayāśu ..
kṣemaṃ vidhatsva kuru śāṃtimanuttamāṃ naḥ saṃpūjitaḥ paramabhaktimataḥ pradehi .. 28 ..
4.195.d:
त्वं सर्वदेवगणधामनिधे च विघ्नमस्मद्गृहेष्वमरपर्वत नाशयाशु ॥
क्षेमं विधत्स्व कुरु शांतिमनुत्तमां नः संपूजितः परमभक्तिमतः प्रदेहि ॥ 28 ॥
4.195.m: "O treasure-house of the dwellings of all the host of gods! Mountain of the immortals, destroy swiftly the misfortune in our homes! / Grant security, make our peace supreme! Worshipped, grant [it] to this devotee of supreme devotion! 28

4.195.s:
tvameva bhagavānīśo brahmā viṣṇurdivākaraḥ ..
mūrtāmūrtaparaṃ bījamataḥ pāhi sanātana .. 29 ..
4.195.d:
त्वमेव भगवानीशो ब्रह्मा विष्णुर्दिवाकरः ॥
मूर्तामूर्तपरं बीजमतः पाहि सनातन ॥ 29 ॥
4.195.m: You alone are the Lord God, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, the Sun, / the supreme seed of both form and formlessness; therefore protect [us], O eternal one! 29

4.195.s:
yasmāttvaṃ lokapālānāṃ viśvamūrteśca maṃdiram ..
keśavārkavasūnāṃ ca tasmā cchāṃtiṃ prayaccha me .. 4.195.30 ..
4.195.d:
यस्मात्त्वं लोकपालानां विश्वमूर्तेश्च मंदिरम् ॥
केशवार्कवसूनां च तस्मा च्छांतिं प्रयच्छ मे ॥ 4.195.30 ॥
4.195.m: Because you are the dwelling of the world protectors, of the universal form, / and of Keśava, the Sun, and the Vasus, therefore grant me peace! 30

4.195.s:
yasmādaśūnyamamarairgaṃdharvaiśca śirastava ..
tasmānmāmuddharāśeṣa duḥkhasaṃsārasāgarāt .. 31 ..
4.195.d:
यस्मादशून्यममरैर्गंधर्वैश्च शिरस्तव ॥
तस्मान्मामुद्धराशेष दुःखसंसारसागरात् ॥ 31 ॥
4.195.m: Because your summit is never devoid of gods and Gandharvas, / therefore deliver me from the ocean of worldly existence filled with all sorrows! 31

4.195.s:
evamabhyarcya taṃ meruṃ mandaraṃ cāpi pūjayet ..
yasmāccaitrarathenātha bhadrāśvavariṣeṇa ca .. 32 ..
4.195.d:
एवमभ्यर्च्य तं मेरुं मन्दरं चापि पूजयेत् ॥
यस्माच्चैत्ररथेनाथ भद्राश्ववरिषेण च ॥ 32 ॥
4.195.m: Having thus worshipped Meru, one should also worship Mandara: / 'Because [you shine] with the Caitraratha [forest] and with the Bhadrāśva realm, 32

4.195.s:
śobhase mandarakṣipramatastuṣṭikaro bhava ..
yasmāccūḍāmaṇirjaṃbūdvīpe tvaṃ gandhamādanaḥ .. 33 ..
4.195.d:
शोभसे मन्दरक्षिप्रमतस्तुष्टिकरो भव ॥
यस्माच्चूडामणिर्जंबूद्वीपे त्वं गन्धमादनः ॥ 33 ॥
4.195.m: O Mandara, you shine brightly, therefore bring satisfaction!' / 'Because you, O Gandhamādana, are the crest-jewel of Jambūdvīpa, 33

4.195.s:
gandharvairapsarobhiśca gīyamānaṃ yaśo'stu me ..
yasmāttvaṃ ketumālena vaibhrājena vanena ca .. 34 ..
4.195.d:
गन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च गीयमानं यशोऽस्तु मे ॥
यस्मात्त्वं केतुमालेन वैभ्राजेन वनेन च ॥ 34 ॥
4.195.m: may my fame be sung by the Gandharvas and Apsarases!' / 'Because you [shine] with the Ketumāla [realm] and with the Vaibhrāja forest, 34

4.195.s:
hiraṇyamayapāṣāṇastasmācchāṃtiṃ prayaccha me ..
uttaraiḥ kurubhiryasmātsāvitreṇa vanena ca .. 35 ..
4.195.d:
हिरण्यमयपाषाणस्तस्माच्छांतिं प्रयच्छ मे ॥
उत्तरैः कुरुभिर्यस्मात्सावित्रेण वनेन च ॥ 35 ॥
4.195.m: having golden boulders, therefore grant me peace!' / 'Because with the Northern Kurus and with the Sāvitra forest, 35

4.195.s:
supārśva rājase nityamataḥ śrīrakṣayāstu me ..
evamāmaṃtrya tānsarvānprabhāte vimale punaḥ .. 36 ..
4.195.d:
सुपार्श्व राजसे नित्यमतः श्रीरक्षयास्तु मे ॥
एवमामंत्र्य तान्सर्वान्प्रभाते विमले पुनः ॥ 36 ॥
4.195.m: O Supārśva, you shine eternally, therefore let my prosperity be imperishable!' / Having thus invoked them all, again at clear dawn, 36

4.195.s:
snātvā tu gurave dadyānmadhyamaṃ parvatottamam ..
śeṣāṃśca paṃca tāndadyādṛtvigbhyaḥ kramaśo nṛpa .. 37 ..
4.195.d:
स्नात्वा तु गुरवे दद्यान्मध्यमं पर्वतोत्तमम् ॥
शेषांश्च पंच तान्दद्यादृत्विग्भ्यः क्रमशो नृप ॥ 37 ॥
4.195.m: having bathed, one should give the best central mountain to the preceptor, / and the remaining five [mountains] one should give to the officiating priests in due order, O king. 37

4.195.s:
gāvo deyāścatustriṃśadathavā daśa bhārata..
śaktitaḥ sapta vāṣṭau vā evaṃ dadyādaśaktimān .. 38 ..
4.195.d:
गावो देयाश्चतुस्त्रिंशदथवा दश भारत॥
शक्तितः सप्त वाष्टौ वा एवं दद्यादशक्तिमान् ॥ 38 ॥
4.195.m: Thirty-four cows should be given, or ten, O descendant of Bharata, / or seven or eight according to one's capacity; thus should one give if lacking capacity. 38

4.195.s:
ekāpi gurave deyā kapilā supayasvinī ..
parvatānāmaśeṣāṇāmeṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ .. 39 ..
4.195.d:
एकापि गुरवे देया कपिला सुपयस्विनी ॥
पर्वतानामशेषाणामेष एव विधिः स्मृतः ॥ 39 ॥
4.195.m: Even a single brown cow yielding abundant milk should be given to the preceptor. / This alone is remembered as the rule for all the mountains. 39

4.195.s:
ya eva pūjane maṃtrāsta evopaskare tathā ..
grahāṇāṃ lokapālānāṃ brahmādīnāmagaiḥ saha .. 4.195.40 ..
4.195.d:
य एव पूजने मंत्रास्त एवोपस्करे तथा ॥
ग्रहाणां लोकपालानां ब्रह्मादीनामगैः सह ॥ 4.195.40 ॥
4.195.m: The very mantras for the worship, the same are for the furnishings, / for the planets, the world protectors, and for Brahmā and the rest along with the mountains. 40

4.195.s:
svamaṃtreṇaiva sarveṣu homaḥ śaileṣu śasyate ..
upavāsī bhavennityamaśaktau naktamiṣyate .. 41 ..
4.195.d:
स्वमंत्रेणैव सर्वेषु होमः शैलेषु शस्यते ॥
उपवासी भवेन्नित्यमशक्तौ नक्तमिष्यते ॥ 41 ॥
4.195.m: A homa with its own mantra is commended for all the mountains; / one should always remain fasting; if incapable, a nocturnal meal is approved. 41

4.195.s:
vidhānaṃ sarvaśailānāṃ kramaśaḥ śṛṇu bhārata ..
dānakāleṣu ye mantrāḥ parvateṣu ca yatphalam .. 42 ..
4.195.d:
विधानं सर्वशैलानां क्रमशः शृणु भारत ॥
दानकालेषु ये मन्त्राः पर्वतेषु च यत्फलम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.195.m: Listen, O descendant of Bharata, in due order to the rule of all the mountains, / to the mantras at the times of donation, and to the fruit regarding the mountains. 42

4.195.s:
annaṃ brahma yataḥ proktamanne prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ..
annādbhavaṃti bhūtāni jagadannena varddhate .. 43 ..
4.195.d:
अन्नं ब्रह्म यतः प्रोक्तमन्ने प्राणाः प्रतिष्ठिताः ॥
अन्नाद्भवंति भूतानि जगदन्नेन वर्द्धते ॥ 43 ॥
4.195.m: Because food is declared to be Brahman, in food the vital breaths are established; / from food beings come to be, the world prospers through food. 43

4.195.s:
annameva yato lakṣmīrannameva janārdanaḥ ..
dhānyaparvatarūpeṇa pāhi tasmānnagottama .. 44 ..
4.195.d:
अन्नमेव यतो लक्ष्मीरन्नमेव जनार्दनः ॥
धान्यपर्वतरूपेण पाहि तस्मान्नगोत्तम ॥ 44 ॥
4.195.m: Because food alone is Lakṣmī, food alone is Janārdana; / therefore protect [us] in the form of the mountain of grain, O best of mountains!' 44

4.195.s:
anena vidhinā yastu dadyāddhānyamayaṃ girim ..
manvantaraśataṃ sāgraṃ devaloke mahīyate .. 45 ..
4.195.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दद्याद्धान्यमयं गिरिम् ॥
मन्वन्तरशतं साग्रं देवलोके महीयते ॥ 45 ॥
4.195.m: He who gives a mountain of grain according to this rule / is honoured in the world of the gods for fully one hundred manvantaras. 45

4.195.s:
apsarogaṇagaṃdharvairākīrṇena virājatā ..
vimānena divaḥ pṛṣṭhe sa yāti ṛṣisevitaḥ .. 46 ..
4.195.d:
अप्सरोगणगंधर्वैराकीर्णेन विराजता ॥
विमानेन दिवः पृष्ठे स याति ऋषिसेवितः ॥ 46 ॥
4.195.m: In a radiant celestial chariot thronged with hosts of Apsarases and Gandharvas, / attended by sages, he travels upon the back of heaven. 46

4.195.s: puṇyakṣaye rājarājyamāpnotīha na saṃśayaḥ .. 47 ..
4.195.d: पुण्यक्षये राजराज्यमाप्नोतीह न संशयः ॥ 47 ॥
4.195.m: Upon the exhaustion of merit, he obtains royal sovereignty here [on earth]; of this there is no doubt. 47

4.195.s:
dhānyācalaṃ kanakavṛkṣavirājamānaṃ viṣkaṃbhaparvatayutaṃ surasiddhajuṣṭam ..
yacchaṃti ye sumatayaḥ praṇipatya viprāṃste prāpnuvaṃti parameṣṭhipadābjayugmam .. 48 .. ..
4.195.d:
धान्याचलं कनकवृक्षविराजमानं विष्कंभपर्वतयुतं सुरसिद्धजुष्टम् ॥
यच्छंति ये सुमतयः प्रणिपत्य विप्रांस्ते प्राप्नुवंति परमेष्ठिपदाब्जयुग्मम् ॥ 48 ॥ ॥
4.195.m: Those wise persons who, having bowed down to the Brahmins, give a mountain of grain / resplendent with golden trees, endowed with flanking mountains, and frequented by gods and Siddhas, reach the pair of lotus feet of the Supreme Lord. 48

4.195.s:
iti śrībhaviṣye purāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde dhānyaparvatadānavidhivarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ.. .. 195 ..
lavaṇaparvatadānavidhivarṇanam
4.195.d:
इति श्रीभविष्ये पुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे धान्यपर्वतदानविधिवर्णनं नाम पंचनवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः॥ ॥ 195 ॥
लवणपर्वतदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.195.m:
Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-fifth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Rule for the Gift of a Mountain of Grain', in the conversation between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira, in the Uttaraparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣyapurāṇa. 195
Description of the rule for the gift of a mountain of salt.

4.196.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi lavaṇācalamuttamam ..
yatpradānānnaro lokamāpnoti śivasaṃyutam ..1..
4.196.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि लवणाचलमुत्तमम् ॥
यत्प्रदानान्नरो लोकमाप्नोति शिवसंयुतम् ॥1॥
4.196.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Now therefore I shall fully describe the excellent mountain of salt, / by the giving of which a man attains the world united with Śiva. 1

4.196.s:
uttamaḥ ṣoḍaśadroṇaḥ kartabyo lavaṇācalaḥ ..
madhyamaḥ syāttadardhena tadarddhenādhamaḥ smṛtaḥ ..2..
4.196.d:
उत्तमः षोडशद्रोणः कर्तब्यो लवणाचलः ॥
मध्यमः स्यात्तदर्धेन तदर्द्धेनाधमः स्मृतः ॥2॥
4.196.m: The best mountain of salt should be made of sixteen droṇas; / the middling should be of half that, and the lowest is remembered as half of that. 2

4.196.s:
vittahīno yathāśaktyā droṇādardhaṃ tu kārayet ..
caturthāṃśena viṣayānparvatānkārayetpṛthak ..3..
4.196.d:
वित्तहीनो यथाशक्त्या द्रोणादर्धं तु कारयेत् ॥
चतुर्थांशेन विषयान्पर्वतान्कारयेत्पृथक् ॥3॥
4.196.m: A man without wealth should make it according to his capacity, down to half a droṇa; / with a fourth portion he should fashion the subsidiary flanking mountains separately. 3
One should always perform the ritual for Brahmā and the others as before; / likewise all the golden trees and the placing of the world protectors. 4

4.196.s:
śirāṃsi kāmadevādīṃstadvattatra niveśayet ..
kuryājjāgaramatrāpi dānamaṃtrānnibodha me ..5..
4.196.d:
शिरांसि कामदेवादींस्तद्वत्तत्र निवेशयेत् ॥
कुर्याज्जागरमत्रापि दानमंत्रान्निबोध मे ॥5॥
4.196.m: One should place the peaks, Kāmadeva and the others, there likewise; / one should keep vigil here too. Hear from me the donation mantras: 5

4.196.s:
saubhāgyarasasaṃbhūto yato'yaṃ lavaṇorasaḥ ..
dānātmakatvena ca māṃ pāhi pāpānnagottama .. 6 ..
4.196.d:
सौभाग्यरससंभूतो यतोऽयं लवणोरसः ॥
दानात्मकत्वेन च मां पाहि पापान्नगोत्तम ॥ 6 ॥
4.196.m: "Because this saline essence is born from the essence of auspicious fortune, / and because you are in the form of a gift, protect me from sin, O best of mountains! 6

4.196.s:
tasmādannarasāḥ sarve notkṛṣṭā lavaṇaṃ vinā ..
priyaṃ ca śivayornityaṃ tasmākchāṃtiprado bhava ..7..
4.196.d:
तस्मादन्नरसाः सर्वे नोत्कृष्टा लवणं विना ॥
प्रियं च शिवयोर्नित्यं तस्माक्छांतिप्रदो भव ॥7॥
4.196.m: Therefore, all the flavours of food are not superior without salt, / and it is eternally dear to Śiva and Śivā; therefore be a granter of peace! 7

4.196.s:
viṣṇudeha samudbhūtaṃ yasmādārogyavardhanam ..
yasmātparvatarūpeṇa pāhi saṃsārasāgarāt .. 8 ..
4.196.d:
विष्णुदेह समुद्भूतं यस्मादारोग्यवर्धनम् ॥
यस्मात्पर्वतरूपेण पाहि संसारसागरात् ॥ 8 ॥
4.196.m: Because [salt] arose from the body of Viṣṇu, promoting health, / and because [you stand] in the form of a mountain, protect [me] from the ocean of worldly existence!" 8

4.196.s:
anena vidhinā yastu dadyāllavaṇaparvatam ..
umāloke vasetkalpaṃ tato yāti parāṃ gatim .. 9 ..
4.196.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दद्याल्लवणपर्वतम् ॥
उमालोके वसेत्कल्पं ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.196.m: He who gives a mountain of salt according to this rule / dwells in the world of Umā for an aeon; thence he goes to the supreme state. 9

4.196.s:
puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ..
putrapautraiḥ parivṛto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam .. 4.196.10 ..
4.196.d:
पुण्यक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ॥
पुत्रपौत्रैः परिवृतो जीवेच्च शरदां शतम् ॥ 4.196.10 ॥
4.196.m: Coming here upon the exhaustion of merit, he becomes a righteous king; / surrounded by sons and grandsons, he shall live for a hundred autumns. 10

4.196.s:
kurvaṃti ye lavaṇa parvatasaṃpradānaṃ saṃprāpnuvaṃti divi te sumahadvimānam ..
tatrāpsarogaṇasurāsurasevyamānāstiṣṭhaṃti hṛṣṭamanaso divi vṛddhamānāḥ .. 11 .. ..
guḍācaladānavidhivarṇanam
4.196.d:
कुर्वंति ये लवण पर्वतसंप्रदानं संप्राप्नुवंति दिवि ते सुमहद्विमानम् ॥
तत्राप्सरोगणसुरासुरसेव्यमानास्तिष्ठंति हृष्टमनसो दिवि वृद्धमानाः ॥ 11 ॥ ॥
गुडाचलदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.196.m:
Those who perform the gift of a mountain of salt obtain a magnificent celestial chariot in heaven; / served there by hosts of Apsarases, gods, and Asuras, they remain joyful in mind, exalted in heaven. 11
Description of the rule for the gift of a mountain of molasses.

4.197.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi guḍaparvatamuttamam ..
yatpradānānnaraḥ svargaṃ prāpnoti surapūjitam .. 1 ..
4.197.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि गुडपर्वतमुत्तमम् ॥
यत्प्रदानान्नरः स्वर्गं प्राप्नोति सुरपूजितम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.197.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
After this I shall explain the highest mountain of molasses,
by giving which a man attains heaven honoured by the gods.

4.197.s:
uttamo daśabhirbhāraiḥ madhyamaḥ paṃcabhistathā ..
tribhirbhāraiḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ syāttadarddhenālpako mataḥ .. 2 ..
4.197.d:
उत्तमो दशभिर्भारैः मध्यमः पंचभिस्तथा ॥
त्रिभिर्भारैः कनिष्ठः स्यात्तदर्द्धेनाल्पको मतः ॥ 2 ॥
4.197.m:
The highest is made of ten bhāras, the intermediate of five,
the lowest consists of three bhāras, and half of that is considered small.

4.197.s:
tadvadāmaṃtraṇaṃ pūjāṃ hemavṛkṣasurārcanam ..
viṣkaṃbhaparvatāstatra sarāṃsi vanadevatāḥ .. 3 ..
4.197.d:
तद्वदामंत्रणं पूजां हेमवृक्षसुरार्चनम् ॥
विष्कंभपर्वतास्तत्र सरांसि वनदेवताः ॥ 3 ॥
4.197.m:
Likewise, the invitation, the worship, the adoration of the golden trees and the gods,
the auxiliary mountains there, the lakes, the forest deities,

4.197.s:
homaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ tadvallokapālādhivāsanam ..
dhānyaparvatavatkuryādimaṃ maṃtramudīrayet .. 4 ..
4.197.d:
होमं जागरणं तद्वल्लोकपालाधिवासनम् ॥
धान्यपर्वतवत्कुर्यादिमं मंत्रमुदीरयेत् ॥ 4 ॥
4.197.m:
the fire-offering, the night-vigil, and similarly the preliminary consecration of the world protectors,
one should perform as for the mountain of grain, and recite this mantra:

4.197.s:
yathā deveṣu viśvātmā pravaroyaṃ janārdanaḥ ..
sāmavedastu vedānāṃ mahādevastu yoginām .. 5 ..
4.197.d:
यथा देवेषु विश्वात्मा प्रवरोयं जनार्दनः ॥
सामवेदस्तु वेदानां महादेवस्तु योगिनाम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.197.m:
"Just as among the gods this Janārdana, the soul of the universe, is supreme,
as the Sāmaveda is among the Vedas, and Mahādeva among yogins,

4.197.s:
praṇavaḥ sarvamaṃtrāṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ pārvatī yathā ..
tathā rasānāṃ pravaraḥ sadā cekṣuraso mataḥ .. 6 ..
4.197.d:
प्रणवः सर्वमंत्राणां नारीणां पार्वती यथा ॥
तथा रसानां प्रवरः सदा चेक्षुरसो मतः ॥ 6 ॥
4.197.m:
as the praṇava is among all mantras, and Pārvatī among women,
even so sugarcane juice is always considered supreme among essences.

4.197.s:
mama tasmātparāṃ lakṣmīṃ prayaccha guḍaparvata ..
surāsurāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ nāgayakṣarkṣayaṃtriṇām .. 7 ..
4.197.d:
मम तस्मात्परां लक्ष्मीं प्रयच्छ गुडपर्वत ॥
सुरासुराणां सर्वेषां नागयक्षर्क्षयंत्रिणाम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.197.m:
Therefore, O mountain of molasses, grant me supreme fortune!
From all the gods and asuras, serpents, yakṣas, bears, and sorcerers,

4.197.s:
vināśaścāpi pārvatyāstasmānmāṃ pāhi sarvadā ..
anena vidhinā yastu dadyādguḍamayaṃ girim .. 8 ..
4.197.d:
विनाशश्चापि पार्वत्यास्तस्मान्मां पाहि सर्वदा ॥
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दद्याद्गुडमयं गिरिम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.197.m:
and from destruction, O mountain [dear to] Pārvatī, protect me always!"
One who gives a mountain made of molasses according to this rule,

4.197.s:
saṃpūjyamāno gaṃdharvairgauṃrīloke mahīyate ..
punaḥ kalpaśatāṃte tu saptadvīpādhipo bhavet .. 9 ..
4.197.d:
संपूज्यमानो गंधर्वैर्गौंरीलोके महीयते ॥
पुनः कल्पशतांते तु सप्तद्वीपाधिपो भवेत् ॥ 9 ॥
4.197.m:
being honoured by the gandharvas, is exalted in the realm of Gaurī;
then, at the end of a hundred kalpas, he becomes ruler of the seven continents,

4.197.s:
āyurārogyasaṃpannaḥ śatrubhiścāparājitaḥ ..
āsīdrājñī mahābhāgā sulabhā nāma suvratā .. 4.197.10 ..
4.197.d:
आयुरारोग्यसंपन्नः शत्रुभिश्चापराजितः ॥
आसीद्राज्ञी महाभागा सुलभा नाम सुव्रता ॥ 4.197.10 ॥
4.197.m:
endowed with long life and good health, and undefeated by enemies.
There was a highly fortunate queen named Sulabhā, faithful to her vows,

4.197.s:
maruttasya priyā bhāryā rūpa yauvanaśālinī ..
tasya bhāryā śatānyāsansapta rājño mahātmanaḥ .. 11 ..
4.197.d:
मरुत्तस्य प्रिया भार्या रूप यौवनशालिनी ॥
तस्य भार्या शतान्यासन्सप्त राज्ञो महात्मनः ॥ 11 ॥
4.197.m:
the beloved wife of Marutta, endowed with beauty and youth.
That noble king had seven hundred wives;

4.197.s:
tā dāsya iva vākyāni kuryustasyāḥ sadaiva hi ..
mukhāvalokanakaro rājā tasya ca sā priyā .. 12 ..
4.197.d:
ता दास्य इव वाक्यानि कुर्युस्तस्याः सदैव हि ॥
मुखावलोकनकरो राजा तस्य च सा प्रिया ॥ 12 ॥
4.197.m:
they always obeyed her commands like handmaids;
the king constantly gazed upon her face, and she was dear to him.

4.197.s:
atha kālena mahatā durvāsā ṛṣisattamaḥ ..
ājagāma tadabhyāśaṃ bhramamāṇo yadṛcchayā .. 13 ..
4.197.d:
अथ कालेन महता दुर्वासा ऋषिसत्तमः ॥
आजगाम तदभ्याशं भ्रममाणो यदृच्छया ॥ 13 ॥
4.197.m:
Then, after a long time, the best of sages, Durvāsas,
came near her, wandering of his own free will.

4.197.s:
tasyātha satkriyāṃ kṛttvā dattvā cārghaṃ yathāvidhi ..
papraccha sulabhā vipraṃ durvāsasamakalmaṣam .. 14 ..
4.197.d:
तस्याथ सत्क्रियां कृत्त्वा दत्त्वा चार्घं यथाविधि ॥
पप्रच्छ सुलभा विप्रं दुर्वाससमकल्मषम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.197.m:
Having rendered hospitality to him and offered arghya according to the rule,
Sulabhā questioned the stainless brāhmaṇa Durvāsas.

4.197.s:
.. sulabhovāca .. ..
kena puṇyena bhagavanmama rājā priyaṃkaraḥ ..
mukhāvalokanaparo vaśe tiṣṭhati sarvadā .. 15 .. ..
4.197.d:
॥ सुलभोवाच ॥ ॥
केन पुण्येन भगवन्मम राजा प्रियंकरः ॥
मुखावलोकनपरो वशे तिष्ठति सर्वदा ॥ 15 ॥ ॥
4.197.m:
Sulabhā said:
"By what merit, O lord, is the king affectionate to me,
always intent on gazing at my face, and continually in my power?

4.197.s:
sapatnyaśca mama brahmansadā priyahite ratāḥ ..
etadācakṣva bhagavanparaṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ..16..
4.197.d:
सपत्न्यश्च मम ब्रह्मन्सदा प्रियहिते रताः ॥
एतदाचक्ष्व भगवन्परं कौतूहलं मम ॥16॥
4.197.m:
And why, O brāhmaṇa, are my co-wives always devoted to doing what is pleasing and beneficial to me?
Tell me this, O lord; great is my curiosity."

4.197.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
śṛṇuṣvāvahitā subhrūrātmavṛttaṃ purātanam ..
jānāmi sarvaṃ subhage tava vṛttamaśeṣataḥ .. 17 ..
4.197.d:
॥ दुर्वासा उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणुष्वावहिता सुभ्रूरात्मवृत्तं पुरातनम् ॥
जानामि सर्वं सुभगे तव वृत्तमशेषतः ॥ 17 ॥

4.197.s:
tvamāsīrvaiśya mahiṣī girivrajapure purā ..
dhārmikā satyaśīlā ca pativrataparāyaṇā .. 18 ..
4.197.d:
त्वमासीर्वैश्य महिषी गिरिव्रजपुरे पुरा ॥
धार्मिका सत्यशीला च पतिव्रतपरायणा ॥ 18 ॥
4.197.m:
In the past, you were the chief wife of a vaiśya in the city of Girivraja,
virtuous, truthful in character, and devoted to your husband.

4.197.s:
tatra śrutastvayā vatse brāhmaṇānāṃ samīpataḥ ..
purā dānavidhiḥ kṛtsnaḥ sthitayā patisaṃnidhau .. 19 ..
4.197.d:
तत्र श्रुतस्त्वया वत्से ब्राह्मणानां समीपतः ॥
पुरा दानविधिः कृत्स्नः स्थितया पतिसंनिधौ ॥ 19 ॥
4.197.m:
There, O child, while staying by your husband's side, you heard
the whole rule for gifts in the presence of brāhmaṇas.

4.197.s:
viśeṣatastatra vipraiḥ kathito guḍaparvataḥ ..
dattaścāpi tvayā putri saṃbhṛtya vidhivattadā .. 4.197.20 ..
4.197.d:
विशेषतस्तत्र विप्रैः कथितो गुडपर्वतः ॥
दत्तश्चापि त्वया पुत्रि संभृत्य विधिवत्तदा ॥ 4.197.20 ॥
4.197.m:
In particular, the mountain of molasses was described there by the brāhmaṇas;
and having assembled [the materials] properly at that time, O daughter, you gave it.

4.197.s:
tasya dānasya māhātmyāttvayā bhuktaṃ varānane ..
rājyaṃ janmāni catvāri niḥsapatnamanākulam .. 21 ..
4.197.d:
तस्य दानस्य माहात्म्यात्त्वया भुक्तं वरानने ॥
राज्यं जन्मानि चत्वारि निःसपत्नमनाकुलम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.197.m:
Through the majesty of that gift, O fair-faced lady,
you enjoyed sovereignty for four births, free from rivals and untroubled.

4.197.s:
anyāni sapta janmāni tava rājyaṃ bhaviṣyati ..
saubhāgyamatulaṃ caiva rūpamārogyameva ca .. 22 ..
4.197.d:
अन्यानि सप्त जन्मानि तव राज्यं भविष्यति ॥
सौभाग्यमतुलं चैव रूपमारोग्यमेव च ॥ 22 ॥
4.197.m:
For another seven births you will possess sovereignty,
unrivalled good fortune, beauty, and good health.

4.197.s:
bhūtaṃ caivamavaśyaṃ ca guḍaparvatadānajam ..
kathā tava varārohe yāsye tvaṃ bhava pu triṇī .. 23 ..
4.197.d:
भूतं चैवमवश्यं च गुडपर्वतदानजम् ॥
कथा तव वरारोहे यास्ये त्वं भव पु त्रिणी ॥ 23 ॥
4.197.m:
Such is the inescapable result born of giving the mountain of molasses.
Such is your story, O fair-hipped lady; I shall depart; may you have sons!"

4.197.s:
tasmāddeyamidaṃ dānaṃ phalamuttamamicchatā ..
gatiṃ ca śāśvatīṃ lebhe saubhāgyaṃ rūpameva ca .. 24 ..
4.197.d:
तस्माद्देयमिदं दानं फलमुत्तममिच्छता ॥
गतिं च शाश्वतीं लेभे सौभाग्यं रूपमेव च ॥ 24 ॥
4.197.m:
Therefore, this gift should be given by one who desires the highest reward;
and she attained the eternal path, good fortune, and beauty.

4.197.s:
dānametatpraśaṃsaṃti strīṇāṃ rāja nviśeṣataḥ ..
pūrvoktaṃ ca phalaṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyo'bhijāyate .. 25 ..
4.197.d:
दानमेतत्प्रशंसंति स्त्रीणां राज न्विशेषतः ॥
पूर्वोक्तं च फलं प्राप्य कृतकृत्योऽभिजायते ॥ 25 ॥
4.197.m:
They praise this gift especially for women, O king;
and having obtained the previously mentioned fruit, one becomes fulfilled.

4.197.s:
kṛṣṇeṣṭasuṃdaradarīsravaṇākulena gaṃdharvasiddhavanitāśatasevitena ..
dattena bhārata vidhānavatā sadaiva gaurī prasādamupayāti guḍācalena .. 26 .. ..
hemācaladānavidhivarṇanam
4.197.d:
कृष्णेष्टसुंदरदरीस्रवणाकुलेन गंधर्वसिद्धवनिताशतसेवितेन ॥
दत्तेन भारत विधानवता सदैव गौरी प्रसादमुपयाति गुडाचलेन ॥ 26 ॥ ॥
हेमाचलदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.197.m:
When given properly according to rule, O descendant of Bharata, by means of that mountain of molasses,
filled with charming caves and flowing streams pleasing to Kṛṣṇa, and attended by hundreds of women of the gandharvas and siddhas, Gaurī is always pleased.
Description of the Rule for the Gift of the Mountain of Gold

4.198.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
atha pāpaharaṃ vakṣye suvarṇācalamuttamam ..
yasya prasādādbhavanaṃ vairicyaṃ yāti mānavaḥ .. 1 ..
4.198.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अथ पापहरं वक्ष्ये सुवर्णाचलमुत्तमम् ॥
यस्य प्रसादाद्भवनं वैरिच्यं याति मानवः ॥ 1 ॥
4.198.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Now I shall explain the highest mountain of gold, which removes sins,
by the grace of which a human being goes to the abode of Brahmā.

4.198.s:
uttamaḥ palasāhasro madhyamaḥ pañcabhiḥ śataiḥ ..
tadarddhenāvarastadvadalpavitto'pi śaktitaḥ .. .. 2..
4.198.d:
उत्तमः पलसाहस्रो मध्यमः पञ्चभिः शतैः ॥
तदर्द्धेनावरस्तद्वदल्पवित्तोऽपि शक्तितः ॥ ॥ 2॥
4.198.m:
The highest is made of a thousand palas, the intermediate of five hundred,
the lowest of half that; and one of small means [may give] according to his ability.

The wise man should give upwards of one pala, according to his capacity;
one should perform everything just like the mountain of grain, O best of kings.

4.198.s:
viṣkaṃbhaśailāṃstadvacca kṛtvā maṃtramudīrayet ..
namaste brahmabījāya brahmagarbhāya vai namaḥ .. 4 ..
4.198.d:
विष्कंभशैलांस्तद्वच्च कृत्वा मंत्रमुदीरयेत् ॥
नमस्ते ब्रह्मबीजाय ब्रह्मगर्भाय वै नमः ॥ 4 ॥
4.198.m:
Likewise, having made the auxiliary mountains, one should recite the mantra:
"Homage to you, the seed of Brahmā! Homage indeed to the womb of Brahmā!

4.198.s:
yasmādanaṃtaphaladastasmātpāhi śiloccaya ..
yasmādagnerapatyaṃ tvaṃ yasmādulba jagatpateḥ .. 5 ..
4.198.d:
यस्मादनंतफलदस्तस्मात्पाहि शिलोच्चय ॥
यस्मादग्नेरपत्यं त्वं यस्मादुल्ब जगत्पतेः ॥ 5 ॥
4.198.m:
Since you bestow endless fruit, therefore protect [me], O mountain!
Since you are the offspring of Fire, since [you are] the matrix of the Lord of the World,

4.198.s:
hemaparvatarūpeṇa tasmātpāhi nagottama ..
anena vidhinā yastu dadyātkanakaparvatam .. 6 ..
4.198.d:
हेमपर्वतरूपेण तस्मात्पाहि नगोत्तम ॥
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दद्यात्कनकपर्वतम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.198.m:
therefore in the form of a mountain of gold protect [me], O best of mountains!"
One who gives a mountain of gold according to this rule,

4.198.s:
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ ..
tatra varṣaśataṃ tiṣṭhettato yāti parāṃ gatim.. 7 ..
4.198.d:
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो महेश्वरः ॥
तत्र वर्षशतं तिष्ठेत्ततो याति परां गतिम्॥ 7 ॥
4.198.m:
goes to the supreme abode where the god Maheśvara resides;
he stays there for a hundred years, and from there goes to the highest state.
No other gift anywhere is superior to the mountain of gold.

4.198.s:
haimaṃ mahīṃdramaṇiśṛṃgaśatairupetaṃ lokādhipāṣṭakayutaṃ sahitaṃ munīndraiḥ ..
yaḥ śaktimānvitaratīha gaṇeśaloke kalpaṃ kumāravadasau kurupuṃgavā''ste .. 9 .. ..
tilācaladānavidhivarṇanam
4.198.d:
हैमं महींद्रमणिशृंगशतैरुपेतं लोकाधिपाष्टकयुतं सहितं मुनीन्द्रैः ॥
यः शक्तिमान्वितरतीह गणेशलोके कल्पं कुमारवदसौ कुरुपुंगवा'ऽस्ते ॥ 9 ॥ ॥
तिलाचलदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.198.m:
The capable person who gives here this golden [mountain]—furnished with hundreds of jewelled peaks, endowed with the eight world protectors, and accompanied by the great sages—
dwells in the realm of Gaṇeśa for a kalpa like Kumāra, O bull of the Kurus.
Description of the Rule for the Gift of the Mountain of Sesame

4.199.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tilaśailaṃ vidhānataḥ ..
yatpradānānnaro yāti viṣṇulokamanuttamam .. 1 ..
4.199.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि तिलशैलं विधानतः ॥
यत्प्रदानान्नरो याति विष्णुलोकमनुत्तमम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.199.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
After this I shall explain the mountain of sesame according to rule,
by giving which a man goes to the unexcelled realm of Viṣṇu.

4.199.s:
tilāḥ pavitramatulaṃ pavitrāṇāṃ ca pāvanam ..
viṣṇudehasamudbhūtāstasmāduttamatāṃ gatāḥ .. 2 ..
4.199.d:
तिलाः पवित्रमतुलं पवित्राणां च पावनम् ॥
विष्णुदेहसमुद्भूतास्तस्मादुत्तमतां गताः ॥ 2 ॥
4.199.m:
Sesame seeds are incomparably pure and the purifier of purifiers;
they arose from the body of Viṣṇu, and for that reason attained supreme excellence.

4.199.s:
madhukaiṭabhanāmānāvāstāṃ ditisutau purā ..
madhunā saha tatrābhūdyuddhaṃ viṣṇoranāratam .. 3 ..
4.199.d:
मधुकैटभनामानावास्तां दितिसुतौ पुरा ॥
मधुना सह तत्राभूद्युद्धं विष्णोरनारतम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.199.m:
Formerly there were two sons of Diti named Madhu and Kaiṭabha;
there an incessant battle took place between Viṣṇu and Madhu.

4.199.s:
sahasraṃ kila varṣāṇāṃ na vyajīvata dānavaḥ ..
tatra svedo mahānāsītkruddhasyātha gadābhṛtaḥ .. 4 ..
4.199.d:
सहस्रं किल वर्षाणां न व्यजीवत दानवः ॥
तत्र स्वेदो महानासीत्क्रुद्धस्याथ गदाभृतः ॥ 4 ॥
4.199.m:
Indeed, for a thousand years the dānava did not lose his life;
then great sweat arose upon the enraged Wielder of the Mace.

4.199.s:
patitaśca dharāpṛṣṭhe kaṇaśo lavaśastathā ..
samuttasthustilā māṣāḥ kuśāśca kurunaṃdana .. 5 ..
4.199.d:
पतितश्च धरापृष्ठे कणशो लवशस्तथा ॥
समुत्तस्थुस्तिला माषाः कुशाश्च कुरुनंदन ॥ 5 ॥
4.199.m:
And as it fell on the surface of the earth in drops and tiny pieces,
sesame seeds, beans, and kuśa grass arose, O joy of the Kurus.

4.199.s:
hataśca hariṇā yuddhe sa madhurbalināṃ varaḥ ..
medasā tasya vasudhā raṃjitā sakalā tadā .. 6 ..
4.199.d:
हतश्च हरिणा युद्धे स मधुर्बलिनां वरः ॥
मेदसा तस्य वसुधा रंजिता सकला तदा ॥ 6 ॥
4.199.m: And that Madhu, best among the mighty, was slain in battle by Hari; / the entire earth was then stained with his fat.

4.199.s:
medinīti tataḥ saṃjñāmavāpācala dhāriṇī ..
hate'tha daityapravare devāstoṣaṃ paraṃ yayuḥ .. 7 ..
4.199.d:
मेदिनीति ततः संज्ञामवापाचल धारिणी ॥
हतेऽथ दैत्यप्रवरे देवास्तोषं परं ययुः ॥ 7 ॥
4.199.m: From that the bearer of mountains acquired the name Medinī. / When that foremost among Daityas was slain, the gods felt supreme joy.

4.199.s:
stutibhiśca paraṃ stutvā ūcustridaśapuṃgavam ..
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
tvayā dhṛtaṃ jagaddeva tvayā sṛṣṭaṃ tathaiva ca .. 8 ..
4.199.d:
स्तुतिभिश्च परं स्तुत्वा ऊचुस्त्रिदशपुंगवम् ॥
॥ देवा ऊचुः ॥ ॥
त्वया धृतं जगद्देव त्वया सृष्टं तथैव च ॥ 8 ॥
4.199.m: And having praised the best of the thirty [gods] with hymns of praise, they said: / The gods said: / By you the world is maintained, O God, and likewise created by you.

4.199.s:
tvayīśa līyate sarvaṃ tvayaiva madhusūdana ..
tasmāttvadaṃgato jātāstilāḥ saṃtu jagaddhitāḥ .. 9 ..
4.199.d:
त्वयीश लीयते सर्वं त्वयैव मधुसूदन ॥
तस्मात्त्वदंगतो जातास्तिलाः संतु जगद्धिताः ॥ 9 ॥
4.199.m: In you, O Lord, everything dissolves, by you alone, O Madhusūdana. / Therefore let sesame seeds, born from your body, be beneficial to the world,

4.199.s:
pālayaṃtu ca deveśa havyakavyāni sarvadā ..
daive pitrye ca satataṃ niyojyāstatparairnaraiḥ .. 4.199.10 ..
4.199.d:
पालयंतु च देवेश हव्यकव्यानि सर्वदा ॥
दैवे पित्र्ये च सततं नियोज्यास्तत्परैर्नरैः ॥ 4.199.10 ॥
4.199.m: and let them always protect the oblations to gods and ancestors, O Lord of gods. / They should constantly be employed by dedicated men in rites for gods and ancestors.

4.199.s:
nahi daityāḥ piśācā vā vipraṃ kurvaṃti bhārata ..
tilā yatropayujyaṃte etacchīghraṃ vidhīyatām .. 11 ..
4.199.d:
नहि दैत्याः पिशाचा वा विप्रं कुर्वंति भारत ॥
तिला यत्रोपयुज्यंते एतच्छीघ्रं विधीयताम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.199.m: Indeed, neither Daityas nor piśācas obstruct a Brahmin, O descendant of Bharata, / wherever sesame seeds are used. Let this quickly be decreed.

4.199.s:
śrutvā surāṇāṃ tadvākyaṃ viṣṇustānidamabravīt ..
tilā bhavantu rakṣārthaṃ trayāṇāṃ jagatāmapi .. 12 ..
4.199.d:
श्रुत्वा सुराणां तद्वाक्यं विष्णुस्तानिदमब्रवीत् ॥
तिला भवन्तु रक्षार्थं त्रयाणां जगतामपि ॥ 12 ॥
4.199.m: Having heard those words of the gods, Viṣṇu spoke this to them: / "Let sesame seeds serve for the protection even of the three worlds.

4.199.s:
śuklapakṣe tu devānāṃ saṃpradadyāttilodakam ..
kṛṣṇapakṣe pitṝṇāṃ ca snātvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ .. 13 ..
4.199.d:
शुक्लपक्षे तु देवानां संप्रदद्यात्तिलोदकम् ॥
कृष्णपक्षे पितॄणां च स्नात्वा श्रद्धासमन्वितः ॥ 13 ॥
4.199.m: In the bright fortnight, having bathed and being endowed with faith, / one should offer water with sesame seeds to the gods, and in the dark fortnight to the ancestors.

4.199.s:
tilaiḥ saptāṣṭabhirvāpi samarpitajalāṃjaliḥ ..
tasya devāḥ sapitarastṛptā yacchaṃti śobhanam .. 14 ..
4.199.d:
तिलैः सप्ताष्टभिर्वापि समर्पितजलांजलिः ॥
तस्य देवाः सपितरस्तृप्ता यच्छंति शोभनम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.199.m: To him who has offered a cavity of hands filled with water, or with seven or eight sesame seeds, / the gods together with the ancestors, being satisfied, grant auspiciousness.

4.199.s:
śvakākopahataṃ yacca patitādibhireva ca ..
tilairabhyukṣitaṃ sarvaṃ pavitraṃ syānna saṃśayaḥ .. 15 ..
4.199.d:
श्वकाकोपहतं यच्च पतितादिभिरेव च ॥
तिलैरभ्युक्षितं सर्वं पवित्रं स्यान्न संशयः ॥ 15 ॥
4.199.m: And whatever is defiled by dogs and crows, or even by outcasts and the like, / everything sprinkled with sesame seeds becomes pure; there is no doubt.

4.199.s:
etairmṛtaistilairyastu kṛtvā parvatamuttamam ..
pradadyāddvijamukhyāya dānaṃ tasyākṣayaṃ bhavet .. 16 ..
4.199.d:
एतैर्मृतैस्तिलैर्यस्तु कृत्वा पर्वतमुत्तमम् ॥
प्रदद्याद्द्विजमुख्याय दानं तस्याक्षयं भवेत् ॥ 16 ॥
4.199.m: Whoever, having fashioned an excellent mountain with these collected sesame seeds, / gives it to a foremost twice-born, his gift becomes inexhaustible.

4.199.s:
uttamo daśabhirdroṇairmadhyamaḥ paṃcabhirmataḥ ..
tribhiḥ kaniṣṭho rājendra tilaśailaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 17 ..
4.199.d:
उत्तमो दशभिर्द्रोणैर्मध्यमः पंचभिर्मतः ॥
त्रिभिः कनिष्ठो राजेन्द्र तिलशैलः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 17 ॥
4.199.m: The best mountain of sesame seeds is taught to consist of ten droṇas, the middle of five, / and the lowest of three, O king of kings.

4.199.s:
pūrvavaccāparaṃ sarvaṃ viṣkaṃbhaparvatādikam ..
dānamannaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvannṛpasattama .. 18 ..
4.199.d:
पूर्ववच्चापरं सर्वं विष्कंभपर्वतादिकम् ॥
दानमन्नं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथावन्नृपसत्तम ॥ 18 ॥
4.199.m: Everything else, such as the peripheral mountains, is as before; / I shall declare the gift of food according to rule, O best of kings.

4.199.s:
yasmānmadhuvadhe viṣṇordehasvedasamudbhavāḥ ..
tilāḥ kuśāśca māṣāśca tasmācchaṃ no bhavatviha .. 19 ..
4.199.d:
यस्मान्मधुवधे विष्णोर्देहस्वेदसमुद्भवाः ॥
तिलाः कुशाश्च माषाश्च तस्माच्छं नो भवत्विह ॥ 19 ॥
4.199.m: 'Since in the slaying of Madhu, sesame seeds, kuśa grass, and māṣa beans / were born from the sweat of Viṣṇu's body, therefore let there be welfare for us here.

4.199.s:
havye kavye ca yasmācca tilairevābhimaṃtraṇam ..
bhavāduddhara śaileṃdra tilācala namo'stu te .. 4.199.20 ..
4.199.d:
हव्ये कव्ये च यस्माच्च तिलैरेवाभिमंत्रणम् ॥
भवादुद्धर शैलेंद्र तिलाचल नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 4.199.20 ॥
4.199.m: And since consecration in rites for gods and ancestors is performed only with sesame seeds, / deliver [us] from worldly existence, O king of mountains! O mountain of sesame seeds, homage to you!'

4.199.s:
ityāmaṃtrya ca yo dadyāttilācalamanuttamam ..
sa vaiṣṇavaṃ padaṃ yāti punarāvṛttidurlabham .. 21 ..
4.199.d:
इत्यामंत्र्य च यो दद्यात्तिलाचलमनुत्तमम् ॥
स वैष्णवं पदं याति पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.199.m: Having recited this, whoever gives the unexcelled mountain of sesame seeds / goes to the realm of Viṣṇu, from which return is hard to attain.

4.199.s:
dīrghāyuṣṭvamavāpnoti iha loke paratra ca ..
pitṛbhirdevagandharvaiḥ pūjyamāno divaṃ vrajet .. 22 ..
4.199.d:
दीर्घायुष्ट्वमवाप्नोति इह लोके परत्र च ॥
पितृभिर्देवगन्धर्वैः पूज्यमानो दिवं व्रजेत् ॥ 22 ॥
4.199.m: He attains longevity in this world and in the next; / being worshipped by the ancestors, gods, and gandharvas, he goes to heaven.

4.199.s:
puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ..
nārī vā tasya patnī syādrūpasaubhāgyasaṃyutā .. 23 ..
4.199.d:
पुण्यक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ॥
नारी वा तस्य पत्नी स्याद्रूपसौभाग्यसंयुता ॥ 23 ॥
4.199.m: When his merit is exhausted, returning here he becomes a righteous king; / or a woman [who gives this] becomes his wife endowed with beauty and good fortune,

4.199.s:
dakṣā kulodbhavā caiva putrapautrasamanvitā ..
vidhānamidamākarṇya vidhinā śraddhayānvitaḥ .. 24 ..
4.199.d:
दक्षा कुलोद्भवा चैव पुत्रपौत्रसमन्विता ॥
विधानमिदमाकर्ण्य विधिना श्रद्धयान्वितः ॥ 24 ॥
4.199.m: skilful, of noble family, and endowed with sons and grandsons. / Having listened to this rite and endowed with faith according to rule,

4.199.s: kapilādānapuṇyasya samaṃ phalamavāpnuyāt .. 25 ..
4.199.d: कपिलादानपुण्यस्य समं फलमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 25 ॥
4.199.m: one obtains a fruit equal to the merit of the gift of a brown cow.

4.199.s:
dānaṃ tilācalasamaṃ yadi cānyadasti tadbhūta śāstranicayaṃ pravicārya buddhyā ..
yairvarjitā pitṛkriyā na ca homakarma teṣāṃ pradānamiha kiṃ na karoti śarma .. 26 .. ..
kārpāsācaladānavidhivarṇanam
4.199.d:
दानं तिलाचलसमं यदि चान्यदस्ति तद्भूत शास्त्रनिचयं प्रविचार्य बुद्ध्या ॥
यैर्वर्जिता पितृक्रिया न च होमकर्म तेषां प्रदानमिह किं न करोति शर्म ॥ 26 ॥ ॥
कार्पासाचलदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.199.m:
If there is any other gift equal to the mountain of sesame seeds, having carefully considered that mass of scriptures with the intellect, [one sees:] / for those who have abandoned ancestral rites and the performance of fire-oblations, what joy does this gift not produce here?
Description of the Procedure for the Gift of the Mountain of Cotton

4.200.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kārpāsācalamuttamam ..
paramaṃ sarvadānānāṃ priyaṃ sarvadivaukasām .. 1 ..
4.200.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि कार्पासाचलमुत्तमम् ॥
परमं सर्वदानानां प्रियं सर्वदिवौकसाम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.200.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Hereafter I shall declare the excellent mountain of cotton, / supreme among all gifts, dear to all the dwellers of heaven.

4.200.s:
deśakālau samāsādya dhanaṃ śraddhāṃ ca yatnataḥ ..
deyametanmahādānaṃ kuloddharaṇahetave .. 2 ..
4.200.d:
देशकालौ समासाद्य धनं श्रद्धां च यत्नतः ॥
देयमेतन्महादानं कुलोद्धरणहेतवे ॥ 2 ॥
4.200.m: Taking into account place and time, wealth and faith with diligence, / this great gift should be given for the sake of the deliverance of one's family.

4.200.s:
pūrvoktena vidhānena kṛtvā sarvamaśeṣataḥ ..
parvataṃ kalpayettatra kārpāsena vidhānataḥ .. 3 ..
4.200.d:
पूर्वोक्तेन विधानेन कृत्वा सर्वमशेषतः ॥
पर्वतं कल्पयेत्तत्र कार्पासेन विधानतः ॥ 3 ॥
4.200.m: Having done everything in its entirety according to the previously stated procedure, / one should fashion a mountain there out of cotton according to rule.

4.200.s:
viṃśadbhārastu kartavya uttamaḥ parvato budhaiḥ ..
daśabhirmadhyamaḥ prokto jaghanyaḥ paṃcabhirmataḥ .. 4 ..
4.200.d:
विंशद्भारस्तु कर्तव्य उत्तमः पर्वतो बुधैः ॥
दशभिर्मध्यमः प्रोक्तो जघन्यः पंचभिर्मतः ॥ 4 ॥
4.200.m: The best mountain should be made by the wise with twenty bhāras; / the middle is declared to be of ten, and the lowest is considered to be of five.
One possessing little wealth, free from financial deceit, may give one of a single bhāra. / Having procured everything as in the case of the grain mountain, O best of kings,

4.200.s:
tadvajjāgaraṇaṃ kuryāttadvaccaivādhivāsanam ..
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāmimaṃ mantramudīrayet .. 6 ..
4.200.d:
तद्वज्जागरणं कुर्यात्तद्वच्चैवाधिवासनम् ॥
प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यामिमं मन्त्रमुदीरयेत् ॥ 6 ॥
4.200.m: one should keep a night-vigil in the same manner, and perform preliminary consecration in the same manner. / Then, when the night has turned to dawn, one should utter this mantra:

4.200.s:
tvamevāvaraṇaṃ yasmāllokānāmiha sarvadā ..
kārpāsācala nastasmādaghaughadhvaṃsano bhava .. 7 ..
4.200.d:
त्वमेवावरणं यस्माल्लोकानामिह सर्वदा ॥
कार्पासाचल नस्तस्मादघौघध्वंसनो भव ॥ 7 ॥
4.200.m: 'Since you are indeed always the covering for the worlds here, / therefore, O mountain of cotton, be the destroyer of the mass of our sins!'

4.200.s:
iti kārpāsaśailendraṃ yo dadyātparvasaṃnidhau ..
rudraloke vasetkalpaṃ tato rājā bhavediha .. 8 ..
4.200.d:
इति कार्पासशैलेन्द्रं यो दद्यात्पर्वसंनिधौ ॥
रुद्रलोके वसेत्कल्पं ततो राजा भवेदिह ॥ 8 ॥
4.200.m: Whoever gives this king of mountains made of cotton in the vicinity of a sacred festival / lives in the realm of Rudra for a kalpa; then he becomes a king here,

4.200.s:
rūpavānsubhago vāgmī śrīmānatulavikramaḥ ..
pañcajanmāni nārī vā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 9 ..
4.200.d:
रूपवान्सुभगो वाग्मी श्रीमानतुलविक्रमः ॥
पञ्चजन्मानि नारी वा जायते नात्र संशयः ॥ 9 ॥
4.200.m: handsome, fortunate, eloquent, prosperous, of unequalled valour; / or a woman is born [as such] for five lives; there is no doubt about this.

4.200.s:
kārpāsaparvatamayo jagadekabaṃdhuryasmānnatena rahito varavastrayogaḥ ..
tasmādaghaudhaśamanāya sukhāya nityaṃ deyo nareṇa naranāthavimatsareṇa .. 4.200.10 ..
ghṛtācaladānavidhivarṇanam
4.200.d:
कार्पासपर्वतमयो जगदेकबंधुर्यस्मान्नतेन रहितो वरवस्त्रयोगः ॥
तस्मादघौधशमनाय सुखाय नित्यं देयो नरेण नरनाथविमत्सरेण ॥ 4.200.10 ॥
घृताचलदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.200.m:
Since the sole kin of the universe consists of the cotton mountain, without which the provision of excellent garments cannot be, / therefore, for the pacification of the multitude of sins and for constant happiness, it should be given by an ungrudging man, O lord of men.
Description of the Procedure for the Gift of the Mountain of Ghee

4.201.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi ghṛtācalamanuttamam ..
tejo'mṛtamayaṃ divyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
4.201.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि घृताचलमनुत्तमम् ॥
तेजोऽमृतमयं दिव्यं महापातकनाशनम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.201.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Now next I shall declare the unexcelled mountain of ghee, / made of divine fiery nectar, destroying the great sins.

4.201.s:
paṃcāśadghṛtakumbhānāmuttamaḥ syādghṛtācalaḥ ..
madhyamastu tadardhena tadarddhenāvaraḥ smṛtaḥ .. 2 ..
4.201.d:
पंचाशद्घृतकुम्भानामुत्तमः स्याद्घृताचलः ॥
मध्यमस्तु तदर्धेन तदर्द्धेनावरः स्मृतः ॥ 2 ॥
4.201.m: The best mountain of ghee consists of fifty jars of ghee; / the middle is considered half of that, and the lowest half of that.

4.201.s:
alpavittastu kurvīta yathāśaktyā vidhānataḥ ..
viṣkaṃbhaparvatāṃstadvaccaturbhāgena kalpayet .. 3 ..
4.201.d:
अल्पवित्तस्तु कुर्वीत यथाशक्त्या विधानतः ॥
विष्कंभपर्वतांस्तद्वच्चतुर्भागेन कल्पयेत् ॥ 3 ॥
4.201.m: One of little wealth should prepare it according to his ability, in accordance with the rule. / Likewise, one should arrange the peripheral mountains as a fourth part [of the size].

4.201.s:
śāleyataṃdulānāṃ ca kuṃbhāṃśca parivinyaset ..
kārayetsaṃhatānuccānyathāśobhaṃ vidhānataḥ .. 4 ..
4.201.d:
शालेयतंदुलानां च कुंभांश्च परिविन्यसेत् ॥
कारयेत्संहतानुच्चान्यथाशोभं विधानतः ॥ 4 ॥
4.201.m: And one should arrange jars of śāli rice grains all around; / one should have them made closely packed and high according to beauty and rule.
One should envelop [it] with white cloths, sugar-cane stalks, fruits, and the like; / the rest of the procedure is recited here as being like that of the grain mountain.

4.201.s:
adhivāsanapūrvaṃ ca tadvaddhomaṃ surārcanam ..
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvayāṃ gurave vinivedayet..6..
4.201.d:
अधिवासनपूर्वं च तद्वद्धोमं सुरार्चनम् ॥
प्रभातायां तु शर्वयां गुरवे विनिवेदयेत्॥6॥
4.201.m: Preceded by preliminary consecration, likewise the fire-oblation and the worship of the gods; / when the night has turned to dawn, one should present it to the guru,

4.201.s:
viṣkaṃbhaparvatāṃstadvadṛtvigbhyaḥ śāṃtamānasaḥ ..
maṃtreṇānena kauṃteya tacchṛṇuṣva vadāmi te ..7..
4.201.d:
विष्कंभपर्वतांस्तद्वदृत्विग्भ्यः शांतमानसः ॥
मंत्रेणानेन कौंतेय तच्छृणुष्व वदामि ते ॥7॥
4.201.m: and likewise the peripheral mountains to the officiating priests, with a tranquil mind, / with this mantra, O son of Kuntī; listen to that, I speak to you:
'Since ghee arose from union for the splendour of nectar, / therefore, through this mountain of ghee, may Śaṅkara be pleased with me.

4.201.s:
tasmāttejomayaṃ brahma ghṛte nityaṃ vyavasthitam ..
ghṛtaparvatarūpeṇa tasmānnaḥ pāhi bhūdhara .. 9 ..
4.201.d:
तस्मात्तेजोमयं ब्रह्म घृते नित्यं व्यवस्थितम् ॥
घृतपर्वतरूपेण तस्मान्नः पाहि भूधर ॥ 9 ॥
4.201.m: Therefore Brahman consisting of light is constantly present in ghee; / therefore, in the form of a mountain of ghee, protect us, O mountain!'

4.201.s:
anena vidhinā dadyādghṛtācalamanuttamam ..
mahāpātakayukto'pi lokamāyāti śāṃkaram .. 4.201.10 ..
4.201.d:
अनेन विधिना दद्याद्घृताचलमनुत्तमम् ॥
महापातकयुक्तोऽपि लोकमायाति शांकरम् ॥ 4.201.10 ॥
4.201.m: According to this rule, one should give the unsurpassed mountain of ghee; / even if burdened with major sins, one goes to the world of Śaṃkara.
In a celestial chariot joined by swans and sārasa cranes, adorned with a network of tinkling bells, / surrounded by apsarases, siddhas, and vidyādharas,
he sports together with the ancestors until the dissolution of all beings.

4.201.s:
ājyācalaṃ pracalakuṃḍalasundarībhiḥ saṃsevyamānamiha ye vitaraṃti martyāḥ ..
svargaṃ sureṃdrabhavanaṃ bhavasaṃnidhiṃ vā snehānubaṃdhamacalaṃ bhavatīti sarvam .. 13 ..
ratnācaladānavidhivarṇanam
4.201.d:
आज्याचलं प्रचलकुंडलसुन्दरीभिः संसेव्यमानमिह ये वितरंति मर्त्याः ॥
स्वर्गं सुरेंद्रभवनं भवसंनिधिं वा स्नेहानुबंधमचलं भवतीति सर्वम् ॥ 13 ॥
रत्नाचलदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.201.m:
The mortals who bestow here a mountain of clarified butter attended by beauties with trembling earrings— / all this becomes their firm bond of affection, [leading to] heaven, the abode of the lord of the gods, or the presence of Śiva.
Description of the Rule for the Gift of the Mountain of Jewels

4.202.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi ratnācalamanuttamam ..
yatpradānānnaro yāti lokānsaptarṣisevitān .. 1 ..
4.202.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि रत्नाचलमनुत्तमम् ॥
यत्प्रदानान्नरो याति लोकान्सप्तर्षिसेवितान् ॥ 1 ॥
4.202.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Now I shall fully explain the unsurpassed mountain of jewels, / by giving which a man goes to the worlds inhabited by the Seven Sages.

4.202.s:
muktāphalasahasreṇa parvataḥ syādanuttamaḥ ..
madhyamaḥ pañcaśatikastriśatenāvaraḥ smṛtaḥ .. 2 ..
4.202.d:
मुक्ताफलसहस्रेण पर्वतः स्यादनुत्तमः ॥
मध्यमः पञ्चशतिकस्त्रिशतेनावरः स्मृतः ॥ 2 ॥
4.202.m: With a thousand pearls, the mountain is best; / the middling consists of five hundred, and the lowest is remembered as three hundred.

4.202.s:
alpavittastu kurvīta muktāphalaśatena ca ..
caturthāṃśena viṣkaṃbhaparvatāḥ syuḥ samaṃtataḥ .. 3 ..
4.202.d:
अल्पवित्तस्तु कुर्वीत मुक्ताफलशतेन च ॥
चतुर्थांशेन विष्कंभपर्वताः स्युः समंततः ॥ 3 ॥
4.202.m: One of small wealth should make it with a hundred pearls; / the peripheral mountains all around should be one fourth [that amount].
Gandhamādana should be made by the learned on the east with diamonds and garnets, / on the south with sapphires and topazes.

4.202.s:
vaiḍūryavidrumaiḥ paścātsāvitro vipulācalaḥ ..
padmarāgaṃ sasauvarṇamuttareṇāpi vinyaset .. 5 ..
4.202.d:
वैडूर्यविद्रुमैः पश्चात्सावित्रो विपुलाचलः ॥
पद्मरागं ससौवर्णमुत्तरेणापि विन्यसेत् ॥ 5 ॥
4.202.m: On the west, Mount Vipula [dedicated to] Savitṛ [is adorned] with cat's eyes and coral; / on the north one should place rubies along with gold.

4.202.s:
dhānyaparvatavaccheṣamatrāpi parikalpayet ..
tadvadāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā vṛkṣāndevāṃśca kāṃcanām .. 6 ..
4.202.d:
धान्यपर्वतवच्छेषमत्रापि परिकल्पयेत् ॥
तद्वदावाहनं कृत्वा वृक्षान्देवांश्च कांचनाम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.202.m: One should arrange the remainder here just as with the mountain of grain, / similarly performing the invocation, and golden trees and deities.

4.202.s:
pūjayetpuṣpanaivedyaiḥ prabhāte tu visarjanam ..
pūrvavadguruṛtvigbhyāṃ imānmaṃtrānudīrayet ..7..
4.202.d:
पूजयेत्पुष्पनैवेद्यैः प्रभाते तु विसर्जनम् ॥
पूर्ववद्गुरुऋत्विग्भ्यां इमान्मंत्रानुदीरयेत् ॥7॥
4.202.m: One should worship them with flowers and food-offerings; in the morning takes place the dismissal; / as before, for the guru and the priests, one should recite these mantras:

4.202.s:
yathā devagaṇāḥ sarve sarvaratneṣvavasthitāḥ ..
tvaṃ ca ratnamayo nityamataḥ pāhi mahācala .. 8 ..
4.202.d:
यथा देवगणाः सर्वे सर्वरत्नेष्ववस्थिताः ॥
त्वं च रत्नमयो नित्यमतः पाहि महाचल ॥ 8 ॥
4.202.m: “Just as all the hosts of gods abide in all the jewels, / and you are always made of jewels, therefore protect [us], O great mountain!

4.202.s:
yasmādratnapradānena tuṣṭimeti janārdanaḥ ..
pūjāratnapradānena tasmānnaḥ pāhi sarvadā .. 9 ..
4.202.d:
यस्माद्रत्नप्रदानेन तुष्टिमेति जनार्दनः ॥
पूजारत्नप्रदानेन तस्मान्नः पाहि सर्वदा ॥ 9 ॥
4.202.m: Since Janārdana attains satisfaction through the gift of jewels, / therefore protect us always by this gift of gems of worship!”

4.202.s:
anena vidhinā yastu dadyādratnamayaṃ girim ..
sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamamareśvarapūjitam .. 4.202.10 ..
4.202.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दद्याद्रत्नमयं गिरिम् ॥
स याति वैष्णवं लोकममरेश्वरपूजितम् ॥ 4.202.10 ॥
4.202.m: He who gives a mountain made of gems according to this rule / goes to the world of Viṣṇu, venerated by the lord of the immortals.

4.202.s:
yāvatkalpaśataṃ sāgramuṣitveha narādhipa ..
rūpārogyaguṇopetaḥ saptadvīpādhipo bhavet.. .. 11 ..
4.202.d:
यावत्कल्पशतं साग्रमुषित्वेह नराधिप ॥
रूपारोग्यगुणोपेतः सप्तद्वीपाधिपो भवेत्॥ ॥ 11 ॥
4.202.m: Dwelling there for more than a hundred kalpas, O ruler of men, / he becomes a sovereign of the seven continents, endowed with beauty, health, and virtues.

4.202.s:
brahmahatyādikaṃ kiṃcidatra cāmutra vā kṛtam ..
tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti girirvajrahato yathā .. 12 ..
4.202.d:
ब्रह्महत्यादिकं किंचिदत्र चामुत्र वा कृतम् ॥
तत्सर्वं नाशमायाति गिरिर्वज्रहतो यथा ॥ 12 ॥
4.202.m: Whatever [sin] like the slaying of a Brahmin was committed here or in the other world, / all that goes to destruction, like a mountain struck by a thunderbolt.

4.202.s:
muktāmayaṃ kanakavidrumabhakticitraṃ caṃcanmahāmaṇimarīcicayopapannam ..
ratnācalaṃ dvijavarāya nivedayitvā bhāsvatprabhāmabhibhavetsuralokaloke .. 13 ..
raupyācaladānavidhivarṇanam
4.202.d:
मुक्तामयं कनकविद्रुमभक्तिचित्रं चंचन्महामणिमरीचिचयोपपन्नम् ॥
रत्नाचलं द्विजवराय निवेदयित्वा भास्वत्प्रभामभिभवेत्सुरलोकलोके ॥ 13 ॥
रौप्याचलदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.202.m:
Having offered to an excellent twice-born the mountain of jewels made of pearls, variegated with decorations of gold and coral, / equipped with a gleaming mass of rays from great gems, he surpasses the radiance of the sun in the realm of the gods.
Description of the Rule for the Gift of the Mountain of Silver

4.203.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi raupyācalamanuttamam ..
yatpradānānnaro yāti somalokaṃ narottama .. 1 ..
4.203.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि रौप्याचलमनुत्तमम् ॥
यत्प्रदानान्नरो याति सोमलोकं नरोत्तम ॥ 1 ॥
4.203.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Hereafter I shall explain the unsurpassed mountain of silver, / by giving which a man goes to the world of Soma, O best of men.

4.203.s:
sahasreṇa palānāṃ tu uttamo rajatācalaḥ ..
paṃcabhirmadhyamaḥ proktastadarddhenāvaraḥ smṛtaḥ..2..
4.203.d:
सहस्रेण पलानां तु उत्तमो रजताचलः ॥
पंचभिर्मध्यमः प्रोक्तस्तदर्द्धेनावरः स्मृतः॥2॥
4.203.m: The highest mountain of silver is made with a thousand palas; / the middling is declared to be five [hundred], and half of that is remembered as the lowest.

4.203.s:
aśakto viṃśaterūrdhvaṃ kārayedbhaktitaḥ sadā ..
viṣkaṃbhaparvatāṃstadvatturīyāṃśena kalpayet ..3..
4.203.d:
अशक्तो विंशतेरूर्ध्वं कारयेद्भक्तितः सदा ॥
विष्कंभपर्वतांस्तद्वत्तुरीयांशेन कल्पयेत् ॥3॥
4.203.m: One unable [to do so] should always have it made with devotion above twenty [palas]; / likewise he should fashion the peripheral mountains with a fourth part [each].
As before, he should make Mandara and the others of silver according to the rule; / likewise, O king, he should have the guardians of the world made of gold,

4.203.s:
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīṃśca nitaṃbo'tra hiraṇmayaḥ ..
rājataṃ syādyadanyeṣāṃ sarvaṃ tadiha kāṃcanam .. 5 ..
4.203.d:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादींश्च नितंबोऽत्र हिरण्मयः ॥
राजतं स्याद्यदन्येषां सर्वं तदिह कांचनम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.203.m: as well as Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and the others; here the slope is made of gold; / whatever of the other [mountains] was silver, all that is here golden.

4.203.s:
śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavatkṛtvā homajāgaraṇādikam ..
dadyāttadvatprabhāte tu gurave raupyaparvatam .. 6 ..
4.203.d:
शेषं च पूर्ववत्कृत्वा होमजागरणादिकम् ॥
दद्यात्तद्वत्प्रभाते तु गुरवे रौप्यपर्वतम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.203.m: Performing the remainder as before—the fire offering, keeping vigil, and so forth— / he should likewise give the silver mountain to the guru in the morning.

4.203.s:
viṣkaṃbhaśailānṛtvigbhyaḥ pūjayecca vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
imaṃ maṃtraṃ paṭhandadyāddarbhapāṇirvimatsaraḥ .. 7 ..
4.203.d:
विष्कंभशैलानृत्विग्भ्यः पूजयेच्च विभूषणैः ॥
इमं मंत्रं पठन्दद्याद्दर्भपाणिर्विमत्सरः ॥ 7 ॥
4.203.m: He should worship the peripheral mountains with ornaments and [give them] to the priests; / holding darbha grass in hand, free from malice, he should give it while reciting this mantra:

4.203.s:
pitṝṇāṃ vallabhaṃ yasmāccharmadaṃ śaṃkarasya ca ..
rajataṃ pāhi tasmānno ghorātsaṃsārasāgarāt ..8..
4.203.d:
पितॄणां वल्लभं यस्माच्छर्मदं शंकरस्य च ॥
रजतं पाहि तस्मान्नो घोरात्संसारसागरात् ॥8॥
4.203.m: “Since silver is dear to the ancestors and brings joy to Śaṃkara, / therefore protect us from the dreadful ocean of worldly existence!”

4.203.s:
itthaṃ niveśya yo dadyādrajatācalamuttamam ..
gavāmayutadānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 9 ..
4.203.d:
इत्थं निवेश्य यो दद्याद्रजताचलमुत्तमम् ॥
गवामयुतदानस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥ 9 ॥
4.203.m: The man who, having arranged it thus, gives the excellent mountain of silver / obtains the fruit of the gift of ten thousand cows.

4.203.s:
somaloke sagaṃdharvakiṃnarāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ..
pūjyamāno vasedvidvānyāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 4.203.10 ..
rājeśa rājatagiriṃ kanakopalālīcchannaṃ prasannasalile sahitaṃ sarobhiḥ ..
yacchaṃti ye sukṛtino virajo vi śokaṃ gacchaṃti te gatamalā nṛpa somalokam ..1 1.. ..
śarkarācaladānavidhivarṇanam
4.203.d:
सोमलोके सगंधर्वकिंनराप्सरसां गणैः ॥
पूज्यमानो वसेद्विद्वान्यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् ॥ 4.203.10 ॥
राजेश राजतगिरिं कनकोपलालीच्छन्नं प्रसन्नसलिले सहितं सरोभिः ॥
यच्छंति ये सुकृतिनो विरजो वि शोकं गच्छंति ते गतमला नृप सोमलोकम् ॥1 1॥ ॥
शर्कराचलदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.203.m:
In the world of Soma, being worshipped by troops of gandharvas, kiṃnaras, and apsarases, / the wise man shall dwell until the dissolution of all beings.
O lord of kings, those virtuous people who give a silver mountain covered with rows of golden stones, / together with lakes of clear water, free from passion and free from sorrow, cleansed of stain, go to the world of Soma, O king.
Description of the Rule for the Gift of the Mountain of Sugar

4.204.s:
..śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi śarkarācalamuttamam ..
yasya pradānādviṣṇvarkarudrāstuṣyaṃti sarvadā .. 1 ..
4.204.d:
॥श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि शर्कराचलमुत्तमम् ॥
यस्य प्रदानाद्विष्ण्वर्करुद्रास्तुष्यंति सर्वदा ॥ 1 ॥
4.204.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Now I shall fully explain the excellent mountain of sugar, / from the gift of which Viṣṇu, Sūrya, and Rudra are always pleased.

4.204.s:
aṣṭabhiḥ śarkarābhārairuttamaḥ syānmahācalaḥ ..
caturbhirmadhyamaḥ prokto bhārābhyāmadhamaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 2 ..
4.204.d:
अष्टभिः शर्कराभारैरुत्तमः स्यान्महाचलः ॥
चतुर्भिर्मध्यमः प्रोक्तो भाराभ्यामधमः स्मृतः ॥ 2 ॥
4.204.m: The highest great mountain should be made of eight bhāras of sugar; / the middling is declared to be four, and the lowest is remembered as two bhāras.

4.204.s:
bhāreṇaivārddhabhāreṇa kuryādyaścālpavittavān ..
viṣkaṃbhaparvatānkuryātturīyāṃśena mānavaḥ .. 3 ..
4.204.d:
भारेणैवार्द्धभारेण कुर्याद्यश्चाल्पवित्तवान् ॥
विष्कंभपर्वतान्कुर्यात्तुरीयांशेन मानवः ॥ 3 ॥
4.204.m: A man of small wealth may make it with one bhāra or half a bhāra; / a man should make the peripheral mountains with a fourth part [each].

4.204.s:
dhānyaparvatavatsarvamāsādya rasasaṃyutam ..
meroruparitastadvatsthāpya hematarutrayam .. 4 ..
4.204.d:
धान्यपर्वतवत्सर्वमासाद्य रससंयुतम् ॥
मेरोरुपरितस्तद्वत्स्थाप्य हेमतरुत्रयम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.204.m: Preparing everything together with the liquids just as with the mountain of grain, / having likewise placed three golden trees on top of Meru:

4.204.s:
maṃdāraḥ pārijātaśca tṛtīyaḥ kalpapādapaḥ..
etadvṛkṣatrayaṃ mūrdhni sarveṣvapi nidhāpayet ..5..
4.204.d:
मंदारः पारिजातश्च तृतीयः कल्पपादपः॥
एतद्वृक्षत्रयं मूर्ध्नि सर्वेष्वपि निधापयेत् ॥5॥
4.204.m: the mandāra, the pārijāta, and thirdly the wish-granting tree; / one should have these three trees placed on the summit on all [the mountains] as well.

4.204.s:
haricaṃdanasaṃtānau pūrvapaścimabhāgayoḥ ..
niveśyau sarvaśaileṣu viśeṣāccharkarācale .. 6 ..
4.204.d:
हरिचंदनसंतानौ पूर्वपश्चिमभागयोः ॥
निवेश्यौ सर्वशैलेषु विशेषाच्छर्कराचले ॥ 6 ॥
4.204.m: The haricandana and saṃtāna trees should be placed on the eastern and western parts / on all mountains, especially on the mountain of sugar.

4.204.s:
maṃdare kāmadevaṃ tu kaṃdabasya tale nyaset ..
jaṃbūvṛkṣatale kāryo garunmāngaṃdhamādane ..7..
4.204.d:
मंदरे कामदेवं तु कंदबस्य तले न्यसेत् ॥
जंबूवृक्षतले कार्यो गरुन्मान्गंधमादने ॥7॥
4.204.m: On Mount Mandara one should place Kāmadeva beneath a kadamba tree; / on Gandhamādana, Garuḍa should be fashioned beneath a jambū tree.

4.204.s:
prāṅmukho hemamūrtiśca haṃsaḥ syādvipulācale ..
haimī śreyorthibhiḥ kāryā surabhirdakṣiṇāmukhī .. 8 ..
4.204.d:
प्राङ्मुखो हेममूर्तिश्च हंसः स्याद्विपुलाचले ॥
हैमी श्रेयोर्थिभिः कार्या सुरभिर्दक्षिणामुखी ॥ 8 ॥
4.204.m: On Mount Vipula there should be an east-facing golden form of a swan; / those seeking welfare should make a golden Surabhi facing south.

4.204.s:
dhānyaparvatavatsarvamāvāhanamakhādikam ..
kṛtvātha gurave dadyānmadhyamaṃ parvatottamam .. 9 ..
4.204.d:
धान्यपर्वतवत्सर्वमावाहनमखादिकम् ॥
कृत्वाथ गुरवे दद्यान्मध्यमं पर्वतोत्तमम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.204.m: Having performed everything—the invocation, sacrificial ritual, and the rest—as with the mountain of grain, / one should then give the central, excellent mountain to the guru.

4.204.s:
ṛtvigbhyaścaturaḥ śailānimānmaṃtrānudīrayet ..
saubhāgyāmṛtasāro'yaṃ paramaḥ śarkarāyutaḥ .. 4.204.10 ..
4.204.d:
ऋत्विग्भ्यश्चतुरः शैलानिमान्मंत्रानुदीरयेत् ॥
सौभाग्यामृतसारोऽयं परमः शर्करायुतः ॥ 4.204.10 ॥
4.204.m: He should give the four mountains to the priests, reciting these mantras: / “This supreme essence of the nectar of auspiciousness, accompanied by sugar...

4.204.s:
yasmādānaṃdakārī tvaṃ bhava śaileṃdra sarvadā ..
amṛtaṃ pibatāṃ ye tu niṣpeturbhuvi śīkarāḥ .. 11 ..
4.204.d:
यस्मादानंदकारी त्वं भव शैलेंद्र सर्वदा ॥
अमृतं पिबतां ये तु निष्पेतुर्भुवि शीकराः ॥ 11 ॥
4.204.m: Because you bring joy, O lord of mountains, be ever [joyful]! / Those drops that fell to the earth as the gods were drinking nectar—

4.204.s:
devānāṃ tatsamuttho'si pāhi naḥ śarkarācala ..
manobhavadhanurmadhyādudbhūtā śarkarā yataḥ .. 12 ..
4.204.d:
देवानां तत्समुत्थोऽसि पाहि नः शर्कराचल ॥
मनोभवधनुर्मध्यादुद्भूता शर्करा यतः ॥ 12 ॥
4.204.m: From those you arose; protect us, O mountain of sugar! / Since sugar was born from the middle of the bow of the Mind-born god [Kāmadeva],

4.204.s:
tanmayo'si mahāśaila pāhi saṃsārasāgarāt ..
yo dadyāccharkarāśailamanena vidhinā naraḥ .. 13 ..
4.204.d:
तन्मयोऽसि महाशैल पाहि संसारसागरात् ॥
यो दद्याच्छर्कराशैलमनेन विधिना नरः ॥ 13 ॥
4.204.m: You consist of that, O great mountain; protect [us] from the ocean of worldly existence!' / The man who gives a mountain of sugar according to this rule

4.204.s:
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sa yāti śivamaṃdiram ..
caṃdrādisārcisaṃkāśamadhiruhyānujīvibhiḥ .. 14 ..
4.204.d:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः स याति शिवमंदिरम् ॥
चंद्रादिसार्चिसंकाशमधिरुह्यानुजीविभिः ॥ 14 ॥
4.204.m: Is freed from all sins and goes to the abode of Śiva. / Ascending a vehicle resembling the rays of the moon and [the sun], together with his dependents,

4.204.s:
sahaiva yānamātiṣṭhetsa tu viṣṇupade divi ..
tataḥ kalpa śatāṃte tu saptadvīpādhipo bhavet .. 15 ..
4.204.d:
सहैव यानमातिष्ठेत्स तु विष्णुपदे दिवि ॥
ततः कल्प शतांते तु सप्तद्वीपाधिपो भवेत् ॥ 15 ॥
4.204.m: He indeed abides in heaven, in the abode of Viṣṇu. / Then, at the end of a hundred kalpas, he becomes the ruler of the seven continents,

4.204.s:
āyurārogyasaṃpanno yāvajjanmāyutatrayam ..
bhojanaṃ śaktito dadyātsarvaśaileṣvamatsaraḥ ..
svayaṃ vā kṣāra lavaṇamaśnīyāttadanujñayā .. 16 ..
4.204.d:
आयुरारोग्यसंपन्नो यावज्जन्मायुतत्रयम् ॥
भोजनं शक्तितो दद्यात्सर्वशैलेष्वमत्सरः ॥
स्वयं वा क्षार लवणमश्नीयात्तदनुज्ञया ॥ 16 ॥
4.204.m: Endowed with long life and health for thirty thousand births. / Free from jealousy, one should give food according to one's capacity at all the mountains; / or oneself, with his [the guru's] permission, one should eat alkaline salt.

4.204.s:
parvatopaskaraṃ sarvaṃ prāpayedbrāhmaṇālayam ..
āsītpurā brahmakalpe dharmamūrtirnarādhipaḥ .. 17 ..
4.204.d:
पर्वतोपस्करं सर्वं प्रापयेद्ब्राह्मणालयम् ॥
आसीत्पुरा ब्रह्मकल्पे धर्ममूर्तिर्नराधिपः ॥ 17 ॥
4.204.m: One should convey all the equipment of the mountain to the home of the brāhmaṇa. / In ancient times, in the Kalpa of Brahmā, there was a king who was the embodiment of righteousness,

4.204.s:
suhṛcchakrasya nihatā yena daityāḥ sahasraśaḥ ..
somasūryādayo yasya tejasā vigataprabhāḥ .. 18 ..
4.204.d:
सुहृच्छक्रस्य निहता येन दैत्याः सहस्रशः ॥
सोमसूर्यादयो यस्य तेजसा विगतप्रभाः ॥ 18 ॥
4.204.m: A friend of Indra, by whom thousands of daityas were slain; / by whose radiance Soma, Sūrya, and the others became devoid of luster;

4.204.s:
bhavaṃti śataśo yena rājāno'pi parājitāḥ ..
yathecchārūpadhārī ca manuṣyo'pyapavāritaḥ .. 19 ..
4.204.d:
भवंति शतशो येन राजानोऽपि पराजिताः ॥
यथेच्छारूपधारी च मनुष्योऽप्यपवारितः ॥ 19 ॥
4.204.m: By whom kings by the hundreds were defeated; / who assumed forms at will, yet was an unhindered mortal.

4.204.s:
tasya bhānumatīnāma bhāryā trailokyasuṃdarī ..
lakṣmīriva ca rūpeṇa nirjitāmarasuṃdarī .. 4.204.20 ..
4.204.d:
तस्य भानुमतीनाम भार्या त्रैलोक्यसुंदरी ॥
लक्ष्मीरिव च रूपेण निर्जितामरसुंदरी ॥ 4.204.20 ॥
4.204.m: His wife, named Bhānumatī, was the most beautiful woman in the three worlds, / resembling Lakṣmī in beauty, who surpassed heavenly beauties.

4.204.s:
rājñastasyāgramahiṣī prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī ..
daśanārīsahasrāṇāṃ madhye śrīriva rājate .. 21 ..
4.204.d:
राज्ञस्तस्याग्रमहिषी प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसी ॥
दशनारीसहस्राणां मध्ये श्रीरिव राजते ॥ 21 ॥
4.204.m: She was the chief queen of that king, dearer even than his life's breath; / among ten thousand women, she shone like Śrī.

4.204.s:
nṛpakoṭisahasreṇa na kadācitpramucyate ..
sa kadācitsthānagataṃ papraccha svaṃ purohitam .. 22 ..
4.204.d:
नृपकोटिसहस्रेण न कदाचित्प्रमुच्यते ॥
स कदाचित्स्थानगतं पप्रच्छ स्वं पुरोहितम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.204.m: He was never abandoned by tens of millions of kings. / Once, he asked his family priest who had arrived at his seat,

4.204.s:
vismayāviṣṭahṛdayo vasiṣṭhamṛṣisattamam ..
bhagavankena dharmeṇa mama lakṣmīranuttamā .. 23 ..
4.204.d:
विस्मयाविष्टहृदयो वसिष्ठमृषिसत्तमम् ॥
भगवन्केन धर्मेण मम लक्ष्मीरनुत्तमा ॥ 23 ॥
4.204.m: His heart filled with wonder, [addressing] Vasiṣṭha, the best of sages: / 'O venerable one, by what righteous act is my fortune unsurpassed?

4.204.s: kasmācca vipulaṃ tejo maccharīre sadottamam .. 24 ..
4.204.d: कस्माच्च विपुलं तेजो मच्छरीरे सदोत्तमम् ॥ 24 ॥
4.204.m: And why is there always immense, supreme splendor in my body?'

4.204.s:
.. vaśiṣṭha uvāca ..
purā līlāvatī nāma veśyā śivaparāyaṇā ..
tayā dattaścaturdaśyāṃ gurave lavaṇācalaḥ .. 25 ..
4.204.d:
॥ वशिष्ठ उवाच ॥
पुरा लीलावती नाम वेश्या शिवपरायणा ॥
तया दत्तश्चतुर्दश्यां गुरवे लवणाचलः ॥ 25 ॥
4.204.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / 'In ancient times there was a courtesan named Līlāvatī, devoted to Śiva; / on the fourteenth day, she gave a mountain of salt to her guru,

4.204.s:
hemavṛkṣāmaraiḥ sārddhaṃ yathāvadvidhipūrvakaḥ ..
śūdraḥ suvarṇakārastu nāmnā śauṃḍobhavattadā .. 26 ..
4.204.d:
हेमवृक्षामरैः सार्द्धं यथावद्विधिपूर्वकः ॥
शूद्रः सुवर्णकारस्तु नाम्ना शौंडोभवत्तदा ॥ 26 ॥
4.204.m: Together with golden trees and gods, properly in accordance with rule. / At that time there was a śūdra goldsmith named Śauṇḍa,

4.204.s:
bhṛtyo līlāvatīgehe tena haimā vinirmitāḥ ..
taravo'maramukhyāśca śraddhāyuktena pārthiva .. 27 ..
4.204.d:
भृत्यो लीलावतीगेहे तेन हैमा विनिर्मिताः ॥
तरवोऽमरमुख्याश्च श्रद्धायुक्तेन पार्थिव ॥ 27 ॥
4.204.m: A servant in Līlāvatī's house; by him, endowed with faith, / golden trees and chief deities were fashioned, O king.

4.204.s:
atirūpeṇa saṃpannānghaṭayitvā tato hṛdi ..
dharmakāryamatiṃ jñātvā nāgṛhīta kathaṃcana .. 28 ..
4.204.d:
अतिरूपेण संपन्नान्घटयित्वा ततो हृदि ॥
धर्मकार्यमतिं ज्ञात्वा नागृहीत कथंचन ॥ 28 ॥
4.204.m: Having fashioned them endowed with extreme beauty, then in his heart / recognizing her mind was set on a pious act, he took nothing whatever.

4.204.s:
ujjvālitāstu tatpatnyā sauvarṇāmarapādapāḥ ..
līlāvatī gṛhe pārśve paricaryā ca pārthiva .. 29 ..
4.204.d:
उज्ज्वालितास्तु तत्पत्न्या सौवर्णामरपादपाः ॥
लीलावती गृहे पार्श्वे परिचर्या च पार्थिव ॥ 29 ॥
4.204.m: The golden divine trees were polished by his wife, / and service was rendered beside Līlāvatī's house, O king.

4.204.s:
kṛtaṃ tābhyāṃ praharṣeṇa dvijaśuśrūṣaṇādikam ..
sā tu līlāvatī veśyā kālena mahatā nṛpa .. 4.204.30 ..
4.204.d:
कृतं ताभ्यां प्रहर्षेण द्विजशुश्रूषणादिकम् ॥
सा तु लीलावती वेश्या कालेन महता नृप ॥ 4.204.30 ॥
4.204.m: Attending upon the brāhmaṇas and other [services] were performed by both of them with great joy. / In course of time, O king, that courtesan Līlāvatī,

4.204.s:
sarvapāpavinirmuktā jagāma śivamaṃdiram ..
yo'sau suvarṇakāraśca daridro'pyati sattvavān .. 31 ..
4.204.d:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्ता जगाम शिवमंदिरम् ॥
योऽसौ सुवर्णकारश्च दरिद्रोऽप्यति सत्त्ववान् ॥ 31 ॥
4.204.m: Freed from all sins, went to the abode of Śiva. / And that goldsmith who, though poor, possessed great noble resolution,

4.204.s:
na mūlyamādādveśyātaḥ sa bhavāniha sāṃpratam ..
saptadvīpapatirjātaḥ sūryāyutasamaprabhaḥ .. 32 ..
4.204.d:
न मूल्यमादाद्वेश्यातः स भवानिह सांप्रतम् ॥
सप्तद्वीपपतिर्जातः सूर्यायुतसमप्रभः ॥ 32 ॥
4.204.m: And took no payment from the courtesan, is now you yourself in this world; / you have become the lord of the seven continents, radiant as ten thousand suns.

4.204.s:
yayā suvarṇa racitāstaravo hemadevatāḥ ..
samyagujjvalitāḥ patnī seyaṃ bhānumatī tava .. 30 ..
4.204.d:
यया सुवर्ण रचितास्तरवो हेमदेवताः ॥
सम्यगुज्ज्वलिताः पत्नी सेयं भानुमती तव ॥ 30 ॥
4.204.m: She by whom the golden trees and golden deities / were thoroughly polished is this Bhānumatī, your wife.

4.204.s:
ujjvālanādujjvalarūpamasyāḥ sujātamasminbhuvanādhipatyam ..
tasmātkṛtaṃ tatparikarma rātrāvanuddhatābhyāṃ lavaṇācalasya .. 34 ..
4.204.d:
उज्ज्वालनादुज्ज्वलरूपमस्याः सुजातमस्मिन्भुवनाधिपत्यम् ॥
तस्मात्कृतं तत्परिकर्म रात्रावनुद्धताभ्यां लवणाचलस्य ॥ 34 ॥
4.204.m: From the polishing, her brilliant form was born, as was this sovereignty over the world; / therefore, that service for the salt-mountain was performed at night by the two of you without arrogance.

4.204.s:
tasmācca lokeṣvaparājitastvamārogyasaubhāgyayutā ca lakṣmīḥ ..
tasmāttvamapyatra vidhānapūrvaṃ dhānyācalādīndaśadhā kuruṣva .. 35 ..
4.204.d:
तस्माच्च लोकेष्वपराजितस्त्वमारोग्यसौभाग्ययुता च लक्ष्मीः ॥
तस्मात्त्वमप्यत्र विधानपूर्वं धान्याचलादीन्दशधा कुरुष्व ॥ 35 ॥
4.204.m: Therefore you are undefeated in the worlds, and your fortune is endowed with health and good luck; / therefore, you too here must offer the ten [mountains], beginning with the grain-mountain, according to rule.'

4.204.s:
tatheti sampūjya ca dharmamūrti vaco vaśiṣṭhasya dadau sa sarvān ..
dhānyācalādīnkramaśaḥ purārerlokaṃ jagāmāmarapūjyamānaḥ .. 36 ..
4.204.d:
तथेति सम्पूज्य च धर्ममूर्ति वचो वशिष्ठस्य ददौ स सर्वान् ॥
धान्याचलादीन्क्रमशः पुरारेर्लोकं जगामामरपूज्यमानः ॥ 36 ॥
4.204.m: Saying 'So be it,' that embodiment of righteousness honored the word of Vasiṣṭha and gave all / [mountains] beginning with the grain-mountain in order, and, honored by the gods, went to the realm of the enemy of Pura [Śiva].

4.204.s:
yaścādhanaḥ paśyati dīyamānaṃ meroḥ pradānamiha dharmaparo manuṣyaḥ ..
śṛṇoti bhaktyā parayā'pramādī vikalmaṣaḥ so'pi divaṃ prayāti .. 37 ..
4.204.d:
यश्चाधनः पश्यति दीयमानं मेरोः प्रदानमिह धर्मपरो मनुष्यः ॥
शृणोति भक्त्या परयाऽप्रमादी विकल्मषः सोऽपि दिवं प्रयाति ॥ 37 ॥
4.204.m: And whatever man without wealth, intent on righteousness, sees being given here / the gift of Meru, or hears of it with supreme devotion and vigilance, he too, freed from taint, goes to heaven.

4.204.s:
duḥsvapnaṃ praśabhamupaiti paṭhyamāne śailendre bhavabhayabhedane narāṇām ..
yaḥ kuryātkimu nṛpapuṃgaveha samyakchāṃtātmā hariharapurameti jaṃtuḥ .. 38 ..
sadācāradharmavarṇanam
4.204.d:
दुःस्वप्नं प्रशभमुपैति पठ्यमाने शैलेन्द्रे भवभयभेदने नराणाम् ॥
यः कुर्यात्किमु नृपपुंगवेह सम्यक्छांतात्मा हरिहरपुरमेति जंतुः ॥ 38 ॥
सदाचारधर्मवर्णनम्
4.204.m:
When this lord of mountains that breaks the fear of worldly existence is recited, a bad dream is immediately subdued for men; / what need be said of a person who fully performs it here with a tranquil soul, O best of kings? He goes to the city of Hari and Hara.
Description of the Practice of Proper Conduct

4.205.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
pratipankramayogena tithīnāṃ vistaraḥ śrutaḥ ..
sarahasyaḥ samaṃtraśca prāraṃbhodyāpanaiḥ saha .. 1 ..
4.205.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
प्रतिपन्क्रमयोगेन तिथीनां विस्तरः श्रुतः ॥
सरहस्यः समंत्रश्च प्रारंभोद्यापनैः सह ॥ 1 ॥
4.205.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / 'Starting from the first lunar day, in proper order, the extensive account of lunar days has been heard / along with the secret doctrine, with mantras, and with beginnings and concluding rites.

4.205.s:
navagrahamakhātsarvaṃ homakarmāvadhāritam ..
snānakramaśca vidito vijñātāścotsavā mayā .. 2 ..
4.205.d:
नवग्रहमखात्सर्वं होमकर्मावधारितम् ॥
स्नानक्रमश्च विदितो विज्ञाताश्चोत्सवा मया ॥ 2 ॥
4.205.m: Beginning with the sacrifice to the nine planets, all the homa ritual has been understood; / and the sequence of bathings has been learned, and festivals have been comprehended by me.

4.205.s:
dānadharmastvaśeṣeṇa śrutaḥ sarvārthadarśitaḥ ..
taḍāgotsarjanavidhirviditaḥ pādapotsavaḥ .. 3 ..
4.205.d:
दानधर्मस्त्वशेषेण श्रुतः सर्वार्थदर्शितः ॥
तडागोत्सर्जनविधिर्विदितः पादपोत्सवः ॥ 3 ॥
4.205.m: The duty of gifting has been heard completely, revealing all ends of life; / the rule for the dedication of ponds has been learned, and the festival of trees.

4.205.s:
evaṃ gataṃ mama mano muhyate madhusūdana ..
vrataṃ kathayatā kṛṣṇa tāstāḥ saṃśritya devatāḥ .. 4 ..
4.205.d:
एवं गतं मम मनो मुह्यते मधुसूदन ॥
व्रतं कथयता कृष्ण तास्ताः संश्रित्य देवताः ॥ 4 ॥
4.205.m: Yet, turning thus, my mind is bewildered, O Madhusūdana! / While you described votive observances, O Kṛṣṇa, taking refuge in various deities,

4.205.s:
devānāṃ devakīputra nānātvaṃ saṃpradarśitam ..
tithikramānkathayatā pūjāmantrodhivāsanam .. 5 ..
4.205.d:
देवानां देवकीपुत्र नानात्वं संप्रदर्शितम् ॥
तिथिक्रमान्कथयता पूजामन्त्रोधिवासनम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.205.m: Multiplicity of gods has been demonstrated, O son of Devakī, / while narrating the sequence of lunar days, worship, mantras, and preliminary consecration.

4.205.s:
vyāsādyairmunibhiḥ sarvairdhyānayogaparāyaṇaiḥ ..
eka evātra nirdiṣṭo devaḥ sarvagato'vyayaḥ .. 6 ..
4.205.d:
व्यासाद्यैर्मुनिभिः सर्वैर्ध्यानयोगपरायणैः ॥
एक एवात्र निर्दिष्टो देवः सर्वगतोऽव्ययः ॥ 6 ॥
