4.205.m: By all the sages beginning with Vyāsa, devoted to the yoga of meditation, / only one all-pervading, imperishable God has been pointed out here.

4.205.s:
varṇāśramācāradharmaḥ kasmānnātra pradarśitaḥ ..
ete maharṣayastuṣṭāḥ śrotukāmā bhavadvacaḥ .. 7 ..
4.205.d:
वर्णाश्रमाचारधर्मः कस्मान्नात्र प्रदर्शितः ॥
एते महर्षयस्तुष्टाः श्रोतुकामा भवद्वचः ॥ 7 ॥
4.205.m: Why has the righteous conduct of the classes and life-stages not been expounded here? / These great sages are satisfied and wish to hear your word.'

4.205.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
vratadānaikaleśoyaṃ kathitastava pārthiva ..
viśeṣataśca śaknoti vaktuṃ yadi sarasvatī .. 8 ..
4.205.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
व्रतदानैकलेशोयं कथितस्तव पार्थिव ॥
विशेषतश्च शक्नोति वक्तुं यदि सरस्वती ॥ 8 ॥
4.205.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / 'Only a single fraction of votive observances and gifts has been spoken to you, O king; / and even Sarasvatī could speak of them in detail [only with difficulty].

4.205.s:
sarvastarati durgāṇi sarvo bhadrāṇi paśyati ..
varṇāśramāṇāṃ sāmānya iti dharmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 9 ..
4.205.d:
सर्वस्तरति दुर्गाणि सर्वो भद्राणि पश्यति ॥
वर्णाश्रमाणां सामान्य इति धर्मः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 9 ॥
4.205.m: Everyone crosses over difficulties; everyone sees good things: / this is declared as the common duty for the classes and life-stages.

4.205.s:
kathito'yaṃ vratatvoho devānuddiśya yo mayā ..
paramārthaḥ sa evokto devastamupadhāraya .. 4.205.10 ..
4.205.d:
कथितोऽयं व्रतत्वोहो देवानुद्दिश्य यो मया ॥
परमार्थः स एवोक्तो देवस्तमुपधारय ॥ 4.205.10 ॥
4.205.m: This collection of votive observances that has been described by me with reference to the deities / is declared as the supreme reality itself; understand that God!

4.205.s:
yo brahmā sa hariḥ prokto yo hariḥ sa maheśvaraḥ ..
maheśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ sūryaḥ sūryaḥ pāvaka ucyate .. .. 11 ..
4.205.d:
यो ब्रह्मा स हरिः प्रोक्तो यो हरिः स महेश्वरः ॥
महेश्वरः स्मृतः सूर्यः सूर्यः पावक उच्यते ॥ ॥ 11 ॥
4.205.m: He who is Brahmā is said to be Hari; he who is Hari is Maheśvara; / Maheśvara is remembered as Sūrya; Sūrya is said to be the Fire.

4.205.s:
pāvakaḥ kārtikeyosau kārtikeyo vināyakaḥ ..
gaurī lakṣmīśca sāvitrī śaktibhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .. 12 ..
4.205.d:
पावकः कार्तिकेयोसौ कार्तिकेयो विनायकः ॥
गौरी लक्ष्मीश्च सावित्री शक्तिभेदाः प्रकीर्तिताः ॥ 12 ॥
4.205.m: That Fire is Kārttikeya; Kārttikeya is Vināyaka; / Gaurī, Lakṣmī, and Sāvitrī are declared to be differentiations of Śakti.

4.205.s:
devaṃ devīṃ samuddiśya yaḥ karoti vrataṃ naraḥ ..
na bhedastatra maṃtavyaḥ śivaśaktimayaṃ jagat .. 13 ..
4.205.d:
देवं देवीं समुद्दिश्य यः करोति व्रतं नरः ॥
न भेदस्तत्र मंतव्यः शिवशक्तिमयं जगत् ॥ 13 ॥
4.205.m: Whatever votive observance a man performs dedicated to a god or a goddess, / no distinction is to be considered there; the world is made of Śiva and Śakti.'

4.205.s:
bahuprakārā vasudhā bhedāḥ sāgnyanilāṃbhasām ..
paramārthataściṃtyamāno na bhedaḥ pratibhāsate .. 14 ..
4.205.d:
बहुप्रकारा वसुधा भेदाः साग्न्यनिलांभसाम् ॥
परमार्थतश्चिंत्यमानो न भेदः प्रतिभासते ॥ 14 ॥
4.205.m: The earth has many forms, and there are varieties of fire, wind, and water; / when considered in the highest sense, no division is perceived.

4.205.s:
kañciddevaṃ samāśritya karoti kimapi vratam ..
trayīdharmānugaṃ pārtha ekaṃ tatrāpi kāraṇam .. 15 ..
4.205.d:
कञ्चिद्देवं समाश्रित्य करोति किमपि व्रतम् ॥
त्रयीधर्मानुगं पार्थ एकं तत्रापि कारणम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.205.m: Taking refuge in whichever deity, one performs whatever votive observance / in accordance with the duty prescribed by the triple Veda, O son of Pṛthā, yet even there the cause is one.

4.205.s:
yaścaiva te mayā khyāto vratadānavidhiḥ paraḥ ..
saphalaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ sadācāravatāṃ satām .. 16 ..
4.205.d:
यश्चैव ते मया ख्यातो व्रतदानविधिः परः ॥
सफलः स तु विज्ञेयः सदाचारवतां सताम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.205.m: And whatever supreme rule of votive observances and gifts has been spoken of by me to you, / that should be understood as fruitful for virtuous men endowed with good conduct.

4.205.s:
ācārahīnaṃ na punaṃti vedā yadyapyadhītāḥ saha ṣaḍbhiraṅgaiḥ ..
chaṃdāṃsyenaṃ mṛtyukāle tyajaṃti nīḍaṃ śakuntā iva jātapakṣāḥ .. 17 ..
4.205.d:
आचारहीनं न पुनंति वेदा यद्यप्यधीताः सह षड्भिरङ्गैः ॥
छंदांस्येनं मृत्युकाले त्यजंति नीडं शकुन्ता इव जातपक्षाः ॥ 17 ॥
4.205.m: The Vedas do not purify one who is devoid of good conduct, even if studied along with the six limbs; / at the time of death, the Vedic meters abandon him, just as fledglings with grown wings abandon their nest.

4.205.s:
kapālasthaṃ yathā toyaṃ śvadṛtau vā yathā payaḥ ..
duṣṭaṃ syātsthānadoṣeṇa vṛttahīne tathā śubham .. 18 ..
4.205.d:
कपालस्थं यथा तोयं श्वदृतौ वा यथा पयः ॥
दुष्टं स्यात्स्थानदोषेण वृत्तहीने तथा शुभम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.205.m: Just as water kept in a skull, or milk kept in a dog's leather bag, / becomes defiled due to the fault of its vessel, so auspicious deeds [become defiled] in one devoid of good conduct.

4.205.s:
vṛttaṃ yatnena saṃrakṣedvittameti prayāti ca ..
ahīno vittato hīno vṛttatastu hato hataḥ .. 19 ..
4.205.d:
वृत्तं यत्नेन संरक्षेद्वित्तमेति प्रयाति च ॥
अहीनो वित्ततो हीनो वृत्ततस्तु हतो हतः ॥ 19 ॥
4.205.m: One should preserve one's character with effort; wealth comes and goes. / One who is deficient in wealth is not ruined, but one who is ruined in character is utterly ruined.

4.205.s:
evamācāradharmasya mūlaṃ rājankulasya ca ..
ācārāddhi cyuto jaṃturna kulīno na dhārmikaḥ .. 4.205.20..
4.205.d:
एवमाचारधर्मस्य मूलं राजन्कुलस्य च ॥
आचाराद्धि च्युतो जंतुर्न कुलीनो न धार्मिकः ॥ 4.205.20॥
4.205.m: Thus good conduct is the root of dharma and of family, O king; / for a creature fallen from good conduct is neither of noble family nor righteous.

4.205.s:
kiṃ kulenopadiṣṭen vipulena durātmanām ..
kṛmayaḥ kiṃ na jāyaṃte kusumeṣu sugaṃdhiṣu .. 21 ..
4.205.d:
किं कुलेनोपदिष्टेन् विपुलेन दुरात्मनाम् ॥
कृमयः किं न जायंते कुसुमेषु सुगंधिषु ॥ 21 ॥
4.205.m: What is the use of an extensive lineage declared for the wicked? / Do worms not arise in fragrant flowers?

4.205.s:
hīnajātiprasūtopi śaucācārasamanvitaḥ ..
sarvadharmārthakuśalaḥ sakulīnaḥ satāṃ varaḥ .. 22 ..
4.205.d:
हीनजातिप्रसूतोपि शौचाचारसमन्वितः ॥
सर्वधर्मार्थकुशलः सकुलीनः सतां वरः ॥ 22 ॥
4.205.m: Even one born in a low caste, if endowed with purity and good conduct, / skilled in the meaning of all dharma, is noble-born and the best among the virtuous.

4.205.s:
na kulaṃ kulamityāhurācāraḥ kulamucyate ..
ācārakuśalo rājanniha cāmutra naṃdate .. 23 ..
4.205.d:
न कुलं कुलमित्याहुराचारः कुलमुच्यते ॥
आचारकुशलो राजन्निह चामुत्र नंदते ॥ 23 ॥
4.205.m: They do not say that family is family; conduct is called family. / O king, one skilled in conduct rejoices here and in the hereafter.

4.205.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
sadācāramahaṃ kṛṣṇa śrotumicchāmi śāśvatam ..
sarvaṃ dharmamayaḥ ko'tra sadācāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 24 ..
4.205.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
सदाचारमहं कृष्ण श्रोतुमिच्छामि शाश्वतम् ॥
सर्वं धर्ममयः कोऽत्र सदाचारः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 24 ॥
4.205.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O Kṛṣṇa, I wish to hear of eternal good conduct. / What is proclaimed here as good conduct, full of all dharma?

4.205.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ācāraprabhavo dharmaḥ saṃtaścācāralakṣaṇāḥ ..
sādhūnāṃ ca yathā vṛttaṃ sa sadācāra ucyate .. 29 ..
4.205.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
आचारप्रभवो धर्मः संतश्चाचारलक्षणाः ॥
साधूनां च यथा वृत्तं स सदाचार उच्यते ॥ 29 ॥
4.205.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Dharma arises from conduct, and the virtuous are characterized by conduct; / and that which is the behavior of the good, that is called good conduct.

4.205.s:
tasmātkuryādihācāraṃ ya icchedgatimātmanaḥ ..
api pāpaśarīrasya ācāro haṃtyalakṣaṇam .. 26 ..
4.205.d:
तस्मात्कुर्यादिहाचारं य इच्छेद्गतिमात्मनः ॥
अपि पापशरीरस्य आचारो हंत्यलक्षणम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.205.m: Therefore, one who desires his own high destination should practice good conduct here. / Even of one with a sinful body, conduct destroys inauspicious marks.

4.205.s:
adṛṣṭamaśrutaṃ vedaṃ puruṣaṃ dharmacāriṇam ..
svāni karmāṇi kurvāṇaṃ taṃ janaṃ kurute priyam .. 27 ..
4.205.d:
अदृष्टमश्रुतं वेदं पुरुषं धर्मचारिणम् ॥
स्वानि कर्माणि कुर्वाणं तं जनं कुरुते प्रियम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.205.m: A man unseen and unheard of, who practices dharma according to the Veda, / performing his own duties—people hold him dear.

4.205.s:
ye nāstikā naiṣṭhikāśca guruśāstrātilaṃghinaḥ ..
adharmajñā durācārāste bhavaṃti gatāyuṣaḥ .. 28 ..
4.205.d:
ये नास्तिका नैष्ठिकाश्च गुरुशास्त्रातिलंघिनः ॥
अधर्मज्ञा दुराचारास्ते भवंति गतायुषः ॥ 28 ॥
4.205.m: Those who are nihilists, [hypocritical] perpetual students, and transgressors of the guru and scriptures, / ignorant of dharma and wicked in conduct—they become short-lived.

4.205.s:
sarvalakṣaṇahīnopi yaḥ sadācāravānnaraḥ ..
śraddadhānonasūyaśca sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 29 ..
4.205.d:
सर्वलक्षणहीनोपि यः सदाचारवान्नरः ॥
श्रद्दधानोनसूयश्च सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥ 29 ॥
4.205.m: Even a man devoid of all auspicious marks, if endowed with good conduct, / trusting and ungrudging, obtains all desired objects.

4.205.s:
brāhme muhūrte budhyeta dharmārthāvanucintayet ..
brāhmaṇānalago sūryānna meheta kadācana .. 4.205.30 ..
4.205.d:
ब्राह्मे मुहूर्ते बुध्येत धर्मार्थावनुचिन्तयेत् ॥
ब्राह्मणानलगो सूर्यान्न मेहेत कदाचन ॥ 4.205.30 ॥
4.205.m: He should wake in the hour of Brahman and reflect on dharma and wealth; / he should never urinate facing a brāhmaṇa, fire, a cow, or the sun.

4.205.s:
udaṅmukho divārātrāvutsargaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ..
utthāyācamya tiṣṭheta pūrvāṃ saṃdhyāṃ samāhitaḥ .. 31 ..
4.205.d:
उदङ्मुखो दिवारात्रावुत्सर्गं दक्षिणामुखः ॥
उत्थायाचम्य तिष्ठेत पूर्वां संध्यां समाहितः ॥ 31 ॥
4.205.m: Facing north by day and facing south by night for excretion; / having arisen and sipped water, he should stand composed for the morning twilight devotion.

4.205.s:
evamevottarāṃ saṃdhyāṃ samupāsīta vāgyataḥ ..
nekṣetādityamudyantaṃ nāstaṃ yāṃtaṃ kadācana .. 32 ..
4.205.d:
एवमेवोत्तरां संध्यां समुपासीत वाग्यतः ॥
नेक्षेतादित्यमुद्यन्तं नास्तं यांतं कदाचन ॥ 32 ॥
4.205.m: In the very same way, restraining his speech, he should worship the evening twilight devotion; / he should never look at the rising sun, nor at the setting sun.

4.205.s:
ṛṣayo dīrghatapasā dīrghamāyuravāpnuyuḥ ..
upāsate yena pūrvāṃ dvijāḥ saṃdhyāṃ na paścimām .. 33 ..
4.205.d:
ऋषयो दीर्घतपसा दीर्घमायुरवाप्नुयुः ॥
उपासते येन पूर्वां द्विजाः संध्यां न पश्चिमाम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.205.m: Through long asceticism, the sages attain a long lifespan; / therefore, twice-born men attend the morning twilight devotion, not neglecting the evening one.

4.205.s:
sarvāṃstāndhārmiko rājā śūdrakarmaṇi yojayet ..
ābādhāsu yathākāmaṃ kuryānmūtrapurīṣayoḥ .. 34 ..
4.205.d:
सर्वांस्तान्धार्मिको राजा शूद्रकर्मणि योजयेत् ॥
आबाधासु यथाकामं कुर्यान्मूत्रपुरीषयोः ॥ 34 ॥
4.205.m: A righteous king should assign all of those [who neglect it] to the work of a śūdra. / In case of distress, one may pass urine and feces as one pleases,

4.205.s:
śirasā prāvṛtenaiva samāstīrya tṛṇairmahīm ..
grāmāvasathatīrthānāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ caiva vartmani .. 35 ..
4.205.d:
शिरसा प्रावृतेनैव समास्तीर्य तृणैर्महीम् ॥
ग्रामावसथतीर्थानां क्षेत्राणां चैव वर्त्मनि ॥ 35 ॥
4.205.m: only with the head covered, having strewn the ground with grass. / On the path of villages, dwellings, sacred fords, and fields,

4.205.s:
na mūtramadhitiṣṭheta na kṛṣṭe na ca govraje ..
antarjalādāvasathādvalmīkānmūṣakasthalāt .. 36 ..
4.205.d:
न मूत्रमधितिष्ठेत न कृष्टे न च गोव्रजे ॥
अन्तर्जलादावसथाद्वल्मीकान्मूषकस्थलात् ॥ 36 ॥
4.205.m: he should not discharge urine, nor on plowed ground, nor in a cowpen. / From within water, from a dwelling, from an anthill, from a mouse-hole,

4.205.s:
kṛtaśaucāvaśiṣṭāśca varjayetpañca vai mṛdaḥ ..
devārcanādikāryāṇi tathā gurvabhivādanam .. 37 ..
4.205.d:
कृतशौचावशिष्टाश्च वर्जयेत्पञ्च वै मृदः ॥
देवार्चनादिकार्याणि तथा गुर्वभिवादनम् ॥ 37 ॥
4.205.m: and the remnants of earth used for purification—one must avoid these five kinds of earth. / Actions such as the worship of deities, and likewise saluting the guru,

4.205.s:
kurvīta samyagācamya tadvadannabhuji kriyām ..
aphenaśabdagaṃdhābhiradbhiracchābhirādarāt .. .. 38 ..
4.205.d:
कुर्वीत सम्यगाचम्य तद्वदन्नभुजि क्रियाम् ॥
अफेनशब्दगंधाभिरद्भिरच्छाभिरादरात् ॥ ॥ 38 ॥
4.205.m: he should perform having properly sipped water, and likewise the act of eating food, / with water that is free of foam, sound, and smell, and is clear, with due care.

4.205.s:
ācāmetprayataḥ samyakprāṅmukhodaṅmukho'pi vā ..
trivargasādhane yacca sadā kāryaṃ vipaścitā .. 39 ..
4.205.d:
आचामेत्प्रयतः सम्यक्प्राङ्मुखोदङ्मुखोऽपि वा ॥
त्रिवर्गसाधने यच्च सदा कार्यं विपश्चिता ॥ 39 ॥
4.205.m: Pure, he should sip water properly, facing east or facing north. / And what is always to be done by a wise man in accomplishing the three aims of life,

4.205.s:
tatsāṃnidhye gṛhasthasya siddhiratra paratra ca ..
pādena kāryaṃ pāratryaṃ pādaṃ kuryācca saṃcaye .. 4.205.40 ..
4.205.d:
तत्सांनिध्ये गृहस्थस्य सिद्धिरत्र परत्र च ॥
पादेन कार्यं पारत्र्यं पादं कुर्याच्च संचये ॥ 4.205.40 ॥
4.205.m: in its presence lies the householder's success here and hereafter. / With one quarter he should perform what belongs to the next world, and one quarter he should put into savings;

4.205.s:
ardhenāhāracaraṇanityanaimittikāṃtakam ..
arthasyopārjane yatnaḥ sadā kāryo vipaścitaiḥ .. 41 ..
4.205.d:
अर्धेनाहारचरणनित्यनैमित्तिकांतकम् ॥
अर्थस्योपार्जने यत्नः सदा कार्यो विपश्चितैः ॥ 41 ॥
4.205.m: with half, [he should provide for] food, conduct, and obligatory and occasional rites. / Effort should always be made by the wise in acquiring wealth,

4.205.s:
tatsaṃsiddhau hi siddhyanti dharmakāmādayo nṛpa ..
keśaprasādhanādarśadarśanaṃ daṃtadhāvanam .. 42 ..
4.205.d:
तत्संसिद्धौ हि सिद्ध्यन्ति धर्मकामादयो नृप ॥
केशप्रसाधनादर्शदर्शनं दंतधावनम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.205.m: for upon its achievement, dharma, pleasure, and the rest are indeed achieved, O king. / Dressing the hair, looking into a mirror, cleaning the teeth,

4.205.s:
pūrvāhna eva kāryāṇi devatānāṃ ca pūjanam ..
dūrādāvasathānmūtraṃ dūrātpādāvasecanam .. 43 ..
4.205.d:
पूर्वाह्न एव कार्याणि देवतानां च पूजनम् ॥
दूरादावसथान्मूत्रं दूरात्पादावसेचनम् ॥ 43 ॥
4.205.m: and the worship of the deities are to be performed in the forenoon. / Far from the dwelling should be urination, far away the washing of feet,

4.205.s:
ucchiṣṭotsarjanaṃ dūrātsadā kāryaṃ hitaiṣiṇā ..
loṣṭamardī tṛṇacchedī nakhakhādī ca yo naraḥ .. 44 ..
4.205.d:
उच्छिष्टोत्सर्जनं दूरात्सदा कार्यं हितैषिणा ॥
लोष्टमर्दी तृणच्छेदी नखखादी च यो नरः ॥ 44 ॥
4.205.m: and far away the disposal of food remnants should always be done by one seeking his own welfare. / A man who breaks clods, cuts grass, and bites his nails,

4.205.s:
nityocchiṣṭaḥ saṃkarakṛnnehāyurviṃdate mahat ..
nagnāṃ parastriyaṃ nekṣenna paśyedātmanaḥ śakṛt .. 45 ..
4.205.d:
नित्योच्छिष्टः संकरकृन्नेहायुर्विंदते महत् ॥
नग्नां परस्त्रियं नेक्षेन्न पश्येदात्मनः शकृत् ॥ 45 ॥
4.205.m: who is perpetually defiled by food remnants and causes confusion of purity, does not attain a long life here. / He should not look at a naked woman belonging to another, nor should he look at his own feces.

4.205.s:
udakyādarśanasparśaṃ kuryātsaṃbhāṣaṇaṃ na ca ..
nāpsu mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā maithunaṃ vā samācaret .. 46 ..
4.205.d:
उदक्यादर्शनस्पर्शं कुर्यात्संभाषणं न च ॥
नाप्सु मूत्रं पुरीषं वा मैथुनं वा समाचरेत् ॥ 46 ॥
4.205.m: He should not look at, touch, or converse with a menstruating woman; / he should not discharge urine or feces in water, nor engage in sexual intercourse [there].

4.205.s:
nādhitiṣṭhecchakṛnmūtre keśabhasmakapālikān ..
tuṣāṃgārāsthiśīrṇāni rañjuvastrādikāni ca .. 47 ..
4.205.d:
नाधितिष्ठेच्छकृन्मूत्रे केशभस्मकपालिकान् ॥
तुषांगारास्थिशीर्णानि रञ्जुवस्त्रादिकानि च ॥ 47 ॥
4.205.m: He should not step upon feces, urine, hair, ashes, pot-sherds, / chaff, charcoal, broken bones, or cords, garments, and the like.

4.205.s:
dhāriṇo na namedvidvānnāsanaṃ cāpi dāpayet ..
brāhmaṇānpraṇamedvidvānāsanaṃ cāpi dāpayet .. 48 ..
4.205.d:
धारिणो न नमेद्विद्वान्नासनं चापि दापयेत् ॥
ब्राह्मणान्प्रणमेद्विद्वानासनं चापि दापयेत् ॥ 48 ॥
4.205.m: A wise man should not bow to debtors, nor should he offer them a seat. / A wise man should bow to brāhmaṇas and also offer them a seat.

4.205.s:
kṛtāṃjalirupāsīta gacchaṃtaṃ pṛṣṭhatonviyāt ..
na cāsītāsane bhinne bhinnaṃ kāṃsyaṃ ca varjayet .. 49 ..
4.205.d:
कृतांजलिरुपासीत गच्छंतं पृष्ठतोन्वियात् ॥
न चासीतासने भिन्ने भिन्नं कांस्यं च वर्जयेत् ॥ 49 ॥
4.205.m: With palms joined he should wait upon them, and when they depart, follow behind them; / he should not sit upon a broken seat, and he should avoid broken bell-metal.

4.205.s:
nāmuktakeśairbhoktavyaṃ na nagnaḥ snānamācaret ..
svaptavyaṃ naiva nagnena na cocchiṣṭastu saṃviśet .. 4.205.50 ..
4.205.d:
नामुक्तकेशैर्भोक्तव्यं न नग्नः स्नानमाचरेत् ॥
स्वप्तव्यं नैव नग्नेन न चोच्छिष्टस्तु संविशेत् ॥ 4.205.50 ॥
4.205.m: Food should not be eaten with unloosed hair; he should not bathe naked; / he should not sleep naked, nor should he lie down when defiled with food remnants.

4.205.s:
ucchiṣṭo na spṛśecchīrṣaṃ sarve prāṇāstadāśrayāḥ ..
keśagrahānprahārāṃśca śirasyetāni varjayet .. 51 ..
4.205.d:
उच्छिष्टो न स्पृशेच्छीर्षं सर्वे प्राणास्तदाश्रयाः ॥
केशग्रहान्प्रहारांश्च शिरस्येतानि वर्जयेत् ॥ 51 ॥
4.205.m: When defiled with food remnants, he should not touch his head; all the vital breaths reside there. / Pulling of the hair and blows to the head—these he must avoid.

4.205.s:
nānyatra putra śiṣyābhyāṃ śiphayā tāḍanaṃ smṛtam ..
na pāṇibhyāṃ saṃhatābhyāṃ kaṃḍūyedātmanaḥ śiraḥ .. 52 ..
4.205.d:
नान्यत्र पुत्र शिष्याभ्यां शिफया ताडनं स्मृतम् ॥
न पाणिभ्यां संहताभ्यां कंडूयेदात्मनः शिरः ॥ 52 ॥
4.205.m: Except in the case of a son and a student, striking with a reed is not prescribed by tradition. / He should not scratch his head with both hands joined together.

4.205.s:
na cābhīkṣṇaṃ śiraḥsnānaṃ kāryaṃ niṣkāraṇaṃ naraiḥ ..
apraśastaṃ niśi snānaṃ rāhoranyatra darśanāt .. 53 ..
4.205.d:
न चाभीक्ष्णं शिरःस्नानं कार्यं निष्कारणं नरैः ॥
अप्रशस्तं निशि स्नानं राहोरन्यत्र दर्शनात् ॥ 53 ॥
4.205.m: Nor should washing of the head be done constantly by men without cause; / bathing at night is uncommended, except upon the sighting of Rāhu [during an eclipse].

4.205.s:
na bhuktottarakālaṃ ca na gambhīrajalāśaye ..
śiraḥsnānaṃ tu tailena nāṃgaṃ kiṃcidupaspṛśet.. .. 54 ..
4.205.d:
न भुक्तोत्तरकालं च न गम्भीरजलाशये ॥
शिरःस्नानं तु तैलेन नांगं किंचिदुपस्पृशेत्॥ ॥ 54 ॥
4.205.m: Nor [should he bathe] immediately after eating, nor in a deep body of water. / In washing the head with oil, he should not touch any other limb.

4.205.s:
tilapiṣṭaṃ ca nāśnīyāttathāsyāyurna hīyate ..
duṣkṛtaṃ na gurorbhūyātkruddhaṃ cainaṃ prasādayet ..55..
4.205.d:
तिलपिष्टं च नाश्नीयात्तथास्यायुर्न हीयते ॥
दुष्कृतं न गुरोर्भूयात्क्रुद्धं चैनं प्रसादयेत् ॥55॥
4.205.m: And he should not eat ground sesame; thus his life does not diminish. / No misdeed should be done toward the guru, and when he is angry, one should appease him.

4.205.s:
parīvādaṃ na śṛṇuyādanyeṣāmapi jalpatām..
sadānupahatastiṣṭhetpraśastāśca tathauṣadhīḥ .. 56 ..
4.205.d:
परीवादं न शृणुयादन्येषामपि जल्पताम्॥
सदानुपहतस्तिष्ठेत्प्रशस्ताश्च तथौषधीः ॥ 56 ॥
4.205.m: He should not listen to censure even when others are chattering. / He should always remain unhurt, and likewise [wear] auspicious herbs

4.205.s:
gāruḍāni ca ratnāni bibhṛyātprayato naraḥ ..
susnigdhāmalakeśaśca sugandhiścāruveṣadhṛk ..57..
4.205.d:
गारुडानि च रत्नानि बिभृयात्प्रयतो नरः ॥
सुस्निग्धामलकेशश्च सुगन्धिश्चारुवेषधृक् ॥57॥
4.205.m: and gems sacred to Garuḍa, a man should carry with care; / with hair well-oiled and clean, fragrant, and wearing handsome attire.

4.205.s:
sitāḥ sumanaso hṛdyā bibhṛyācca naraḥ sadā..
kiṃcitparasvaṃ na harennālpamapyapriyaṃ vadet..58..
4.205.d:
सिताः सुमनसो हृद्या बिभृयाच्च नरः सदा॥
किंचित्परस्वं न हरेन्नाल्पमप्यप्रियं वदेत्॥58॥
4.205.m: A man should always wear white, charming, agreeable flowers; / he must not take anything of another's property, nor speak even a little unpleasantness.

4.205.s:
priyaṃ ca nānṛtaṃ brūyānnānyadoṣānudīrayet ..
nānyāśritaṃ tathā vairaṃ rocayetpuruṣeśvaraḥ..59..
4.205.d:
प्रियं च नानृतं ब्रूयान्नान्यदोषानुदीरयेत् ॥
नान्याश्रितं तथा वैरं रोचयेत्पुरुषेश्वरः॥59॥
4.205.m: He should not speak pleasant falsehood, nor mention the faults of others; / likewise, the lord of men should not take pleasure in hostility directed toward another.

4.205.s:
na duṣṭayānamārohetkūlacchāyā na saṃśrayet ..
vidviṣṭapatitonmattabahuvairādisaṃkaraiḥ ..4.205.60..
4.205.d:
न दुष्टयानमारोहेत्कूलच्छाया न संश्रयेत् ॥
विद्विष्टपतितोन्मत्तबहुवैरादिसंकरैः ॥4.205.60॥
4.205.m: He must not mount a dangerous vehicle; he should not seek shade under a riverbank. / With those who are hated, fallen, mad, having many enemies, and cross-bred,

4.205.s:
baṃdhakībaṃdhakībhartṛkṣudrānṛta kathaiḥ saha ..
tathātivyayaśīlaiśca parivādarataiḥ śaṭhaiḥ ..61..
4.205.d:
बंधकीबंधकीभर्तृक्षुद्रानृत कथैः सह ॥
तथातिव्ययशीलैश्च परिवादरतैः शठैः ॥61॥
4.205.m: with unchaste women, husbands of unchaste women, petty liars in conversation, / likewise with squanderers, those devoted to slander, and rogues,

4.205.s:
budho maitrīṃ na kurvīta naikaḥ paṃthānamāśrayet ..
nāvagāhejjalaughasya vegamagre nareśvarā.62..
4.205.d:
बुधो मैत्रीं न कुर्वीत नैकः पंथानमाश्रयेत् ॥
नावगाहेज्जलौघस्य वेगमग्रे नरेश्वरा.62॥
4.205.m: a wise man should not form a friendship; he should not take a road alone; / he should not plunge into the force of a flood of water ahead, O kings.

4.205.s:
pradīptaṃ veśma na viśennārohecchikharaṃ taroḥ ..
na huṃkuryācchavaṃ caiva śavagandho hi somajaḥ .. 63 ..
4.205.d:
प्रदीप्तं वेश्म न विशेन्नारोहेच्छिखरं तरोः ॥
न हुंकुर्याच्छवं चैव शवगन्धो हि सोमजः ॥ 63 ॥
4.205.m: He must not enter a burning house; he must not climb the top of a tree; / he must not snort with disgust at a corpse, for the smell of a corpse is born of Soma.

4.205.s:
na kuryāddantasaṃvarṣaṃ na kuryāccalanāsikām ..
nāsaṃspṛṣṭamukho brūyācchvāsakāsau ca varjayet .. 64 ..
4.205.d:
न कुर्याद्दन्तसंवर्षं न कुर्याच्चलनासिकाम् ॥
नासंस्पृष्टमुखो ब्रूयाच्छ्वासकासौ च वर्जयेत् ॥ 64 ॥
4.205.m: He should not grind his teeth; he should not wiggle his nose; / he should not speak without touching his mouth, and he should avoid panting and coughing [while speaking].

4.205.s:
noccairhasetsaśabdaṃ ca na muñcetpavanaṃ budhaḥ ..
nakhānna vādayecchiṃdyānna nakhaiśca mahīṃ likhet .. .. 65 ..
4.205.d:
नोच्चैर्हसेत्सशब्दं च न मुञ्चेत्पवनं बुधः ॥
नखान्न वादयेच्छिंद्यान्न नखैश्च महीं लिखेत् ॥ ॥ 65 ॥
4.205.m: A wise man should not laugh loudly with a roar, nor release flatulence audibly; / he should not snap his nails or bite them, nor scratch the earth with his nails.

4.205.s:
na śmaśru bhakṣayeccaiva na loṣṭhāni ca mardayet ..
pādena nākrametpādaṃ na pūjyābhimukhaṃ nayeta ..66..
4.205.d:
न श्मश्रु भक्षयेच्चैव न लोष्ठानि च मर्दयेत् ॥
पादेन नाक्रमेत्पादं न पूज्याभिमुखं नयेत ॥66॥
4.205.m: He should not chew his beard, nor crush clods of earth; / he should not cross foot over foot, nor stretch out his feet toward a venerable person.

4.205.s:
noccāsane samāsīta guroragre kadācana ..
tasmātsadācāraparo bhavetkāmacaro na hi .. 67 ..
4.205.d:
नोच्चासने समासीत गुरोरग्रे कदाचन ॥
तस्मात्सदाचारपरो भवेत्कामचरो न हि ॥ 67 ॥
4.205.m: He should never sit on a high seat in front of his guru; / therefore he should be devoted to right conduct and never act at his own whim.

4.205.s:
lokadvaye śubhaṃ prepsuḥ pretya svarge mahīyate ..
catuṣpathaṃ caityataruṃ śmaśānopavanāni ca .. 68 ..
4.205.d:
लोकद्वये शुभं प्रेप्सुः प्रेत्य स्वर्गे महीयते ॥
चतुष्पथं चैत्यतरुं श्मशानोपवनानि च ॥ 68 ॥
4.205.m: Desiring good fortune in both worlds, he is honoured in heaven after dying. / A crossroads, a caitya tree, cremation grounds, and pleasure gardens,

4.205.s:
duṣṭastrīsaṃnikarṣaṃ ca varjayenniśi sarvadā ..
grīṣmavarṣāsu cacchatrī maunī rātrau vaneṣu ca .. 69 ..
4.205.d:
दुष्टस्त्रीसंनिकर्षं च वर्जयेन्निशि सर्वदा ॥
ग्रीष्मवर्षासु चच्छत्री मौनी रात्रौ वनेषु च ॥ 69 ॥
4.205.m: and contact with wicked women—he should always avoid these at night. / In summer and the rains [he should walk] holding a parasol, and in silence at night and in forests.

4.205.s:
keśāsthikaṇṭakāmedhyabalibhasmatuṣāṃstathā ..
snānārdrāṃ dharaṇīṃ caiva dūrataḥ parivarjayet..4.205.70..
4.205.d:
केशास्थिकण्टकामेध्यबलिभस्मतुषांस्तथा ॥
स्नानार्द्रां धरणीं चैव दूरतः परिवर्जयेत्॥4.205.70॥
4.205.m: Hair, bones, thorns, impure things, offerings, ashes, and chaff, / as well as ground wet from bathing, he should avoid from a distance.

4.205.s:
paṃthā deyo brāhmaṇebhyo rājabhyaḥ strībhya eva ca ..
vidyādhikasya gurviṇyā bhārārtasya mahīyasaḥ..71..
4.205.d:
पंथा देयो ब्राह्मणेभ्यो राजभ्यः स्त्रीभ्य एव च ॥
विद्याधिकस्य गुर्विण्या भारार्तस्य महीयसः॥71॥
4.205.m: The path must be yielded to Brāhmaṇas, kings, and women, / to one superior in learning, to a pregnant woman, to one oppressed by a burden, to an elder,

4.205.s:
mūkāṃdhabadhirāṇāṃ ca mattasyonmattakasya ca ..
upānadvastramālyaṃ ca dhṛtamanyairna dhārayet .. 72 ..
4.205.d:
मूकांधबधिराणां च मत्तस्योन्मत्तकस्य च ॥
उपानद्वस्त्रमाल्यं च धृतमन्यैर्न धारयेत् ॥ 72 ॥
4.205.m: and to the mute, the blind, the deaf, the intoxicated, and the mad. / One should not wear shoes, clothes, or a garland worn by others.

4.205.s:
na hīdṛśamanāyuṣyaṃ loke kiñcana vidyate ..
yādṛśaṃ puruṣasyeha paradāropasevanam ..73..
4.205.d:
न हीदृशमनायुष्यं लोके किञ्चन विद्यते ॥
यादृशं पुरुषस्येह परदारोपसेवनम् ॥73॥
4.205.m: For there is nothing in this world that destroys longevity / so much as a man's pursuit of another's wife.

4.205.s:
na cerṣyā strīṣu kartavyā dārā rakṣyāḥ prayatnataḥ ..
anāyuṣyā bhavedīrṣyā tasmāttāṃ parivarjayet .. 74 ..
4.205.d:
न चेर्ष्या स्त्रीषु कर्तव्या दारा रक्ष्याः प्रयत्नतः ॥
अनायुष्या भवेदीर्ष्या तस्मात्तां परिवर्जयेत् ॥ 74 ॥
4.205.m: Jealousy should not be directed toward women; one's wives must be guarded with effort. / Jealousy is destructive of longevity; therefore one should abandon it.

4.205.s:
mūrkhonmattavyasanino virūpānmāninastathā ..
hīnāṃgānadhikāṃgāṃśca vidyāhīnāṃśca nākṣipet .. 75 ..
4.205.d:
मूर्खोन्मत्तव्यसनिनो विरूपान्मानिनस्तथा ॥
हीनांगानधिकांगांश्च विद्याहीनांश्च नाक्षिपेत् ॥ 75 ॥
4.205.m: The foolish, the mad, the addicted, the deformed, the proud, / those deficient in limbs, those with extra limbs, and the uneducated—he should not revile them.

4.205.s:
pānīyasya kriyā naktaṃ tathaiva dadhisaktavaḥ ..
varjanīyā mahārāja niśīthe bhojanakriyāḥ .. 76 ..
4.205.d:
पानीयस्य क्रिया नक्तं तथैव दधिसक्तवः ॥
वर्जनीया महाराज निशीथे भोजनक्रियाः ॥ 76 ॥
4.205.m: Drinking water at night, and likewise curd-meal, / and eating meals at midnight are to be avoided, O great king.

4.205.s:
nordhvajānuściraṃ tiṣṭhenna rahasyaparo bhavet ..
tadvannopaviśetprājñaḥ pādenākramya vāsanam ..77..
4.205.d:
नोर्ध्वजानुश्चिरं तिष्ठेन्न रहस्यपरो भवेत् ॥
तद्वन्नोपविशेत्प्राज्ञः पादेनाक्रम्य वासनम् ॥77॥
4.205.m: He should not remain long with raised knees; he should not be excessively secretive; / likewise, a wise man should not sit stepping upon the seat with his foot.

4.205.s:
na cātiraktavāsāḥ syāccitrāsitadharo'pi vā ..
na ca kuryādviparyāsaṃ vāsaso na vibhūṣaṇe .. 78 ..
4.205.d:
न चातिरक्तवासाः स्याच्चित्रासितधरोऽपि वा ॥
न च कुर्याद्विपर्यासं वाससो न विभूषणे ॥ 78 ॥
4.205.m: He should not wear garments that are excessively red, variegated, or black; / nor should he invert his garment, nor do so with ornaments.

4.205.s:
strīṃ kṛśāṃ nāvajānīyāddīrghamāyurjijīviṣuḥ ..
brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyaṃ sarvaṃ sarve hyāśīviṣopamāḥ ..79..
4.205.d:
स्त्रीं कृशां नावजानीयाद्दीर्घमायुर्जिजीविषुः ॥
ब्राह्मणं क्षत्रियं सर्वं सर्वे ह्याशीविषोपमाः ॥79॥
4.205.m: One who desires to live a long life should not despise a weak woman, / a Brāhmaṇa, or any Kṣatriya, for all are like venomous serpents.

4.205.s:
hanyādāśīviṣaḥ kruddho yāvatspṛśati daṃṣṭrayā ..
kṣatriyo'pi dahetkruddho yāvatpaśyati tejasā..4.205.80..
4.205.d:
हन्यादाशीविषः क्रुद्धो यावत्स्पृशति दंष्ट्रया ॥
क्षत्रियोऽपि दहेत्क्रुद्धो यावत्पश्यति तेजसा॥4.205.80॥
4.205.m: An enraged venomous serpent strikes only so far as it touches with its fang; / an enraged Kṣatriya burns only so far as he sees with his splendour;

4.205.s:
brāhmaṇaḥ sakulaṃ hanyāddhyāne nāvekṣitena ca ..
nātikalyaṃ nātisāyaṃ na ca madhyaṃ dine tathā..81..
4.205.d:
ब्राह्मणः सकुलं हन्याद्ध्याने नावेक्षितेन च ॥
नातिकल्यं नातिसायं न च मध्यं दिने तथा॥81॥
4.205.m: a Brāhmaṇa destroys one along with one's family through contemplation and a glance. / Neither too early in the morning, nor too late in the evening, nor at midday

4.205.s:
nājñātaiḥ saha gaṃtavyaṃ naikena bahubhiḥ saha ..
nāruṃtudaḥ syānna parokṣavādī na sahī nataḥ .. 82 ..
4.205.d:
नाज्ञातैः सह गंतव्यं नैकेन बहुभिः सह ॥
नारुंतुदः स्यान्न परोक्षवादी न सही नतः ॥ 82 ॥
4.205.m: should one travel with strangers, nor alone, nor with many people. / He should not utter biting words, nor slander behind backs, nor [...]

4.205.s:
rohate cāgninā dagdhaṃ vanaṃ paraśunā hatam ..
vaco duruktabībhatsaṃ na saṃrohati cāśatam .. 83 ..
4.205.d:
रोहते चाग्निना दग्धं वनं परशुना हतम् ॥
वचो दुरुक्तबीभत्सं न संरोहति चाशतम् ॥ 83 ॥
4.205.m: A forest burnt by fire or struck down by an axe grows back; / but a repulsive, ill-spoken word never heals, even after a hundred [years].

4.205.s:
nāstikyaṃ vedaniṃdā ca devatānāṃ ca kutsanam ..
dveṣastaṃbhādimānasya klaibyaṃ ca parivarjayet .. 84 ..
4.205.d:
नास्तिक्यं वेदनिंदा च देवतानां च कुत्सनम् ॥
द्वेषस्तंभादिमानस्य क्लैब्यं च परिवर्जयेत् ॥ 84 ॥
4.205.m: Atheism, reviling the Vedas, abuse of the deities, / malice, haughtiness born of conceit, and unmanliness he should avoid.

4.205.s:
na brāhmaṇaṃ parivadenna nakṣatrāṇi darśayet ..
tithiṃ pakṣasya na brūyādyayāsyāyurna riṣyate .. 85 ..
4.205.d:
न ब्राह्मणं परिवदेन्न नक्षत्राणि दर्शयेत् ॥
तिथिं पक्षस्य न ब्रूयाद्ययास्यायुर्न रिष्यते ॥ 85 ॥
4.205.m: He should not slander a Brāhmaṇa; he should not point out the stars; / he should not announce the tithi of the fortnight, so that his lifespan is not harmed.

4.205.s:
tejo niṣṭhīvya vāsaśca paridhāyācamedbudhaḥ ..
jitāmitro nṛpo yaśca balavānkarmatatparaḥ ..86 ..
4.205.d:
तेजो निष्ठीव्य वासश्च परिधायाचमेद्बुधः ॥
जितामित्रो नृपो यश्च बलवान्कर्मतत्परः ॥86 ॥
4.205.m: Having spat out semen, and having put on a garment, a wise man should sip water. / Where the king has conquered his enemies, is powerful, and is devoted to duty,

4.205.s:
tatra nityaṃ vasetprājñaḥ kṛtakṛtyaḥ patau sukham ..
paurāḥ susaṃhatā yatra satatanyāyavartinaḥ .. 87 ..
4.205.d:
तत्र नित्यं वसेत्प्राज्ञः कृतकृत्यः पतौ सुखम् ॥
पौराः सुसंहता यत्र सततन्यायवर्तिनः ॥ 87 ॥
4.205.m: there a wise man, fulfilled in purpose, should dwell happily under that lord. / Where the citizens are well united and constantly conduct themselves with justice,

4.205.s:
yatra striyo'matsariṇyastatra vāsaḥ sukhodayaḥ ..
yasminkṛṣīvalā rāṣṭre prāyaśo nātibhāṣiṇaḥ .. 88 ..
4.205.d:
यत्र स्त्रियोऽमत्सरिण्यस्तत्र वासः सुखोदयः ॥
यस्मिन्कृषीवला राष्ट्रे प्रायशो नातिभाषिणः ॥ 88 ॥
4.205.m: where women are without jealousy, dwelling there brings about happiness. / In whatever realm the farmers generally do not talk excessively,

4.205.s:
yatrauṣadhānyaśeṣāṇi vasettatra vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
tatra rājanna vastavyaṃ yatraitattritayaṃ sadā .. 89 ..
4.205.d:
यत्रौषधान्यशेषाणि वसेत्तत्र विचक्षणः ॥
तत्र राजन्न वस्तव्यं यत्रैतत्त्रितयं सदा ॥ 89 ॥
4.205.m: and where all medicinal herbs are present, there a discerning person should dwell. / O king, one must never reside where this triad exists:

4.205.s:
jigīṣuḥ pūrvavairaṃ ca janaśca viratotsavaḥ ..
tatra rājanna vastavyaṃ yatra nāsti catuṣṭayam .. 4.205.90 ..
4.205.d:
जिगीषुः पूर्ववैरं च जनश्च विरतोत्सवः ॥
तत्र राजन्न वस्तव्यं यत्र नास्ति चतुष्टयम् ॥ 4.205.90 ॥
4.205.m: an ambitious rival, ancestral enmity, and people devoid of festivals. / O king, one must not reside where four things are absent:

4.205.s:
ṛṇapradātā vaidyaśca śrotriyaḥ sajalā nadī ..
avalokyo na cādarśo malino buddhimattaraiḥ .. 91 ..
4.205.d:
ऋणप्रदाता वैद्यश्च श्रोत्रियः सजला नदी ॥
अवलोक्यो न चादर्शो मलिनो बुद्धिमत्तरैः ॥ 91 ॥
4.205.m: a moneylender, a physician, a Vedic scholar, and a river filled with water. / A dirty mirror must not be looked into by the exceedingly intelligent,

4.205.s:
na ca rātrau mahārāja dīrgharājyamabhīpsatā ..
hemakāragṛhe cānnamaśnīyānna ca viśvaset.. 92 ..
4.205.d:
न च रात्रौ महाराज दीर्घराज्यमभीप्सता ॥
हेमकारगृहे चान्नमश्नीयान्न च विश्वसेत्॥ 92 ॥
4.205.m: nor [should a mirror be looked into] at night, O great king, by one desiring a long reign. / One should not eat food in a goldsmith's house, nor trust him,

4.205.s:
na ca mitraṃ prakurvīta hemakāraṃ kadācana ..
bhinnabhāṃḍaṃ ca khaṭvāṃ ca kukkuraṃ kukkuṭaṃ tathā ..93..
4.205.d:
न च मित्रं प्रकुर्वीत हेमकारं कदाचन ॥
भिन्नभांडं च खट्वां च कुक्कुरं कुक्कुटं तथा ॥93॥
4.205.m: and one should never make a goldsmith a friend. / A broken pot, a [broken] cot, a dog, and a rooster—

4.205.s:
apraśastāni catvāri ye ca vṛkṣāḥ sakaṃṭakāḥ ..
bhinna bhāṃḍe baliḥ prāyaḥ khadvāyāṃ ceha niścayaḥ .. 94 ..
4.205.d:
अप्रशस्तानि चत्वारि ये च वृक्षाः सकंटकाः ॥
भिन्न भांडे बलिः प्रायः खद्वायां चेह निश्चयः ॥ 94 ॥
4.205.m: these four are inauspicious, as are trees that are thorny. / An offering [given] in a broken pot is generally considered wasted, and in a cot it is likewise certain;

4.205.s:
nāśnaṃti pitarastasya yatra kukkurakukkaṭau ..
vṛkṣamūle piśācānāṃ sarveṣāmeva saṃsthitiḥ .. 95 ..
4.205.d:
नाश्नंति पितरस्तस्य यत्र कुक्कुरकुक्कटौ ॥
वृक्षमूले पिशाचानां सर्वेषामेव संस्थितिः ॥ 95 ॥
4.205.m: his ancestors do not eat where there are dogs and roosters. / At the root of a tree is the abode of all piśācas;

4.205.s:
atasteṣāṃ tale bhujannaśnute pūyaśoṇitam ..
asaṃskṛtānnabhuṅmūtraṃ bālādiprabhavaṃ svayam .. 96 ..
4.205.d:
अतस्तेषां तले भुजन्नश्नुते पूयशोणितम् ॥
असंस्कृतान्नभुङ्मूत्रं बालादिप्रभवं स्वयम् ॥ 96 ॥
4.205.m: therefore, eating beneath them, one partakes of pus and blood. / One who eats unconsecrated food eats urine produced by children and others.

4.205.s:
suvāsinīṃ gurviṇīṃ ca vṛddhāṃ bālāturāṃstathā ..
bhojayetsaṃskṛtānnena prathamaṃ caramaṃ gṛhī .. 97 ..
4.205.d:
सुवासिनीं गुर्विणीं च वृद्धां बालातुरांस्तथा ॥
भोजयेत्संस्कृतान्नेन प्रथमं चरमं गृही ॥ 97 ॥
4.205.m: A woman whose husband is alive, a pregnant woman, an elderly woman, children, and the sick / the householder should feed with consecrated food first, and himself last.

4.205.s:
aghaṃ sa kevalaṃ bhuṃkte baddhagovāhanādikam ..
yo bhuṃkte ca bahirjyeṣṭhaprekṣatāmapradāya ca .. 98 ..
4.205.d:
अघं स केवलं भुंक्ते बद्धगोवाहनादिकम् ॥
यो भुंक्ते च बहिर्ज्येष्ठप्रेक्षतामप्रदाय च ॥ 98 ॥
4.205.m: He eats mere sin, like one binding oxen and draught animals, / who eats without having given to elders watching outside.

4.205.s:
vaiśvadevaṃ tataḥ kuryādyāvadāhutayaḥ kramāt ..
prathamāṃ brahmaṇe dadyātprajānāṃ pataye tataḥ .. 99 ..
4.205.d:
वैश्वदेवं ततः कुर्याद्यावदाहुतयः क्रमात् ॥
प्रथमां ब्रह्मणे दद्यात्प्रजानां पतये ततः ॥ 99 ॥
4.205.m: Then he should perform the Vaiśvadeva rite, offering oblations in succession: / he should offer the first to Brahmā, then to the Lord of Creatures,

4.205.s:
tṛtīyāṃ caiva guhyebhyaḥ kaśyapāya tathā parām ..
tataścānumate dadyāddattvā gṛhabaliṃ tataḥ .. 4.205.100 ..
4.205.d:
तृतीयां चैव गुह्येभ्यः कश्यपाय तथा पराम् ॥
ततश्चानुमते दद्याद्दत्त्वा गृहबलिं ततः ॥ 4.205.100 ॥
4.205.m: and the third to the Guhyas, and the next to Kaśyapa; / then he should offer to Anumati, and having then offered the domestic bali,

4.205.s:
pūrvākhyātaṃ mayā yatte nityakarmakriyāvidhau ..
dadyādatha dharitrīṇāṃ dadyāttu maṇikatrayam .. 101 ..
4.205.d:
पूर्वाख्यातं मया यत्ते नित्यकर्मक्रियाविधौ ॥
दद्यादथ धरित्रीणां दद्यात्तु मणिकत्रयम् ॥ 101 ॥
4.205.m: as was declared by me to you before in the rule for daily rites, / he should then make offerings to the Earths, and present three water jars.

4.205.s:
prācyādikramayogena iṃdrādīnāṃ baliṃ kṣipet ..
brahmaṇe cāntarikṣāya sūryāya ca yathākramam ..102..
4.205.d:
प्राच्यादिक्रमयोगेन इंद्रादीनां बलिं क्षिपेत् ॥
ब्रह्मणे चान्तरिक्षाय सूर्याय च यथाक्रमम् ॥102॥
4.205.m: In order starting from the east, he should cast the offering for Indra and the others, / and in proper sequence for Brahmā, the atmosphere, and the Sun.

4.205.s:
viśvebhyaścaiva devebhyo viśvabhūtebhya eva ca ..
kṛtvāpasavyaṃ vāyavyaṃ yakṣmaitatte nivedayet ..103..
4.205.d:
विश्वेभ्यश्चैव देवेभ्यो विश्वभूतेभ्य एव च ॥
कृत्वापसव्यं वायव्यं यक्ष्मैतत्ते निवेदयेत् ॥103॥
4.205.m: And for the Viśvedevas, and indeed for all beings; / having placed [the sacred thread] over the right shoulder toward the northwest, he should offer: 'O consumption, this is yours!'

4.205.s:
tataścāgraṃ samuddhṛtya haṃtakāropakalpitam ..
yathāvidhi yathānyāyaṃ brāhmaṇāyopapādayet ..104..
4.205.d:
ततश्चाग्रं समुद्धृत्य हंतकारोपकल्पितम् ॥
यथाविधि यथान्यायं ब्राह्मणायोपपादयेत् ॥104॥
4.205.m: Then, having set aside the first portion prepared as a haṃtakāra offering, / he should present it to a brāhmaṇa according to rule and right order.

4.205.s:
dattvā vidhibhyo devebhyo gurubhyaḥ suśrutāya ca ..
puṇyagaṃdhāṃbaradharo mālyadhārī nareśvara .. 105 ..
4.205.d:
दत्त्वा विधिभ्यो देवेभ्यो गुरुभ्यः सुश्रुताय च ॥
पुण्यगंधांबरधरो माल्यधारी नरेश्वर ॥ 105 ॥
4.205.m: Having given [offerings] according to rule to the gods, the elders, and an educated [guest], / wearing pure scents and garments, and bearing garlands, O ruler of men,

4.205.s:
naikavastradharo'śnīyānnārdrapādo mahīpate ..
viśuddhavadanaḥ prīto bhuṃjīta na vidiḍmukhaḥ .. 106 ..
4.205.d:
नैकवस्त्रधरोऽश्नीयान्नार्द्रपादो महीपते ॥
विशुद्धवदनः प्रीतो भुंजीत न विदिड्मुखः ॥ 106 ॥
4.205.m: he should not eat wearing a single garment, nor with wet feet, O king; / with a purified face, cheerful, he should eat, not facing an intermediate direction.

4.205.s:
prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi na caivānyamanā naraḥ ..
kutsitena hataṃ caiva jugupsāvadasaṃskṛtam ..107..
4.205.d:
प्राङ्मुखोदङ्मुखो वापि न चैवान्यमना नरः ॥
कुत्सितेन हतं चैव जुगुप्सावदसंस्कृतम् ॥107॥
4.205.m: A man should face east or face north, and not have his mind elsewhere; / [he should not eat food] struck by a despicable person, or prepared with disgust,

4.205.s:
dattvā tu bhuṃkte śiṣṭebhyaḥ kṣudhitebhyastathā gṛhī ..
praśastaśuddhapātreṣu bhuñjītākupito nṛpa .. 108 ..
4.205.d:
दत्त्वा तु भुंक्ते शिष्टेभ्यः क्षुधितेभ्यस्तथा गृही ॥
प्रशस्तशुद्धपात्रेषु भुञ्जीताकुपितो नृप ॥ 108 ॥
4.205.m: but the householder eats after having given to the worthy and to the hungry; / he should eat from praised, clean vessels, unangered, O king.

4.205.s:
nāsaṃdīsaṃsthite pātre nādeśe ca nareśvara ..
nā kāle nātisaṃkīrṇe dattvāgraṃ ca naro mahī .. 109 ..
4.205.d:
नासंदीसंस्थिते पात्रे नादेशे च नरेश्वर ॥
ना काले नातिसंकीर्णे दत्त्वाग्रं च नरो मही ॥ 109 ॥
4.205.m: Nor [should he eat from] a vessel placed on a stool, nor in an improper place, O ruler of men, / nor at an unseasonable time, nor in an excessively crowded space, having given the first portion, a man [on] earth.

4.205.s:
aśnīyāttanmayo bhūtvā pūrvaṃ tu madhuraṃ rasam ..
lavaṇograu tataḥ paścātkaṭutīkṣṇādikaṃ tataḥ .. .. 4.205.110 ..
4.205.d:
अश्नीयात्तन्मयो भूत्वा पूर्वं तु मधुरं रसम् ॥
लवणोग्रौ ततः पश्चात्कटुतीक्ष्णादिकं ततः ॥ ॥ 4.205.110 ॥
4.205.m: He should eat, absorbed in it: first the sweet flavour, / then the salty and pungent, and afterwards the bitter, sharp, and others.

4.205.s:
mārdavaṃ puruṣośnanvai madhye ca kaṭhināśanam ..
aṃte punardravāśī ca naro rogeṇa mucyate ..111..
4.205.d:
मार्दवं पुरुषोश्नन्वै मध्ये च कठिनाशनम् ॥
अंते पुनर्द्रवाशी च नरो रोगेण मुच्यते ॥111॥
4.205.m: A man eating soft food [at first], hard food in the middle, / and eating liquid at the end, is freed from disease.

4.205.s:
divādhānāsu vasati rātrau ca dadhisaktuṣu ..
alakṣmīḥ kovidāreṣu sarvadaiva kṛtālayā .. 112 ..
4.205.d:
दिवाधानासु वसति रात्रौ च दधिसक्तुषु ॥
अलक्ष्मीः कोविदारेषु सर्वदैव कृतालया ॥ 112 ॥
4.205.m: Alakṣmī dwells in fried grains by day and in curds with roasted barley meal at night; / in kovidāra trees she has made her abode at all times.

4.205.s:
aniṃdyaṃ bhakṣayennityaṃ vāgyato'nnamakutsayan ..
bhuktvā samyagyathācamya prāṅmukhodaṅ mukho'pi vā .. 113 ..
4.205.d:
अनिंद्यं भक्षयेन्नित्यं वाग्यतोऽन्नमकुत्सयन् ॥
भुक्त्वा सम्यग्यथाचम्य प्राङ्मुखोदङ् मुखोऽपि वा ॥ 113 ॥
4.205.m: He should always eat blameless food with restrained speech, not finding fault with the food; / having eaten and properly sipped water, facing east or facing north,

4.205.s:
yathāvatpunarācāmetpāṇī prakṣālya yatnataḥ ..
abhīṣṭadevatānāṃ ca kurvīta smaraṇaṃ naraḥ .. 114 ..
4.205.d:
यथावत्पुनराचामेत्पाणी प्रक्षाल्य यत्नतः ॥
अभीष्टदेवतानां च कुर्वीत स्मरणं नरः ॥ 114 ॥
4.205.m: he should carefully wash both hands and sip water again according to rule; / and a man should practice remembrance of his beloved deities:

4.205.s:
prāṇāpānasamānānāmudānavyānayostathā ..
annapuṣṭikaraṃ cāstu mamādyāvyāhataṃ sukham .. 115 ..
4.205.d:
प्राणापानसमानानामुदानव्यानयोस्तथा ॥
अन्नपुष्टिकरं चास्तु ममाद्याव्याहतं सुखम् ॥ 115 ॥
4.205.m: 'May the food bring nourishment to prāṇa, apāna, samāna, / udāna, and vyāna, and unhindered happiness to me today!

4.205.s:
agastiragnirvaḍavānalaśca bhuktaṃ prapātraṃ jarayatvaśeṣam ..
sukhaṃ ca me tatpariṇāmasaṃbhava yacchatvarogaṃ khalu vāsudevaḥ .. 116 ..
4.205.d:
अगस्तिरग्निर्वडवानलश्च भुक्तं प्रपात्रं जरयत्वशेषम् ॥
सुखं च मे तत्परिणामसंभव यच्छत्वरोगं खलु वासुदेवः ॥ 116 ॥
4.205.m: May Agastya, Agni, and the submarine fire completely digest the meal that has been eaten; / and may Vāsudeva truly bestow on me health and the happiness born of its digestion!'

4.205.s:
ityuccārya svahastena pīramārjya tathodaram ..
anāyāsapradāyīti kuryātkarmāṇyataṃdritaḥ..117..
4.205.d:
इत्युच्चार्य स्वहस्तेन पीरमार्ज्य तथोदरम् ॥
अनायासप्रदायीति कुर्यात्कर्माण्यतंद्रितः॥117॥
4.205.m: Having spoken thus and stroked his belly with his own hand, / [saying] 'giver of ease', he should perform his duties unwearied.

4.205.s:
saṃdhyāyāṃ pathikaḥ kaścitsamāgacchati bhārata ..
pādaśaucāsanaiḥ prahvaḥ svāgatoktyā ca pūjayet .. 118 ..
4.205.d:
संध्यायां पथिकः कश्चित्समागच्छति भारत ॥
पादशौचासनैः प्रह्वः स्वागतोक्त्या च पूजयेत् ॥ 118 ॥
4.205.m: If a traveller arrives at twilight, O descendant of Bharata, / he should honour him humbly with washing of the feet, a seat, and words of welcome.

4.205.s:
tataścānnapradānena śayanena ca pārthiva ..
divā tithau ca vimukho yadaikaṃ pātakaṃ bhavet ..119..
4.205.d:
ततश्चान्नप्रदानेन शयनेन च पार्थिव ॥
दिवा तिथौ च विमुखो यदैकं पातकं भवेत् ॥119॥
4.205.m: And then with the gift of food and a bed, O king; / if a guest turns away [unfed] by day, there would be a single sin,

4.205.s:
tadevāṣṭaguṇaṃ puṃsāṃ sūrye haṃsamukhe gate ..
gacchecchayyāmasphuṭitāmapi dārumayīṃ nṛpa .. 4.205.120 ..
4.205.d:
तदेवाष्टगुणं पुंसां सूर्ये हंसमुखे गते ॥
गच्छेच्छय्यामस्फुटितामपि दारुमयीं नृप ॥ 4.205.120 ॥
4.205.m: and that same [sin] becomes eightfold for men when the sun has gone to set. / He should go to a bed made of wood that is not split, O king,

4.205.s:
nāviśālāṃ na vā bhagnāṃ nāsamāṃ malināṃ na ca ..
na ca jaṃtumayīṃ śayyāṃ samātiṣṭhedanāpadi .. 121 ..
4.205.d:
नाविशालां न वा भग्नां नासमां मलिनां न च ॥
न च जंतुमयीं शय्यां समातिष्ठेदनापदि ॥ 121 ॥
4.205.m: nor narrow, nor broken, nor uneven, nor dirty; / nor should he resort to a bed infested with vermin, unless in an emergency.

4.205.s:
prācyāṃ diśi śiraḥ śastaṃ yāmyāyāmapi bhūpate ..
sadaiva svapatāṃ puṃsāṃ viparītaṃ tu rogadam .. 122 ..
4.205.d:
प्राच्यां दिशि शिरः शस्तं याम्यायामपि भूपते ॥
सदैव स्वपतां पुंसां विपरीतं तु रोगदम् ॥ 122 ॥
4.205.m: Sleeping with the head toward the east or toward the south is praised, O king, / for men at all times; but the reverse brings disease.

4.205.s:
ṛtāvupagamaḥ śastaḥ sapatnyāṃ hyavanīpate ..
puṇyarkṣe ca śubhe kāle putrā yugmāsu rātriṣu .. 123 ..
4.205.d:
ऋतावुपगमः शस्तः सपत्न्यां ह्यवनीपते ॥
पुण्यर्क्षे च शुभे काले पुत्रा युग्मासु रात्रिषु ॥ 123 ॥
4.205.m: Approaching one's wife during her season is praised, O king, / under an auspicious constellation and at an auspicious time, [producing] sons on even nights.

4.205.s:
na cāsnātāṃ striyaṃ gacchedgarbhiṇīṃ na rajasvalām ..
nāniṣṭāṃ vai na kupitāṃ nāśastāṃ na ca rogiṇīm .. 124 ..
4.205.d:
न चास्नातां स्त्रियं गच्छेद्गर्भिणीं न रजस्वलाम् ॥
नानिष्टां वै न कुपितां नाशस्तां न च रोगिणीम् ॥ 124 ॥
4.205.m: He should not approach a woman who has not bathed, nor one who is pregnant, nor one who is menstruating, / nor one who is unloved, nor angry, nor inauspicious, nor ill,

4.205.s:
nādakṣiṇāṃ nānyakāmāṃ nākāmāṃ nānyayoṣitam ..
sukṣāmāmatyabhuktāṃ ca svayaṃ caibhirguṇairyutaḥ ..125..
4.205.d:
नादक्षिणां नान्यकामां नाकामां नान्ययोषितम् ॥
सुक्षामामत्यभुक्तां च स्वयं चैभिर्गुणैर्युतः ॥125॥
4.205.m: nor one who is ungracious, nor one desiring another, nor one without desire, nor another's wife, / nor one who is emaciated, nor one who has overeaten; and he himself should possess these [corresponding] qualities.

4.205.s:
snātaḥ sugandhadhṛgdhṛṣṭo na śrāṃtaḥ kṣudhito'pi vā ..
sakāmaḥ sānurāgaśca vyavāyaṃ puruṣo vrajet .. 126 ..
4.205.d:
स्नातः सुगन्धधृग्धृष्टो न श्रांतः क्षुधितोऽपि वा ॥
सकामः सानुरागश्च व्यवायं पुरुषो व्रजेत् ॥ 126 ॥
4.205.m: Bathed, wearing scents, cheerful, not fatigued nor hungry, / desiring and affectionate, a man should engage in sexual union.

4.205.s:
caturdaśyāṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ paṃcadaśyāṃ ca parvasu ..
tailābhyaṃgaṃ tathā bhogānyoṣitaśca vivarjayet .. 127 ..
4.205.d:
चतुर्दश्यां तथाष्टम्यां पंचदश्यां च पर्वसु ॥
तैलाभ्यंगं तथा भोगान्योषितश्च विवर्जयेत् ॥ 127 ॥
4.205.m: On the fourteenth, likewise on the eighth, and on the fifteenth, and on the parvan days, / he should avoid oil massage, sensual pleasures, and women.

4.205.s:
kṣura karmaṇi cāṃte ca strīsaṃbhoge ca bhārata ..
snāyīta cailavānprātaḥ kaṭabhūmimupetya ca .. 128 ..
4.205.d:
क्षुर कर्मणि चांते च स्त्रीसंभोगे च भारत ॥
स्नायीत चैलवान्प्रातः कटभूमिमुपेत्य च ॥ 128 ॥
4.205.m: After shaving, at the end [of an illness], after intercourse with a woman, O descendant of Bharata, / and after visiting a cemetery ground, he should bathe with his clothes on in the morning.

4.205.s:
guroḥ pativratānāṃ ca tathā yajñatapasvinām ..
parivādaṃ na kurvīta parihāse'pi bhārata .. 129 ..
4.205.d:
गुरोः पतिव्रतानां च तथा यज्ञतपस्विनाम् ॥
परिवादं न कुर्वीत परिहासेऽपि भारत ॥ 129 ॥
4.205.m: He should not speak ill of a guru, of devoted wives, / or of sacrificers and ascetics, even in jest, O descendant of Bharata.

4.205.s:
yugapajjalamagniṃ ca bibhṛyānna vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
guruṃ devānprati tathā na ca pādau prasārayet .. 4.205.130 ..
4.205.d:
युगपज्जलमग्निं च बिभृयान्न विचक्षणः ॥
गुरुं देवान्प्रति तथा न च पादौ प्रसारयेत् ॥ 4.205.130 ॥
4.205.m: A wise man should not carry water and fire simultaneously; / nor should he stretch out his feet toward a guru or toward the gods.

4.205.s:
nācakṣīta dhayaṃtīṃ gāṃ jalaṃ nāṃjalinā pibet ..
vātātapau na seveta anutāpaṃ ca varjayet ..131..
4.205.d:
नाचक्षीत धयंतीं गां जलं नांजलिना पिबेत् ॥
वातातपौ न सेवेत अनुतापं च वर्जयेत् ॥131॥
4.205.m: He should not point out a cow suckling a calf; he should not drink water with cupped hands; / he should not expose himself to wind and blazing sun; and he should avoid remorse.

4.205.s:
dāsaṃ śapenna vai kruddhaḥ sarvabandhūnamatsarī ..
bhītāśvāsanakṛtsādhuḥ svargastasyāvyayaṃ phalam .. 132 ..
4.205.d:
दासं शपेन्न वै क्रुद्धः सर्वबन्धूनमत्सरी ॥
भीताश्वासनकृत्साधुः स्वर्गस्तस्याव्ययं फलम् ॥ 132 ॥
4.205.m: He should not curse a servant when angry, free of malice toward all kinsmen; / he who comforts the frightened is virtuous: heaven is his imperishable fruit.

4.205.s:
nordhvaṃ tu pattanadvāraṃ nirīkṣya paryaṭennaraḥ..
yugamātraṃ mahīpṛṣṭhe naro gacchedvilokayan .. 133 ..
4.205.d:
नोर्ध्वं तु पत्तनद्वारं निरीक्ष्य पर्यटेन्नरः॥
युगमात्रं महीपृष्ठे नरो गच्छेद्विलोकयन् ॥ 133 ॥
4.205.m: A man should not wander looking upward at the city gate; / a man should walk gazing only a yoke's length upon the ground.

4.205.s:
śeṣāhe tvapi śeṣāṃśca vaśyātmā yo nirasyati ..
tasya dharmārthakāmānāṃ hānirnālpāpi jāyate .. 134 ..
4.205.d:
शेषाहे त्वपि शेषांश्च वश्यात्मा यो निरस्यति ॥
तस्य धर्मार्थकामानां हानिर्नाल्पापि जायते ॥ 134 ॥
4.205.m: He who, having mastered himself, discards remainder on remaining days, / suffers not even the slightest loss of virtue, wealth, and desire.

4.205.s:
vṛthā māṃsaṃ na khādeta pṛṣṭhamāṃsaṃ tathaiva ca ..
ākrośaṃ ca vivādaṃ ca paiśunyaṃ ca vivarjayet .. 135 ..
4.205.d:
वृथा मांसं न खादेत पृष्ठमांसं तथैव च ॥
आक्रोशं च विवादं च पैशुन्यं च विवर्जयेत् ॥ 135 ॥
4.205.m: He should not eat meat needlessly, nor back-meat; / he should avoid reviling, dispute, and calumny.

4.205.s:
saṃyāvaṃ kṛśaraṃ māṃsaṃ śaṣkulīpāyasaṃ tathā ..
ātmārthe na prakartavyaṃ devatānāṃ prakalpayet .. .. 136 ..
4.205.d:
संयावं कृशरं मांसं शष्कुलीपायसं तथा ॥
आत्मार्थे न प्रकर्तव्यं देवतानां प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ ॥ 136 ॥
4.205.m: Sweet fried dough, kṛśara, meat, cakes, and milk-rice / should not be made for oneself; he should prepare them for the deities.

4.205.s:
ajāśca nāvakarṣeta tā bahirdhārayaṃti ca ..
raktamālyaṃ na dhāryaṃ syācchuklaṃ dhāryaṃ tu paṃḍitaiḥ .. 137 ..
4.205.d:
अजाश्च नावकर्षेत ता बहिर्धारयंति च ॥
रक्तमाल्यं न धार्यं स्याच्छुक्लं धार्यं तु पंडितैः ॥ 137 ॥
4.205.m: He should not drag goats, for they carry outside; / a red garland should not be worn, but white should be worn by the wise,

4.205.s:
varjayitvātra kamalaṃ tathā kuvalayaṃ vibho ..
raktaṃ śirasi dhāryaṃ ca tathā pāneyamityapi .. 138 ..
4.205.d:
वर्जयित्वात्र कमलं तथा कुवलयं विभो ॥
रक्तं शिरसि धार्यं च तथा पानेयमित्यपि ॥ 138 ॥
4.205.m: excepting here the lotus and the blue water-lily, O lord; / red [flowers] may be worn on the head, as well as aquatic ones.

4.205.s:
kāṃcanīyāpi yā mālā sā na duṣyati karhicit ..
anyadeva bhavedvāsaḥ śayanīye narottama .. 139 ..
4.205.d:
कांचनीयापि या माला सा न दुष्यति कर्हिचित् ॥
अन्यदेव भवेद्वासः शयनीये नरोत्तम ॥ 139 ॥
4.205.m: Even a garland made of gold is never defiled; / there should be one garment for the bed, O best of men,

4.205.s:
anyadarcāsu devānāmanyaddhāryaṃ sabhāsu ca ..
pippalaṃ ca vaṭaṃ caiva śīrṇaśleṣmāṃtakaṃ tathā .. 4.205.140 ..
4.205.d:
अन्यदर्चासु देवानामन्यद्धार्यं सभासु च ॥
पिप्पलं च वटं चैव शीर्णश्लेष्मांतकं तथा ॥ 4.205.140 ॥
4.205.m: another for the worship of the gods, and another to be worn in assemblies. / The pippala, the banyan, and the withered śleṣmātaka,

4.205.s:
udubaraṃ na khādeta bhavārthī puruṣottamaḥ ..
patitaiśca kathāṃte ca cchedanaṃ ca vivarjayet .. 141 ..
4.205.d:
उदुबरं न खादेत भवार्थी पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
पतितैश्च कथांते च च्छेदनं च विवर्जयेत् ॥ 141 ॥
4.205.m: and the udumbara he should not eat, if he desires prosperity, O best of men; / he should avoid conversation with fallen persons and causing injury.

4.205.s:
patitaḥ syānnaro rājanpatitaistu sahācaran ..
vṛddho jñātistathā mitraṃ daridro yo bhavediha .. 142 ..
4.205.d:
पतितः स्यान्नरो राजन्पतितैस्तु सहाचरन् ॥
वृद्धो ज्ञातिस्तथा मित्रं दरिद्रो यो भवेदिह ॥ 142 ॥
4.205.m: A man becomes fallen, O king, by associating with the fallen. / An elderly kinsman, a friend, or anyone here who is poor,

4.205.s:
gṛhe vā saṃsthāpitāste gṛhavṛddhimabhīpsatā ..
gṛhe pārāvatā dhanyāḥ śukāśca sahasārikāḥ.. 143 ..
4.205.d:
गृहे वा संस्थापितास्ते गृहवृद्धिमभीप्सता ॥
गृहे पारावता धन्याः शुकाश्च सहसारिकाः॥ 143 ॥
4.205.m: should be settled in the house by one desiring the house's prosperity. / Pigeons in the house bring fortune, as do parrots along with mynas;

4.205.s:
bhavaṃtyete tathā pāpāstathā vai tilapāyikāḥ ..
ājokṣā caṃdanaṃ vīṇā ādarśo madhusarpiṣī .. 144 ..
4.205.d:
भवंत्येते तथा पापास्तथा वै तिलपायिकाः ॥
आजोक्षा चंदनं वीणा आदर्शो मधुसर्पिषी ॥ 144 ॥
4.205.m: these, however, are inauspicious: cockroaches; / a goat-bull, sandalwood, a lute, a mirror, honey, and clarified butter [are auspicious].

4.205.s:
jalāgnī caiva bibhṛyādgṛhe nityamiti sthitiḥ..
dhanurvede ca satataṃ yatnaḥ kāryo narādhipa .. 145 ..
4.205.d:
जलाग्नी चैव बिभृयाद्गृहे नित्यमिति स्थितिः॥
धनुर्वेदे च सततं यत्नः कार्यो नराधिप ॥ 145 ॥
4.205.m: And water and fire one should maintain continually in the home; such is the rule. / And, O ruler of men, constant effort must be made in the science of archery.

4.205.s:
hastipṛṣṭhe'śvapṛṣṭhe ca rathacaryāsu caiva hi..
yatnavānbhava rājendra nayavānsukhamedhate .. 146 ..
4.205.d:
हस्तिपृष्ठेऽश्वपृष्ठे च रथचर्यासु चैव हि॥
यत्नवान्भव राजेन्द्र नयवान्सुखमेधते ॥ 146 ॥
4.205.m: On the back of an elephant, on the back of a horse, and in chariot maneuvers, / be diligent, O king of kings; one who possesses statecraft prospers in happiness.

4.205.s:
prajāpālana yuktaśca na kṣāṃtiṃ labhate nṛpa ..
yajñaśāstraṃ ca vijñāya śabdaśāstraṃ ca bhārata .. 147 ..
4.205.d:
प्रजापालन युक्तश्च न क्षांतिं लभते नृप ॥
यज्ञशास्त्रं च विज्ञाय शब्दशास्त्रं च भारत ॥ 147 ॥
4.205.m: And dedicated to protecting his subjects, a king finds no rest. / Having understood the science of sacrifice and the science of grammar, O Bhārata,

4.205.s:
gāṃdharvaśāstraṃ vijñeyaṃ kalā jñeyāśca bhārata ..
purāṇamitihāsaṃ ca tathākhyānāni yāni ca .. 148 ..
4.205.d:
गांधर्वशास्त्रं विज्ञेयं कला ज्ञेयाश्च भारत ॥
पुराणमितिहासं च तथाख्यानानि यानि च ॥ 148 ॥
4.205.m: the science of music must be understood, and the arts must be understood, O Bhārata, / as well as the Purāṇa, the epic, and whatever narratives there are.

4.205.s:
eṣa te lakṣaṇoddeśa ācārasya prakīrtitaḥ ..
śeṣāśca vedyā vṛddhebhyaḥ pratyāhāryā narādhipa.. 149 ..
4.205.d:
एष ते लक्षणोद्देश आचारस्य प्रकीर्तितः ॥
शेषाश्च वेद्या वृद्धेभ्यः प्रत्याहार्या नराधिप॥ 149 ॥
4.205.m: This brief indication of the characteristics of conduct has been proclaimed to you; / the rest should be learned from the elders and adopted, O ruler of men.

4.205.s:
ācāro bhūtijanana ācāraḥ kīrtivardhanaḥ ..
ācārādvardhate hyāyurācāro haṃtyalakṣaṇam .. 4.205.150 ..
4.205.d:
आचारो भूतिजनन आचारः कीर्तिवर्धनः ॥
आचाराद्वर्धते ह्यायुराचारो हंत्यलक्षणम् ॥ 4.205.150 ॥
4.205.m: Conduct generates prosperity; conduct increases fame; / for from conduct lifespan increases, and conduct destroys inauspicious marks.

4.205.s:
āgamānāṃ hi sarveṣāmācāraḥ śreṣṭha ucyata ..
ācāraḥ paramo dharma ācārādvardhate dhanam .. 151 ..
4.205.d:
आगमानां हि सर्वेषामाचारः श्रेष्ठ उच्यत ॥
आचारः परमो धर्म आचाराद्वर्धते धनम् ॥ 151 ॥
4.205.m: Conduct indeed is spoken of as best among all sacred scriptures; / conduct is the highest dharma; from conduct wealth increases.

4.205.s:
puṇyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ svastyayanaṃ mahat ..
sarvavarṇānukaṃpārthaṃ mayaitatsamudāhṛtam .. .. 152 ..
4.205.d:
पुण्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं स्वर्ग्यं स्वस्त्ययनं महत् ॥
सर्ववर्णानुकंपार्थं मयैतत्समुदाहृतम् ॥ ॥ 152 ॥
4.205.m: Meritorious, bringing fame and longevity, leading to heaven, a great blessing— / this has been proclaimed by me out of compassion for all castes.

4.205.s:
ācāra eva narapuṃgava sevyamāno dharmārthakāmaphalado bhavatīha puṃsām ..
tasmātsadaiva viduṣāvahitena rājañchāstrodito hyanudinaṃ paripālanīyaḥ .. 153 ..
rohiṇīcandraśayanavratavidhivarṇanam
4.205.d:
आचार एव नरपुंगव सेव्यमानो धर्मार्थकामफलदो भवतीह पुंसाम् ॥
तस्मात्सदैव विदुषावहितेन राजञ्छास्त्रोदितो ह्यनुदिनं परिपालनीयः ॥ 153 ॥
रोहिणीचन्द्रशयनव्रतविधिवर्णनम्
4.205.m:
Conduct alone, when practiced, O bull among men, grants men the fruits of dharma, wealth, and pleasure in this world; / therefore, O king, it must always be carefully maintained day by day by the wise man as proclaimed in the scriptures.
Description of the procedure for the Rohiṇīcandraśayana observance.

4.206.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
dīrghāyurārogyakulādivṛddhiyuktaḥ pumānyena guṇānvitaḥ syāt ..
muhurmuhurjanmani yena samyagvrataṃ mama brūhi tadiṃdumauleḥ .. 1 ..
4.206.d:
॥ नारद उवाच ॥ ॥
दीर्घायुरारोग्यकुलादिवृद्धियुक्तः पुमान्येन गुणान्वितः स्यात् ॥
मुहुर्मुहुर्जन्मनि येन सम्यग्व्रतं मम ब्रूहि तदिंदुमौलेः ॥ 1 ॥
4.206.m: Nārada said: / Tell me that observance of the moon-crested [god], practiced properly, by which a man may possess long life, health, increase of family and the like, / and be endowed with virtues birth after birth.

4.206.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
tvayā pṛṣṭamidaṃ samyagamutrākṣayakārakam ..
rahasyaṃ te pravakṣyāmi yatpurāṇavido viduḥ .. 2 ..
4.206.d:
॥ श्रीभगवानुवाच ॥ ॥
त्वया पृष्टमिदं सम्यगमुत्राक्षयकारकम् ॥
रहस्यं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि यत्पुराणविदो विदुः ॥ 2 ॥
4.206.m: The Blessed Lord said: / This question asked by you is excellent and brings imperishable reward in the other world. / I shall tell you the secret that those versed in the Purāṇas know.

4.206.s:
rohiṇīcandraśayanaṃ nāma vratamihottamam ..
tasminnārāyaṇasyārccāmarccayediṃdunāmabhiḥ .. 3 ..
4.206.d:
रोहिणीचन्द्रशयनं नाम व्रतमिहोत्तमम् ॥
तस्मिन्नारायणस्यार्च्चामर्च्चयेदिंदुनामभिः ॥ 3 ॥
4.206.m: The observance here named Rohiṇīcandraśayana is supreme; / in it one should worship the image of Nārāyaṇa with the names of the moon.

4.206.s:
yadā somadinayuktā bhavetpaṃcadaśī kvacit ..
atha vā brahmanakṣatraṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ prajāyate .. 4 ..
4.206.d:
यदा सोमदिनयुक्ता भवेत्पंचदशी क्वचित् ॥
अथ वा ब्रह्मनक्षत्रं पौर्णमास्यां प्रजायते ॥ 4 ॥
4.206.m: When the fifteenth lunar day is joined with Monday, / or else the asterism of Brahmā falls on a full moon day,

4.206.s:
tadā snānaṃ naraḥ kuryātpaṃcagavyaṃ ca sarṣapaiḥ ..
āpyāyasveti ca japedvidvānaṣṭaśataṃ punaḥ .. .. 5 ..
4.206.d:
तदा स्नानं नरः कुर्यात्पंचगव्यं च सर्षपैः ॥
आप्यायस्वेति च जपेद्विद्वानष्टशतं पुनः ॥ ॥ 5 ॥
4.206.m: then a man should bathe with the five products of the cow and with mustard seeds; / and the learned man should recite [the mantra] "Āpyāyasva..." one hundred and eight times.

4.206.s:
śūdro'pi parayā bhaktyā pākhaṃḍālāpavarjitaḥ ..
somāya varadāyātha viṣṇave ca namonamaḥ .. 6 ..
4.206.d:
शूद्रोऽपि परया भक्त्या पाखंडालापवर्जितः ॥
सोमाय वरदायाथ विष्णवे च नमोनमः ॥ 6 ॥
4.206.m: Even a śūdra, endowed with supreme devotion and avoiding speech with heretics, [should recite:] / "Obeisance, obeisance to Soma, the giver of boons, and to Viṣṇu."

4.206.s:
kṛtajapyaḥ svabhavanamāgatya madhusūdanam ..
pūjayetphalapuṣpaiśca somanāmāni kīrtayet .. 7 ..
4.206.d:
कृतजप्यः स्वभवनमागत्य मधुसूदनम् ॥
पूजयेत्फलपुष्पैश्च सोमनामानि कीर्तयेत् ॥ 7 ॥
4.206.m: Having performed his recitation and returned to his home, / he should worship Madhusūdana with fruits and flowers, and chant the names of the moon.

4.206.s:
somāya śāṃtāya namo'stu pādāvanaṃtanāmne hyanujānu jaṃghe ..
ūrudvayaṃ cāpi vṛkodarāya saṃpūjayenmeḍhramanaṃgabāhave .. 8 ..
4.206.d:
सोमाय शांताय नमोऽस्तु पादावनंतनाम्ने ह्यनुजानु जंघे ॥
ऊरुद्वयं चापि वृकोदराय संपूजयेन्मेढ्रमनंगबाहवे ॥ 8 ॥
4.206.m: With "Obeisance to Soma, the peaceful," the two feet; with "To him named Ananta," the shanks below the knees; / and the two thighs with "To Vṛkodara"; he should worship the penis with "To Anaṅgabāhu";

4.206.s:
namonamaḥ kāmasukhapradāya kaṭiḥ śaśāṃkasya samarcanīyā ..
tathodaraṃ cāpyamṛtodarāya nābhiḥ supūjyā vidhilocanāya .. 9 ..
4.206.d:
नमोनमः कामसुखप्रदाय कटिः शशांकस्य समर्चनीया ॥
तथोदरं चाप्यमृतोदराय नाभिः सुपूज्या विधिलोचनाय ॥ 9 ॥
4.206.m: with "Obeisance, obeisance to the giver of the pleasure of desire," the hips of the moon are to be worshipped; / likewise the belly with "To him of nectar-belly"; the navel is to be well worshipped with "To Vidhilocana";

4.206.s:
namo'stu candrāya mukhaṃ prapūjya hanurdvijānāmadhipāya pūjyā ..
āsyaṃ namaścaṃdramasebhipūjyamoṣṭhau kumutkhaṃḍavanapriyāya .. 4.206.10 ..
4.206.d:
नमोऽस्तु चन्द्राय मुखं प्रपूज्य हनुर्द्विजानामधिपाय पूज्या ॥
आस्यं नमश्चंद्रमसेभिपूज्यमोष्ठौ कुमुत्खंडवनप्रियाय ॥ 4.206.10 ॥
4.206.m: having worshipped the face with "Obeisance to the moon," the chin is to be worshipped with "To the lord of the twice-born"; / having worshipped the mouth with "Obeisance to the moon," the two lips with "To him who loves clusters of night-blooming water lilies";

4.206.s:
nāsā ca nāthāya vanauṣadhīnāṃ hyānaṃndadāyātha punarbhruvośca ..
netradvayaṃ nīlakumutpriyāya ceṃdīvaraśyāmakarāya coraḥ .. 11 ..
4.206.d:
नासा च नाथाय वनौषधीनां ह्यानंन्ददायाथ पुनर्भ्रुवोश्च ॥
नेत्रद्वयं नीलकुमुत्प्रियाय चेंदीवरश्यामकराय चोरः ॥ 11 ॥
4.206.m: and the nose with "To the master of forest herbs," and both eyebrows with "To the giver of bliss"; / the two eyes with "To him who loves blue water lilies," and the chest with "To him whose hands are dark like blue lotuses";

4.206.s:
namaḥ samastādhvaravaṃditāya karṇadvayaṃ daityaniṣūdanāya ..
lalāṭamiṃdorudadhipriyāya keśā suṣumṇādhipateḥ prapūjyāḥ .. 12 ..
4.206.d:
नमः समस्ताध्वरवंदिताय कर्णद्वयं दैत्यनिषूदनाय ॥
ललाटमिंदोरुदधिप्रियाय केशा सुषुम्णाधिपतेः प्रपूज्याः ॥ 12 ॥
4.206.m: the two ears with "Obeisance to him praised in all sacrifices," with "To the slayer of daityas"; / the forehead of the moon with "To the beloved of the ocean"; the hair is to be worshipped with "To the lord of Suṣumṇā";

4.206.s:
śiraḥ śaśāṃkāya namo'surārerviśveśvarāyeti namaḥ kirīṭam ..
padmapriye rohiṇi nāma lakṣmi saubhāgyasaukhyāmṛtatārakāyai .. 13 ..
4.206.d:
शिरः शशांकाय नमोऽसुरारेर्विश्वेश्वरायेति नमः किरीटम् ॥
पद्मप्रिये रोहिणि नाम लक्ष्मि सौभाग्यसौख्यामृततारकायै ॥ 13 ॥
4.206.m: the head with "To the moon, obeisance to the enemy of the asuras"; the diadem with "Obeisance to the lord of the universe"; / with "To Lakṣmī named Rohiṇī, who loves the lotus, the star of good fortune, happiness, and nectar..."

4.206.s:
devīṃ ca saṃpūjya sugandhadhūpanevadyapuṣpādibhiriṃdupatnīm..
prapūjya bhūmau punarutthitena snātvā ca viprāya haviṣyayuktaḥ ..14..
4.206.d:
देवीं च संपूज्य सुगन्धधूपनेवद्यपुष्पादिभिरिंदुपत्नीम्॥
प्रपूज्य भूमौ पुनरुत्थितेन स्नात्वा च विप्राय हविष्ययुक्तः ॥14॥
4.206.m: And having worshipped the goddess, the wife of the moon, with fragrant incense, food offerings, flowers, and the like, / having paid homage on the ground and risen again, having bathed, he, taking sacrificial food,

4.206.s:
deyaḥ prabhāte sa hiraṇyavārikuṃbho manaḥpāpavināśanāya.
saṃprāśya gomūtramamāṃsamannamakṣāramaṣṭāvatha viṃśatiṃ ca .. 15 ..
4.206.d:
देयः प्रभाते स हिरण्यवारिकुंभो मनःपापविनाशनाय।
संप्राश्य गोमूत्रममांसमन्नमक्षारमष्टावथ विंशतिं च ॥ 15 ॥
4.206.m: should give in the morning that pot of water containing gold to a brāhmaṇa, for the destruction of mental sins. / Having consumed cow's urine, and twenty-eight mouthfuls of meatless,

4.206.s:
grāsānpayaḥ sarpiyutānupoṣya bhuktvetihāsaṃ śṛṇuyānmuhūrtam ..
kadaṃbanīlotpalaketakāni jātī sarojaṃ śatapatrikā ca ..16..
4.206.d:
ग्रासान्पयः सर्पियुतानुपोष्य भुक्त्वेतिहासं शृणुयान्मुहूर्तम् ॥
कदंबनीलोत्पलकेतकानि जाती सरोजं शतपत्रिका च ॥16॥
4.206.m: saltless food mixed with milk and clarified butter, having fasted and eaten, he should listen to epic history for a muhūrta. / Kadamba, blue lotus, ketaka, jātī, lotus, and the hundred-petaled rose,

4.206.s:
amlānakubjānatha siṃduvārapuṣpaṃ punarnārada mallikāyāḥ..
muktaṃ ca viṣṇoḥ karavīrapuṣpaṃ śrīcaṃpakaṃ caṃdramasaśca deyam..17...
4.206.d:
अम्लानकुब्जानथ सिंदुवारपुष्पं पुनर्नारद मल्लिकायाः॥
मुक्तं च विष्णोः करवीरपुष्पं श्रीचंपकं चंद्रमसश्च देयम्॥17॥।
4.206.m: and amlāna, kubja, sinduvāra flowers, and then, O Nārada, of mallikā, / and the karavīra flower offered to Viṣṇu, and glorious campaka should be given to the moon.

4.206.s:
śrāvaṇādiṣu māseṣu kramādetāni sarvadā ..
yasminmāse vratādiḥ syātpuṣpairabhyarcayeddharim .. 18 ..
4.206.d:
श्रावणादिषु मासेषु क्रमादेतानि सर्वदा ॥
यस्मिन्मासे व्रतादिः स्यात्पुष्पैरभ्यर्चयेद्धरिम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.206.m: In the months beginning with Śrāvaṇa, these in succession at all times / in whichever month the observance begins, one should worship Hari with these flowers.

4.206.s:
ekasaṃvatsaraṃ yāvadupoṣya vidhivannaraḥ ..
vratāṃte śayanaṃ dadyāddarpaṇopaskarānvitam .. 19 ..
4.206.d:
एकसंवत्सरं यावदुपोष्य विधिवन्नरः ॥
व्रतांते शयनं दद्याद्दर्पणोपस्करान्वितम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.206.m: A man, having fasted according to the rule for one year, / at the end of the observance should give a bed furnished with mirrors and accessories.

4.206.s:
rohiṇacaṃdramithunaṃ kārayitvā tu kāṃcanam ..
caṃdraḥ ṣaḍaṃgulaḥ kāryo rohiṇī caturaṃgulā .. 4.206.20 ..
4.206.d:
रोहिणचंद्रमिथुनं कारयित्वा तु कांचनम् ॥
चंद्रः षडंगुलः कार्यो रोहिणी चतुरंगुला ॥ 4.206.20 ॥
4.206.m: Having had fashioned a golden couple of Rohiṇī and the moon, / the moon should be made six aṅgulas [high], and Rohiṇī four aṅgulas,

4.206.s:
muktāphalāṣṭakayutaṃ sitanetrapaṭāvṛtam ..
kṣīrakuṃbhopari puna. kāṃsyapātrākṣatānvitam .. 21 ..
4.206.d:
मुक्ताफलाष्टकयुतं सितनेत्रपटावृतम् ॥
क्षीरकुंभोपरि पुन। कांस्यपात्राक्षतान्वितम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.206.m: endowed with eight pearls, covered with a white silk cloth, / placed atop a pot of milk, with a bronze vessel containing unbroken grains of rice.

4.206.s:
dadyānmaṃtreṇe pūrvāhne śālīkṣuphalasaṃyutam ..
śvetāmatha suvarṇāsyāṃ raupyakhurasamanvitām .. 22 ..
4.206.d:
दद्यान्मंत्रेणे पूर्वाह्ने शालीक्षुफलसंयुतम् ॥
श्वेतामथ सुवर्णास्यां रौप्यखुरसमन्विताम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.206.m: He should give it with a mantra in the forenoon, together with rice, sugarcane, and fruit, / and a white cow with a golden face, equipped with silver hooves,

4.206.s:
savastrabhājanāṃ dhenuṃ tathā śaṃkhaṃ ca śobhanam ..
bhūṣaṇairdvijadāṃpatyamalaṃkṛtya guṇānvitam .. 23 ..
4.206.d:
सवस्त्रभाजनां धेनुं तथा शंखं च शोभनम् ॥
भूषणैर्द्विजदांपत्यमलंकृत्य गुणान्वितम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.206.m: together with garments and vessels, and an auspicious conch. / Having adorned a virtuous brāhmaṇa couple with ornaments,

4.206.s:
caṃdro'yaṃ dvijarūpeṇa sabhārya iti kalpayet ..
yathā na rohiṇī kṛṣṇa śayanaṃ tyajya gacchati .. 24 ..
4.206.d:
चंद्रोऽयं द्विजरूपेण सभार्य इति कल्पयेत् ॥
यथा न रोहिणी कृष्ण शयनं त्यज्य गच्छति ॥ 24 ॥
4.206.m: he should conceptualize: "This is the moon with his wife in the form of a brāhmaṇa. / Just as Rohiṇī, O Kṛṣṇa, does not abandon the bed and go away,

4.206.s:
somarūpasya te tadvanmamābhedo'stu mūrtibhiḥ ..
yathā tvameva sarveṣāṃ paramānaṃdamuktidaḥ .. 25 ..
4.206.d:
सोमरूपस्य ते तद्वन्ममाभेदोऽस्तु मूर्तिभिः ॥
यथा त्वमेव सर्वेषां परमानंदमुक्तिदः ॥ 25 ॥
4.206.m: so may there be non-difference for me from your forms, O you who have the form of the moon. / Just as you alone are the giver of supreme bliss and liberation to all,

4.206.s:
bhuktirmuktistathā bhaktistvayi yajñe'stu me dṛḍhā ..
iti saṃsārabhītasya muktikāmasya cānagha .. 26 ..
4.206.d:
भुक्तिर्मुक्तिस्तथा भक्तिस्त्वयि यज्ञेऽस्तु मे दृढा ॥
इति संसारभीतस्य मुक्तिकामस्य चानघ ॥ 26 ॥
4.206.m: so may my enjoyment, liberation, and devotion be steadfast in you, the Sacrifice." / Thus, for one afraid of transmigration and desiring liberation, O sinless one,

4.206.s:
rūpārogyāyuṣāmetadvidhāyakamanuttamam ..
idameva pitṝṇāṃ ca sarvadā vallabhaṃ mune .. 27 ..
4.206.d:
रूपारोग्यायुषामेतद्विधायकमनुत्तमम् ॥
इदमेव पितॄणां च सर्वदा वल्लभं मुने ॥ 27 ॥
4.206.m: this is the supreme bestower of beauty, health, and lifespan. / This alone is always dear to the ancestors, O sage.

4.206.s:
trailokyādhipatirbhūtvā śatakalpaśatatrayam ..
caṃdralokamavāpnoti punarāvṛttidurlabham .. 28 ..
4.206.d:
त्रैलोक्याधिपतिर्भूत्वा शतकल्पशतत्रयम् ॥
चंद्रलोकमवाप्नोति पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.206.m: Having become the ruler of the three worlds for three hundred hundred kalpas, / he attains the world of the moon, from which return is hard to find.

4.206.s:
nārī vā rohiṇī caṃdraśayanaṃ vā samācaret ..
sā'pi tatphalamāpnoti punarāvṛttidurlabham .. 29 ..
4.206.d:
नारी वा रोहिणी चंद्रशयनं वा समाचरेत् ॥
साऽपि तत्फलमाप्नोति पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.206.m: Or if a woman should practice the Rohiṇīcandraśayana, / she too obtains that fruit, from which return is hard to find.

4.206.s:
iti paṭhati śṛṇoti vā ya itthaṃ madhumathanārcanamiṃdukīrtanena ..
matimapi ca dadāti so'pi śaurerbhavanagataḥ paripūjyate'maraughaiḥ .. 4.206.30 .. ..
śrīkṛṣṇasya dvārakāgamanavarṇanam
4.206.d:
इति पठति शृणोति वा य इत्थं मधुमथनार्चनमिंदुकीर्तनेन ॥
मतिमपि च ददाति सोऽपि शौरेर्भवनगतः परिपूज्यतेऽमरौघैः ॥ 4.206.30 ॥ ॥
श्रीकृष्णस्य द्वारकागमनवर्णनम्
4.206.m:
Whoever reads or hears of the worship of Madhusūdana in this manner, accompanied by praise of the moon,
and even whoever directs their mind to it, goes to Śauri's abode and is honoured by the hosts of immortals.
Description of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's departure for Dvārakā.

4.207.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
vrataṃ dānamatho rājaṃstava dharmāḥ prakāśitāḥ ..
dharmamūlaṃ yataścedaṃ tasmāddharmaparo bhava .. 1 ..
4.207.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
व्रतं दानमथो राजंस्तव धर्माः प्रकाशिताः ॥
धर्ममूलं यतश्चेदं तस्माद्धर्मपरो भव ॥ 1 ॥

4.207.s:
jānatā'pi mayā pārtha kāmārthau na prakāśito ..
yataḥ svayaṃ pravṛttotra lokaḥ kimanuvarṇyate .. 2 ..
4.207.d:
जानताऽपि मया पार्थ कामार्थौ न प्रकाशितो ॥
यतः स्वयं प्रवृत्तोत्र लोकः किमनुवर्ण्यते ॥ 2 ॥
4.207.m:
Even though I know them, O son of Pṛthā, I have not revealed desire and worldly wealth,
since people here are engaged in them of their own accord—why should they be described?

4.207.s:
kāmino varṇayankāmām̐llobhaṃ lubdhasya varṇayan ..
naraḥ kiṃ phalamāpnoti kūpeṃ'dhamiva pātayan .. 3 ..
4.207.d:
कामिनो वर्णयन्कामाम्̐ल्लोभं लुब्धस्य वर्णयन् ॥
नरः किं फलमाप्नोति कूपेंऽधमिव पातयन् ॥ 3 ॥
4.207.m:
What fruit does a man gain by describing desires to a lustful person,
[or] by describing greed to a greedy person, like throwing a blind man into a well?

4.207.s:
bhaviṣyottarametatte kathitaṃ pāṃḍunaṃdana ..
sadācāravatāṃ puṃsāṃ vratadānasamuccayaḥ ..4..
4.207.d:
भविष्योत्तरमेतत्ते कथितं पांडुनंदन ॥
सदाचारवतां पुंसां व्रतदानसमुच्चयः ॥4॥
4.207.m:
This Bhaviṣyottara has been told to you, O son of Pāṇḍu,
a compendium of votive observances and gifts for virtuous men.

4.207.s:
yaddṛṣṭamitihāseṣu purāṇeṣu ca bhārata ..
vedavedāṃgasaṃbaddhaṃ tatsarvamiha darśitam ..5..
4.207.d:
यद्दृष्टमितिहासेषु पुराणेषु च भारत ॥
वेदवेदांगसंबद्धं तत्सर्वमिह दर्शितम् ॥5॥
4.207.m:
Whatever has been seen in the histories and in the Purāṇas, O descendant of Bharata,
connected with the Vedas and the auxiliary Vedic sciences—all of that has been shown here.

4.207.s:
lokavedaviruddhaṃ yatkathyate manujottama ..
na tatrāsthā prakartavyā vipralāpo hi sa smṛtaḥ .. 6 ..
4.207.d:
लोकवेदविरुद्धं यत्कथ्यते मनुजोत्तम ॥
न तत्रास्था प्रकर्तव्या विप्रलापो हि स स्मृतः ॥ 6 ॥
4.207.m:
Whatever is spoken that contradicts the world and the Vedas, O best among men,
no faith should be placed in it, for it is regarded as meaningless prattle.

4.207.s:
atisnehena bhavato mamaitatsamudāhṛtam ..
ṛṣīṇāṃ purataḥ pārtha kuṃṭhā bhavati bhāratī .. 7 ..
4.207.d:
अतिस्नेहेन भवतो ममैतत्समुदाहृतम् ॥
ऋषीणां पुरतः पार्थ कुंठा भवति भारती ॥ 7 ॥
4.207.m:
Out of great affection for you, this has been spoken by me;
O son of Pṛthā, in front of the sages, speech becomes blunt.

4.207.s:
naitatprakāśanīyaṃ hi dāṃbhikāya śaṭhāya vā ..
nāstikāyānyamanase kutarkopahatāya ca .. 8 ..
4.207.d:
नैतत्प्रकाशनीयं हि दांभिकाय शठाय वा ॥
नास्तिकायान्यमनसे कुतर्कोपहताय च ॥ 8 ॥
4.207.m:
This should not be disclosed to a hypocrite or a rogue,
nor to an atheist, to one whose mind is elsewhere, or to one ruined by faulty reasoning.

4.207.s:
sādhuvṛttāya dāṃtāya satyārjavaratāya ca ..
etadākhyāyamānaṃ hi śubhāmutpādayedgatim ..9..
4.207.d:
साधुवृत्ताय दांताय सत्यार्जवरताय च ॥
एतदाख्यायमानं हि शुभामुत्पादयेद्गतिम् ॥9॥
4.207.m:
When told to one of good conduct, self-restrained,
and devoted to truth and straightforwardness, it brings about an auspicious destination.

4.207.s:
sāmānyametatsurasattamānāṃ varṇāśramāṇāṃ ca nareṃdracandra ..
khyātaṃ bhaviṣyottaranāmadheyaṃ mayā purāṇaṃ tava sauhṛdena ..4.207.10..
4.207.d:
सामान्यमेतत्सुरसत्तमानां वर्णाश्रमाणां च नरेंद्रचन्द्र ॥
ख्यातं भविष्योत्तरनामधेयं मया पुराणं तव सौहृदेन ॥4.207.10॥
4.207.m:
Common to the best of gods and to the varnas and āśramas, O moon among kings,
this Purāṇa named Bhaviṣyottara has been declared by me out of friendship for you.

4.207.s:
dharmaḥ svayaṃ pārtha bhavāniha tvaṃ dharmārthaviddṛṣṭaparāvaraśca ..
pṛṣṭo'smyato dharmamahaṃ ca vacmi śraddheyametatsutarāṃ janasya .. 11 ..
4.207.d:
धर्मः स्वयं पार्थ भवानिह त्वं धर्मार्थविद्दृष्टपरावरश्च ॥
पृष्टोऽस्म्यतो धर्ममहं च वच्मि श्रद्धेयमेतत्सुतरां जनस्य ॥ 11 ॥
4.207.m:
You yourself are dharma embodied here, O son of Pṛthā, knowing dharma and wealth, and seeing the higher and the lower;
I was asked, and therefore I speak of dharma, which must certainly be trusted by people.

4.207.s:
yāsyāmyahaṃ dvāravatīṃ punaśca yajñaṃ sameṣyāmi mahotsave ca ..
kālasya sarvaṃ hi vaśe viditvā naivānutāpo bhavatātra kāryaḥ .. 12 ..
4.207.d:
यास्याम्यहं द्वारवतीं पुनश्च यज्ञं समेष्यामि महोत्सवे च ॥
कालस्य सर्वं हि वशे विदित्वा नैवानुतापो भवतात्र कार्यः ॥ 12 ॥
4.207.m:
I shall go to Dvāravatī, and I shall come again to the sacrifice and on great festive occasions;
knowing that everything is under the control of time, you should not feel any grief in this matter.

4.207.s:
ityuktavānyātukāmaḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ saṃpūjitaḥ pāṃḍusutairmahātmā ..
pṛṣṭvā suhṛjjjñātijanaṃ hi sarvaṃ jagāma viprānpraṇipatya kṛṣṇaḥ .. 13 ..
4.207.d:
इत्युक्तवान्यातुकामः प्रहृष्टः संपूजितः पांडुसुतैर्महात्मा ॥
पृष्ट्वा सुहृज्ज्ज्ञातिजनं हि सर्वं जगाम विप्रान्प्रणिपत्य कृष्णः ॥ 13 ॥
4.207.m:
Having spoken thus, the great-souled Kṛṣṇa, desirous of departing, rejoiced, honoured by the sons of Pāṇḍu;
having taken leave of all his friends and kin, he bowed down to the brahmins and departed.

4.207.s:
yadyājñavalkyamuninā bhagavānvaśiṣṭhaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ kilottaramuvāca bahuprakāram ..
kṛṣṇena pāṃḍutanayasya ca yatpradiṣṭaṃ vyāsena tatkṛtamaho munipuṃgavena .. 14 ..
4.207.d:
यद्याज्ञवल्क्यमुनिना भगवान्वशिष्ठः पृष्टः किलोत्तरमुवाच बहुप्रकारम् ॥
कृष्णेन पांडुतनयस्य च यत्प्रदिष्टं व्यासेन तत्कृतमहो मुनिपुंगवेन ॥ 14 ॥
4.207.m:
That which the venerable Vasiṣṭha, questioned by the sage Yājñavalkya, indeed gave as multifaceted answers,
and that which was instructed by Kṛṣṇa to the son of Pāṇḍu—all that, lo, was composed by Vyāsa, the bull among sages.

4.207.s:
jayati parāśarasūnuḥ satyavatīhṛdayanaṃdano vyāsaḥ ..
yasyāsyakamalagalita vāṅmadhupuṇyaṃ jagatpibati ..15..
anukramaṇikākathanam
( atha vṛttāṃtāḥ ..)
4.207.d:
जयति पराशरसूनुः सत्यवतीहृदयनंदनो व्यासः ॥
यस्यास्यकमलगलित वाङ्मधुपुण्यं जगत्पिबति ॥15॥
अनुक्रमणिकाकथनम्
( अथ वृत्तांताः ॥)
4.207.m:
Victorious is the son of Parāśara, the delighter of Satyavatī's heart, Vyāsa,
the pure honey of whose speech, trickling from the lotus of his mouth, the world drinks.
Recitation of the Table of Contents
(Now, the topics:)

4.208.s:
vyāsānugamanaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmāṃḍasya samudbhavaḥ ..
māyā ca vaiṣṇavī yasmātsaṃsāre doṣakīrtanam .. 1
4.208.d:
व्यासानुगमनं पूर्वं ब्रह्मांडस्य समुद्भवः ॥
माया च वैष्णवी यस्मात्संसारे दोषकीर्तनम् ॥ 1
4.208.m:
First, the accompanying of Vyāsa; the origin of the egg of Brahmā;
and the Vaiṣṇava Māyā, from which comes the description of the faults of worldly existence;

4.208.s:
pāpabhedastatastasmācchubhāśubhavinirṇayaḥ ..
śakaṭavratamāhātmyaṃ tilakavratakīrtanam .. 2 ..
4.208.d:
पापभेदस्ततस्तस्माच्छुभाशुभविनिर्णयः ॥
शकटव्रतमाहात्म्यं तिलकव्रतकीर्तनम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.208.m:
then the division of sins; from that, the determination of the auspicious and inauspicious;
the glorification of the śakaṭa votive observance; the declaration of the tilaka votive observance;

4.208.s:
aśokakaravīrākhyaṃ vrataṃ tasmācca kokilam ..
bṛhattapovrataṃ nāma rudropoṣaṇameva ca .. 3 ..
4.208.d:
अशोककरवीराख्यं व्रतं तस्माच्च कोकिलम् ॥
बृहत्तपोव्रतं नाम रुद्रोपोषणमेव च ॥ 3 ॥
4.208.m:
the votive observance named Aśoka-karavīra, and after that the Kokila;
the one named Bṛhattapas votive observance, and the Rudra fast;

4.208.s:
dvitīyāvratamāhātmyamaśūnya śayanaṃ tathā ..
kāmākhyā tu tṛtīyā ca meghapālīvrataṃ tathā .. 4 ..
4.208.d:
द्वितीयाव्रतमाहात्म्यमशून्य शयनं तथा ॥
कामाख्या तु तृतीया च मेघपालीव्रतं तथा ॥ 4 ॥
4.208.m:
the glorification of the dvitīyā votive observance, and likewise the Aśūnyaśayana;
the tṛtīyā named Kāmā, and likewise the Meghapālī votive observance;

4.208.s:
paṃcāgnisādhanā ramyā tṛtīyāvratamuttamam ..
trirātraṃ goṣpadaṃ nāma harakālī vrataṃ tathā .. 5 ..
4.208.d:
पंचाग्निसाधना रम्या तृतीयाव्रतमुत्तमम् ॥
त्रिरात्रं गोष्पदं नाम हरकाली व्रतं तथा ॥ 5 ॥
4.208.m:
the pleasant tṛtīyā votive observance of practicing the five fires, the excellent one;
the trirātra named Goṣpada, and likewise the Harakālī votive observance;

4.208.s:
lalitākhyā tṛtīyā ca yogākhyā ca tathāparā..
umāmaheśvaraṃ nāma tathā raṃbhātṛtīyakam .. 6 ..
4.208.d:
ललिताख्या तृतीया च योगाख्या च तथापरा॥
उमामहेश्वरं नाम तथा रंभातृतीयकम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.208.m:
the tṛtīyā named Lalitā, and another named Yogā;
the one named Umāmaheśvara, and likewise the Rambhā-tṛtīyā;

4.208.s:
saubhāgyākhyā tṛtīyā ca ārdrānaṃdakarī thā ..
caitre bhādrapade māghe tṛtīyāvratamucyate .. 7 ..
4.208.d:
सौभाग्याख्या तृतीया च आर्द्रानंदकरी था ॥
चैत्रे भाद्रपदे माघे तृतीयाव्रतमुच्यते ॥ 7 ॥
4.208.m:
the tṛtīyā named Saubhāgyā, and the Ārdrānandakarī;
in Caitra, Bhādrapada, and Māgha, the tṛtīyā votive observance is taught;

4.208.s:
anaṃtarī tṛtīyā ca gaṇaśāṃtivrataṃ tathā ..
sārasvatavrataṃ nāma paṃcamīvrata mucyate .. 8 ..
4.208.d:
अनंतरी तृतीया च गणशांतिव्रतं तथा ॥
सारस्वतव्रतं नाम पंचमीव्रत मुच्यते ॥ 8 ॥
4.208.m:
the subsequent tṛtīyā, and likewise the Gaṇaśānti votive observance;
the votive observance named Sārasvata, and the pañcamī votive observance is taught;

4.208.s:
tathā śrīpaṃcamī nāma ṣaṣṭhī śokapraṇāśinī ..
phalaṣaṣṭhī ca maṃdāraṣaṣṭhīvratamathocyate .. 9 ..
4.208.d:
तथा श्रीपंचमी नाम षष्ठी शोकप्रणाशिनी ॥
फलषष्ठी च मंदारषष्ठीव्रतमथोच्यते ॥ 9 ॥
4.208.m:
likewise the one named Śrīpañcamī; the ṣaṣṭhī that destroys sorrow;
and the Phalaṣaṣṭhī, and then the Mandāraṣaṣṭhī votive observance is taught;

4.208.s:
lalitāvrataṣaṣṭhī ca ṣaṣṭhī kārtikasaṃjñitā ..
mahattapaḥ saptamī ca vibhūṣā saptamī tathā .. 4.208.10 ..
4.208.d:
ललिताव्रतषष्ठी च षष्ठी कार्तिकसंज्ञिता ॥
महत्तपः सप्तमी च विभूषा सप्तमी तथा ॥ 4.208.10 ॥
4.208.m:
the Lalitāvrata-ṣaṣṭhī, and the ṣaṣṭhī named Kārtika;
the Mahattapas-saptamī, and likewise the Vibhūṣā-saptamī;

4.208.s:
ādityamaṃḍapavidhistrayodaśīti saptamī ..
kṛkavākuplavaṅgā ca tathaivābhayasaptamī .. 11 ...
4.208.d:
आदित्यमंडपविधिस्त्रयोदशीति सप्तमी ॥
कृकवाकुप्लवङ्गा च तथैवाभयसप्तमी ॥ 11 ॥।
4.208.m:
the ritual of the Ādityamaṇḍapa; the saptamī [known as] Trayodaśī;
and the Kṛkavākuplavaṅgā, and likewise the Abhayasaptamī;

4.208.s:
kalyāṇasaptamī nāma śarkarāsaptamīvratam ..
saptamī kamalākhyā ca tathānyā śubhasaptamī .. 12 ..
4.208.d:
कल्याणसप्तमी नाम शर्करासप्तमीव्रतम् ॥
सप्तमी कमलाख्या च तथान्या शुभसप्तमी ॥ 12 ॥
4.208.m:
the one named Kalyāṇasaptamī; the Śarkarāsaptamī votive observance;
the saptamī named Kamalā, and another auspicious saptamī;

4.208.s:
snapanavratasaptamyau tathaivācala saptamī ..
budhāṣṭamīvrataṃ nāma tathā janmāṣṭamīvratam .. 13 ..
4.208.d:
स्नपनव्रतसप्तम्यौ तथैवाचल सप्तमी ॥
बुधाष्टमीव्रतं नाम तथा जन्माष्टमीव्रतम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.208.m:
the two Snapanavrata-saptamīs, and likewise the Acalasaptamī;
the votive observance named Budhāṣṭamī, and likewise the Janmāṣṭamī votive observance;

4.208.s:
dūrvākṛṣṇāṣṭamī proktā anayāvratamaṣṭamī ..
aṣṭamyarkāṣṭamī cātha vṛkṣanavamīvratam.. ... 14 ..
4.208.d:
दूर्वाकृष्णाष्टमी प्रोक्ता अनयाव्रतमष्टमी ॥
अष्टम्यर्काष्टमी चाथ वृक्षनवमीव्रतम्॥ ॥। 14 ॥
4.208.m:
the Dūrvākṛṣṇāṣṭamī is declared; the aṣṭamī votive observance without another;
the [standard] aṣṭamī, and the Arkāṣṭamī, and then the Vṛkṣanavamī votive observance;

4.208.s:
dhvajākhyā navamī caiva ulkākhyā navamī tathā ..
daśāvatāravratakaṃ tathāśādaśamīvratam .. 15 ..
4.208.d:
ध्वजाख्या नवमी चैव उल्काख्या नवमी तथा ॥
दशावतारव्रतकं तथाशादशमीव्रतम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.208.m:
the navamī named Dhvajā, and likewise the navamī named Ulkā;
the Daśāvatāra votive observance, and likewise the Āśādaśamī votive observance;

4.208.s:
rohiṇīṃhariśaṃbhubrahmasūryāviyogakam..
govatsadvādaśīnāma vratamuktaṃ tataḥ param .. 16 ..
4.208.d:
रोहिणींहरिशंभुब्रह्मसूर्यावियोगकम्॥
गोवत्सद्वादशीनाम व्रतमुक्तं ततः परम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.208.m:
the Rohiṇī-[vrata], non-separation from Hari, Śambhu, Brahmā, and Sūrya;
after that, the votive observance named Govatsadvādaśī is stated;

4.208.s:
nīrājanadvādaśī ca bhīṣmapaṃcakameva ca ..
mallikākhyā dvādaśī ca bhīmā dvādaśikottamā .. .. 17 ..
4.208.d:
नीराजनद्वादशी च भीष्मपंचकमेव च ॥
मल्लिकाख्या द्वादशी च भीमा द्वादशिकोत्तमा ॥ ॥ 17 ॥
4.208.m:
the Nīrājanadvādaśī, and Bhīṣmapañcaka;
the dvādaśī named Mallikā, and the excellent Bhīmā-dvādaśī;

4.208.s:
śravaṇadvādaśī nāma saṃprāptidvādaśīvratam ..
govindadvādaśīnāma vratamuktaṃ tataḥ param..18..
4.208.d:
श्रवणद्वादशी नाम संप्राप्तिद्वादशीव्रतम् ॥
गोविन्दद्वादशीनाम व्रतमुक्तं ततः परम्॥18॥
4.208.m:
the one named Śravaṇadvādaśī; the Saṃprāptidvādaśī votive observance;
after that, the votive observance named Govindadvādaśī is stated;

4.208.s:
akhaṃḍadvādaśīnāma tiladvādaśyataḥ param ..
sukṛtadvādaśī nāma dharaṇīvratameva ca .. 19 ..
4.208.d:
अखंडद्वादशीनाम तिलद्वादश्यतः परम् ॥
