सुकृतद्वादशी नाम धरणीव्रतमेव च ॥ 19 ॥
4.208.m:
the one named Akhaṇḍadvādaśī, and after that the Tiladvādaśī;
the one named Sukṛtadvādaśī, and the Dharaṇī votive observance;

4.208.s:
viśokadvādaśī nāma vibhūtidvādaśīvratam ..
puṣyarkṣadvādaśī caiva dvādaśī śravaṇarkṣagā .. 4.208.20 ..
4.208.d:
विशोकद्वादशी नाम विभूतिद्वादशीव्रतम् ॥
पुष्यर्क्षद्वादशी चैव द्वादशी श्रवणर्क्षगा ॥ 4.208.20 ॥
4.208.m:
the one named Viśokadvādaśī; the Vibhūtidvādaśī votive observance;
the dvādaśī in the asterism of Puṣya, and the dvādaśī occurring in the asterism of Śravaṇa;

4.208.s:
anaṃgadvādaśī caiva aṅgapādavrataṃ tathā ..
nimbārkakaravīrātha yamā darśatrayodaśī ..
anaṃgadvādaśī cāpi pālirambhāvrate tathā .. 21 ..
4.208.d:
अनंगद्वादशी चैव अङ्गपादव्रतं तथा ॥
निम्बार्ककरवीराथ यमा दर्शत्रयोदशी ॥
अनंगद्वादशी चापि पालिरम्भाव्रते तथा ॥ 21 ॥

4.208.s:
caturdaśīvrataṃ proktaṃ tato'nantacaturdaśī ..
śrāvaṇīvratanaktaṃ ca caturdaśyaṣṭamīdine .. 22..
4.208.d:
चतुर्दशीव्रतं प्रोक्तं ततोऽनन्तचतुर्दशी ॥
श्रावणीव्रतनक्तं च चतुर्दश्यष्टमीदिने ॥ 22॥
4.208.m:
the caturdaśī votive observance is declared; then the Anantacaturdaśī;
and the nocturnal meal of the Śrāvaṇī observance, on the day of caturdaśī and aṣṭamī.

4.208.s:
vrataṃ śivacaturdaśyāṃ phalatyāgacaturdaśī ..
vaiśākhī kārtikī māghī vratametadanaṃtaran .. 23 ..
4.208.d:
व्रतं शिवचतुर्दश्यां फलत्यागचतुर्दशी ॥
वैशाखी कार्तिकी माघी व्रतमेतदनंतरन् ॥ 23 ॥
4.208.m: The votive observance on Śivacaturdaśī, the Phalatyāgacaturdaśī, / and next this votive observance on the full moon of Vaiśākha, of Kārttika, and of Māgha;

4.208.s:
kārtikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge kṛttikāvratamīritam ..
phālgune pūrṇimāyāṃ tu vrataṃ pūrṇamanoratham .. 24 ..
4.208.d:
कार्तिक्यां कृत्तिकायोगे कृत्तिकाव्रतमीरितम् ॥
फाल्गुने पूर्णिमायां तु व्रतं पूर्णमनोरथम् ॥ 24 ॥
4.208.m: on the full moon of Kārttika when conjoined with Kṛttikā, the Kṛttikā observance is proclaimed; / and on the full moon of Phālguna, the observance that fulfils all desires;

4.208.s:
aśokapūrṇimā nāma anaṃtavratameva ca ..
vrataṃ hi sāṃbharāyiṇyaṃ nakṣatrapuruṣavratam .. 25 ..
4.208.d:
अशोकपूर्णिमा नाम अनंतव्रतमेव च ॥
व्रतं हि सांभरायिण्यं नक्षत्रपुरुषव्रतम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.208.m: the observance named Aśokapūrṇimā, and also the Anantavrata; / the observance indeed at Sāmbharāyī, the Nakṣatrapuruṣa observance,

4.208.s:
śivanakṣatrapuruṣaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ yena mucyate ..
kāmadānavrataṃ nāma vṛntākavidhireva ca .. 26 ..
4.208.d:
शिवनक्षत्रपुरुषं संपूर्णं येन मुच्यते ॥
कामदानव्रतं नाम वृन्ताकविधिरेव च ॥ 26 ॥
4.208.m: the complete Śivanakṣatrapuruṣa by which one is liberated; / the observance named Kāmadāna, and the rule regarding eggplants;

4.208.s:
ādityasya dine naktaṃ saṃkrātyudyāpane phalam ..
bhadrāvratamagastyārgho navacandrārkameva ca .. 27 ..
4.208.d:
आदित्यस्य दिने नक्तं संक्रात्युद्यापने फलम् ॥
भद्राव्रतमगस्त्यार्घो नवचन्द्रार्कमेव च ॥ 27 ॥
4.208.m: the nocturnal meal on Sunday, the fruit of concluding the solstice observance; / the Bhadrā observance, the libation to Agastya, and the new moon and sun,

4.208.s:
arghaḥ śukrabṛhaspatyoḥ paṃcāśīti vratāni ca ..
māghasnānaṃ nityasnānaṃ rudrastānavidhistathā .. 28 ..
4.208.d:
अर्घः शुक्रबृहस्पत्योः पंचाशीति व्रतानि च ॥
माघस्नानं नित्यस्नानं रुद्रस्तानविधिस्तथा ॥ 28 ॥
4.208.m: the libation to Venus and Jupiter, and the eighty-five votive observances; / the bath in Māgha, the daily bath, and the rule for bathing Rudra;

4.208.s:
caṃdrārkagrahaṇe snānaṃ vidhiścānnāśane tathā ..
vāpīkūpataḍāgānāmutsargo vṛkṣayājanam .. 29 ..
4.208.d:
चंद्रार्कग्रहणे स्नानं विधिश्चान्नाशने तथा ॥
वापीकूपतडागानामुत्सर्गो वृक्षयाजनम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.208.m: the bath during an eclipse of the moon or sun, and likewise the rule for the first feeding of solid food; / the consecration of step-wells, wells, and ponds, the worship of trees;

4.208.s:
devapūjādīpadānavṛṣotsargavidhistathā ..
phālgunyutsavakaṃ nāma tathānyaḥ sadanotsavaḥ .. 4.208.30 ..
4.208.d:
देवपूजादीपदानवृषोत्सर्गविधिस्तथा ॥
फाल्गुन्युत्सवकं नाम तथान्यः सदनोत्सवः ॥ 4.208.30 ॥
4.208.m: the rule for worship of the gods, offering of lamps, and setting free a bull; / the celebration called the festival of the Phālguna full moon, and another celebration of the home;

4.208.s:
bhūtamātā ca śrāvaṇyāṃ rakṣābaṃdhavidhistathā ..
vidhistathā navamyāstu tathā candramahotsavaḥ .. 31 ..
4.208.d:
भूतमाता च श्रावण्यां रक्षाबंधविधिस्तथा ॥
विधिस्तथा नवम्यास्तु तथा चन्द्रमहोत्सवः ॥ 31 ॥
4.208.m: and Bhūtamātā, and on the Śrāvaṇa full moon the rite of tying the protective amulet; / likewise the rite of the navamī, and the great lunar festival;

4.208.s:
dīpālikāyāṃ tu homo lakṣahomavidhistathā ..
koṭihomo mahāśītirgaṇanāthasya śātikā .. 32 ..
4.208.d:
दीपालिकायां तु होमो लक्षहोमविधिस्तथा ॥
कोटिहोमो महाशीतिर्गणनाथस्य शातिका ॥ 32 ॥
4.208.m: and the fire oblation on Dīpāvalī, and the rule for the hundred-thousand-fire-offerings; / the ten-million-fire-offerings, the great eighty-five, the pacification rite of Gaṇanātha;

4.208.s:
tathā nakṣatrahomotha godānavidhireva ca ..
guḍadhenughṛtadhenutiladhenuvrataṃ tathā .. 33 ..
4.208.d:
तथा नक्षत्रहोमोथ गोदानविधिरेव च ॥
गुडधेनुघृतधेनुतिलधेनुव्रतं तथा ॥ 33 ॥
4.208.m: likewise the lunar-mansion fire oblation, and the rule for the gift of a cow; / and the observance of the molasses-cow, the clarified-butter-cow, and the sesame-cow;

4.208.s:
jaladhenuvidhiḥ prokto lavaṇasya tathā parā ..
dhenuḥ kāryāsamaṃjñātvā navanītasya cāparā ..
suvarṇadhenuśca tathā devakāryaṃ cikīrṣubhiḥ .. 34 ..
.. iti caturthamuttaraparva .. 4 ..
samāpto'yaṃ bhaviṣyapurāṇagranthaḥ .
4.208.d:
जलधेनुविधिः प्रोक्तो लवणस्य तथा परा ॥
धेनुः कार्यासमंज्ञात्वा नवनीतस्य चापरा ॥
सुवर्णधेनुश्च तथा देवकार्यं चिकीर्षुभिः ॥ 34 ॥
॥ इति चतुर्थमुत्तरपर्व ॥ 4 ॥
समाप्तोऽयं भविष्यपुराणग्रन्थः ।
4.208.m:
the rule for the water-cow has been taught, and another, the cow / of salt is to be made, knowing its equality; and another of fresh butter, / and the golden cow, by those wishing to perform acts for the gods.
Thus ends the fourth part, the Uttaraparvan.
This Bhaviṣyapurāṇa text is complete.

Now begins the subject table of contents of the Uttaraparvan (4):
1 [page] 376 Auspicious invocation; the arrival of Vyāsa and numerous other great sages to the sovereign King Yudhiṣṭhira consecrated under the royal parasol; Yudhiṣṭhira asking them questions through a desire to hear various duties in order to dispel the sin arising from killing his own kinsmen; Vyāsa describing duties by way of questions and answers to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, praising [them], and departing to his hermitage: 30 verses.
2 [page] 376 Dialogue of Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira; Śrī Kṛṣṇa describing to Yudhiṣṭhira the account of the origin of the entire universe: 51 verses.
3 [page] 377 Description of the account of seeing the true nature of the Lord's Māyā: 107 verses.
4 [page] 379 Description demonstrating the defects of rebirth and worldly existence: 135 verses.
5 [page] 382 Description of the divisions of unrighteousness and sin: 85 verses.
6 [page] 384 Description of the manner of the torments of Yama in the description of attaining the fruits of auspicious and inauspicious courses: 209 verses.
7 [page] 388 Description of the majesty of the cart observance: 31 verses.
